/**
 * Account deletion across the three modules on real Postgres: the auth repository behind the auth

describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: account deletion", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  /** 3e: profiles.created_at is no longer the API role's to write (migration 0020 grants it the columns it writes), so the migrator ages the profile. */
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let authRepo: AuthRepo;
  let h: FlowHarness;
  let m: MediaHarness;
  let s: SocialHarness;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 1 });
    authRepo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    h = flowHarness(authRepo, { profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb) });
    m = await mediaHarness(apiDb);
    s = socialHarness(apiDb, {
      media: {
        attach: (tx, input) => m.deps.repo.attach(tx, input),
        detachAll: (tx, postId) => m.deps.repo.detachAll(tx, postId),
        requestDeletion: (ids) => m.files.requestDeletion(ids),
        forPosts: (postIds) => m.deps.repo.forPosts(postIds),
      },
    });

  afterAll(async () => {
    m.cleanup();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

      confirmDeletion: (session, input) => authConfirmDeletion(h.deps, session, input),
      pendingPurges: () => authRepo.pendingPurges(),
      finishPurge: (userId) => authRepo.finishPurge(userId, new Date()),
      takeDownTerminated: (userId, facts) => takeDownTerminated(h.deps, userId, facts),
      exportAccount: (userId) => exportAccount(h.deps, userId),

    social: {

  /** An auth account with a password, signed in on one device, with a profile of the same id in the public schema, old enough to quote and repost. */

  test("deleting an account with posts, images, engagement and graph rows leaves tombstones, right counters elsewhere, no image rows, an anonymised profile with its handle reserved, and an anonymised auth row", async () => {

    await authRepo.setPhoneHash(userId, randomBytes(16).toString("hex"));
    await h.deps.profiles.setVerified(userId, new Date());

    const [bob, carol, dan, eve] = await Promise.all([s.established(), s.established(), s.established(), s.established()]);
    const bobsPost = await createPost(s.deps, bob.id, { body: "bob's post", media: [] });

    const selfReply = await createPost(s.deps, userId, { body: "my own follow-up", replyToId: root.id, media: [] });

    const quoteOfBob = await createPost(s.deps, userId, { body: "quoting bob", quoteOfId: bobsPost.id, media: [] });
    const earlier = await createPost(s.deps, userId, { body: "deleted before the account", media: [] });
    await deletePost(s.deps, userId, earlier.id);
    const earlierDeletedAt = (await postRow(earlier.id)).deletedAt;
    const bobsReply = await createPost(s.deps, bob.id, { body: "bob replies", replyToId: root.id, media: [] });
    // Engagement: the owner's on bob's post goes with the counters; carol's stays, so the counters come down to one, not to zero.

    expect((await authRepo.recentEvents(userId)).map((e) => e.type)).toContain("account_deleted");

    expect(gone.deletedAt).not.toBeNull();

    expect(await s.repo.changeHandle(bob.id, owner.handle, s.clock.next())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "handle_taken" });

  test("3e: a suspended account deletes itself its 1b way, with no hold: the purge takes the rows of its followers and those it follows before any post, writes their counters exactly, and writes no standing into the deleted row", async () => {
    const owner = await account();
    const userId = owner.user.id;
    const [bob, carol] = await Promise.all([s.established(), s.established()]);
    const own = await createPost(s.deps, userId, { body: "posted before the suspension", media: [] });
    expect(await s.repo.follow(bob.id, userId, s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
    expect(await s.repo.follow(userId, carol.id, s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
    await suspendRowForTest(migrateDb, userId);
    // The suspended account cannot post, but it can delete itself (GDPR Art. 17): no hold (3e design, section 2, row 27).
    expect(await rejection(createPost(s.deps, userId, { body: "while suspended", media: [] }))).toBe("account_suspended");
    const { flowId } = await startDeletion(deps(), owner.session, h.ctx);
    await confirmDeletion(deps(), owner.session, { flowId, code: h.mailer.lastCodeFor(owner.email)!, handle: owner.handle });
    expect((await authRow(userId))!.purgedAt).not.toBeNull();
    expect(await profileRow(userId)).toMatchObject({ displayName: "Deleted account", followerCount: 0, followingCount: 0, postCount: 0 });
    expect(await postRow(own.id)).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" });
    expect(await profileRow(bob.id)).toMatchObject({ followingCount: 0 });
    expect(await profileRow(carol.id)).toMatchObject({ followerCount: 0 });
  });

  test("3e: the take-down of a terminated account, as the system: the row marked deleted and its sessions revoked as a confirmation leaves them, the event marked a termination's, termination_final to the address read before it and never account_deleted; a second call changes and mails nothing, and the round's purge finishes it", async () => {
    const owner = await account();
    const userId = owner.user.id;
    const decidedAt = new Date("2026-04-04T09:30:15.250Z");
    expect(await takeDownTerminated(h.deps, userId, { decidedAt, imagesSealed: true })).toBe(true);
    expect((await authRow(userId))!.deletedAt).not.toBeNull();
    expect(await authRepo.findActiveSession(owner.session.sessionId, new Date())).toBeUndefined();
    const mailed = () => h.mailer.sent.filter((mail) => mail.to === owner.email);
    expect(mailed().map((mail) => mail.template)).toEqual(["termination_final"]);
    expect(mailed()[0]!.data).toEqual({ decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "true" });
    const [event] = await migrateDb.execute<{ metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(sql`select metadata from auth.auth_events where user_id = ${userId}::uuid and type = 'account_deleted'`);
    expect(event?.metadata).toEqual({ terminated: true });
    // Once only: the account is already marked deleted, so nothing is written and nothing mailed.
    expect(await takeDownTerminated(h.deps, userId, { decidedAt, imagesSealed: true })).toBe(false);
    expect(mailed()).toHaveLength(1);
    // The round's purge finds it among the deletions left to finish, as any other.
    expect(await authRepo.pendingPurges()).toContain(userId);
    const report = await purgePending(deps());
    expect(report).toMatchObject({ failed: 0, terminated: 0 });
    expect((await authRow(userId))!.purgedAt).not.toBeNull();
  });

  test("sign-in with a deleted address behaves as for an unknown one before the purge ran, and one round of the job finishes deletions left half done, oldest first", async () => {
    const ghost = await account();
    const later = await account();
    const bob = await s.established();
    const ghostsPost = await createPost(s.deps, ghost.user.id, { body: "left behind", media: [] });
    expect(await s.repo.follow(bob.id, ghost.user.id, s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
    expect(await s.repo.follow(ghost.user.id, bob.id, s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
    // Deleted by hand, as a process that died after the auth step leaves them: no purge has run.
    await authRepo.markDeleted(ghost.user.id, new Date(Date.now() - 120_000));
    await authRepo.markDeleted(later.user.id, new Date(Date.now() - 60_000));

    // The start answers as for an address without an account, and the right password no longer signs in.
    const device = newTestDevice();
    const started = await startEmail(h.deps, { email: ghost.email, turnstileToken: "ok", ...device }, h.ctx);
    expect(Object.keys(started)).toEqual(["flowId"]);
    expect((await authRepo.findEmailCode(started.flowId))?.purpose).toBe("signup");
    expect(h.mailer.sent.filter((mail) => mail.to === ghost.email).map((mail) => mail.template)).toEqual(["sign_up_code"]);
    expect(await rejection(passwordSignIn(h.deps, { email: ghost.email, password: PASSWORD, turnstileToken: "ok", ...device }, h.ctx))).toBe("invalid_credentials");
    expect(await authRepo.findActiveSession(ghost.session.sessionId, new Date())).toBeUndefined();
    // The profile is still there for the moment; the job is what takes it down.
    expect(await s.repo.findProfileByHandle(ghost.handle)).not.toBeNull();

    const pending = await authRepo.pendingPurges();
    expect(pending).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([ghost.user.id, later.user.id]));
    expect(pending.indexOf(ghost.user.id)).toBeLessThan(pending.indexOf(later.user.id));
    const report = await purgePending(deps());
    expect(report.failed).toBe(0);
    expect(report.purged).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    expect(await authRepo.pendingPurges()).toEqual([]);
    for (const user of [ghost, later]) {
      const row = (await authRow(user.user.id))!;
      expect(row.purgedAt, user.handle).not.toBeNull();
      expect(row.email, user.handle).toBe(`deleted:${user.user.id}`);
      expect(await s.repo.findProfileByHandle(user.handle), user.handle).toBeNull();
      expect(await profileRow(user.user.id)).toMatchObject({ displayName: "Deleted account", followerCount: 0, followingCount: 0, postCount: 0 });
    }
    expect(await postRow(ghostsPost.id)).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" });
    expect(await profileRow(bob.id)).toMatchObject({ followerCount: 0, followingCount: 0 });
    // The job as the server runs it: a round under its lock, with nothing left to do.
    expect(await createPurgeJob(deps(), new MemoryJobLock()).round()).toBe("ran");

    // finishPurge twice is once: the second call leaves the row as it was; and it never touches a live account.
    const purged = await authRow(ghost.user.id);
    await authRepo.finishPurge(ghost.user.id, new Date(Date.now() + 1000));
    expect(await authRow(ghost.user.id)).toEqual(purged);
    const alive = await account();
    await authRepo.finishPurge(alive.user.id, new Date());
    expect(await authRow(alive.user.id)).toMatchObject({ email: alive.email, purgedAt: null, deletedAt: null });
    expect(await authRepo.findUserById(alive.user.id)).toBeDefined();
  });

  test("3f: with an address held for a report, the deletion takes everything down at once but the address: the credentials go in the purge's first statement, the address and purged_at wait, the mail gains the hold's paragraph, and the next round after the hold is released overwrites the address", async () => {
    const owner = await account();
    const userId = owner.user.id;
    await authRepo.setPhoneHash(userId, randomBytes(16).toString("hex"));
    // 3f's review (proofs9): two-factor on, so that the check below of the secret and the codes proves their clearing.
    await authRepo.enableTotp(userId, { secretEnc: "v1:held-account", recoveryCodesHash: ["code-a", "code-b"], now: new Date() });
    expect(await authRow(userId)).toMatchObject({ totpSecretEnc: "v1:held-account", recoveryCodesHash: ["code-a", "code-b"] });
    // A seal taken while deciding holds the account's record: its hold, as report_open sets it, written as the migrator.
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into auth.report_holds (user_id, set_at, seal_final) values (${userId}::uuid, now(), false)`);
    try {
      const { flowId } = await startDeletion(deps(), owner.session, h.ctx);
      await confirmDeletion(deps(), owner.session, { flowId, code: h.mailer.lastCodeFor(owner.email)!, handle: owner.handle });
      // Everything but the address went at once: the credentials and personal facts, the profile, the sessions.
      const held = (await authRow(userId))!;
      expect(held).toMatchObject({ email: owner.email, purgedAt: null, passwordHash: null, totpSecretEnc: null, totpEnabledAt: null, phoneHash: null, recoveryCodesHash: [], ageConfirmedAt: null, termsVersion: null, termsAcceptedAt: null });
      expect(held.deletedAt).not.toBeNull();
      expect(await s.repo.findProfileByHandle(owner.handle)).toBeNull();
      // The mail: the one wording for every account, and the paragraph of the seal taken while deciding, with its day.
      const mail = h.mailer.sent.filter((m) => m.to === owner.email && m.template === "account_deleted").at(-1)!;
      const [until] = await migrateDb.execute<{ day: string }>(sql`select to_char(auth.address_held_until(${userId}::uuid) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day`);
      expect(mail.data).toEqual({ heldUntil: until!.day, holdFinal: "false" });
      // The account stays pending, last, and each round counts it as held and changes nothing.
      const first = await purgePending(deps());
      expect(first.held).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      expect(await authRow(userId)).toMatchObject({ email: owner.email, purgedAt: null });
      const pending = await authRepo.pendingPurges();
      expect(pending.at(-1)).toBe(userId);
      // The record is sent: the hold is released, and the next round overwrites the address.
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`update auth.report_holds set released_at = now(), release_reason = 'sent' where user_id = ${userId}::uuid`);
      await purgePending(deps());
      expect(await authRow(userId)).toMatchObject({ email: `deleted:${userId}`, emailVerifiedAt: null });
      expect((await authRow(userId))!.purgedAt).not.toBeNull();
    } finally {
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from auth.report_holds where user_id = ${userId}::uuid`);
    }
  });

  test("3f: a hold older than reportHoldDays reads as not held, and REPORT_HOLD off purges a held address at once, as 1b did", async () => {
    const aged = await account();
    const off = await account();
    for (const user of [aged, off]) {
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into auth.report_holds (user_id, set_at, seal_final) values (${user.user.id}::uuid, now(), true)`);
      await authRepo.markDeleted(user.user.id, new Date(Date.now() - 60_000));
    }
    try {
      expect(await authRepo.finishPurge(aged.user.id, new Date())).toBe("held");
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`update auth.report_holds set set_at = set_at - make_interval(days => ${ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays}, secs => 1) where user_id = ${aged.user.id}::uuid`);
      expect(await authRepo.finishPurge(aged.user.id, new Date())).toBe("purged");
      expect(await authRepo.finishPurge(off.user.id, new Date(), false)).toBe("purged");
      expect(await authRow(off.user.id)).toMatchObject({ email: `deleted:${off.user.id}` });
      expect(await authRepo.finishPurge(off.user.id, new Date())).toBe("none");
    } finally {
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from auth.report_holds where user_id = any(${`{${aged.user.id},${off.user.id}}`}::uuid[])`);
    }
  });
});

import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ALERT_KINDS, ORDER_RULES, renderAlert, type AlertFacts } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import type { StaffMessage } from "../../src/auth";
import { alertMailLeg, alertTick, channelHealth, staffAlert } from "../../src/moderation/alerts";
import { overview } from "../../src/moderation/cases";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { ageMessageForTest, closeNotifyFixtures, contactMessageForTest, nextValidity, outboxOf, outboxSince, removeMessages, type OutboxRow } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { newStaffKey, newStaffSession, rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 60_000 });

const MIN = 60_000;

/**
 * The alert channel's time-driven alerts and its two legs (3f design, sections 6.1, 7.2 and 12.1; invariants 14 and 15):
 * alert_steps() writes an escalation at escalate_minutes and the deadline's two reminders, each once, and stops them when
 * the message is handled; a person already at work in the console is not absent; the daily test is written once a day.
 * The alert tick mails every row whose mail is its sentence once, never one of 3c's or 3e's kinds, and with NOTIFY on
 * judges the channel's health with its own alarms, once in 24 hours. staffAlert writes the row of every kind of 3c and
 * 3e and marks it mailed either way.
 *
 * The steps run inside transactions of the migrator that end in a rollback: there the test sets the times it needs and
 * pushes every staff session back a day, so that the sessions earlier files of the run opened do not count as someone at
 * work. The tick commits, as the server's does; its rows and messages are removed by id, and the file's last test holds
 * it to leaving no row behind.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the alert steps and the alert tick", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let staffEmail: string;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const made: string[] = [];
  const started = new Date();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, CHANNEL_TABLES);
    // A live staff account with a key and a session: the address the staff mails of this file go to, and a session a
    // test can mark as used.
    const staff = await newStaffKey(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    staffEmail = staff.user.email;
    await newStaffSession(w.authDb, staff.user.id, staff.key.id);
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_state`);
  }, 60_000);
  afterEach(async () => {
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_state`);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  /** A message inside the migrator's transaction, received `minutes` ago: the migrator keeps the time it supplies. */
  const messageIn = async (tx: DbTx, minutes: number, extra: { stale?: boolean } = {}) => {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.contact_messages (folder, uidvalidity, uid, received_at, seen_at, stale)
      values ('inbox', ${nextValidity()}, 1, now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), ${extra.stale ?? false}) returning id`);
    return row!.id;
  };
  /** Every staff session pushed a day back, its lifetime with it: nobody is at work in the console. */
  const nobodyAtWork = (tx: DbTx) =>
    tx.execute(sql`update auth.staff_sessions set created_at = created_at - interval '1 day', last_used_at = last_used_at - interval '1 day', idle_expires_at = idle_expires_at - interval '1 day', absolute_expires_at = absolute_expires_at - interval '1 day'`);
  const steps = async (tx: DbTx) => Number((await tx.execute<{ written: number }>(sql`select public.alert_steps() as written`))[0]!.written);
  const kinds = (rows: OutboxRow[]) => rows.map((r) => [r.kind, r.step]);

  test("an unanswered message is escalated to every phone once, escalate_minutes after it arrived, and not before", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const early = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.escalateMinutes - 1);
      const due = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.escalateMinutes + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(kinds((await outboxOf(tx, early)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated"))).toEqual([]);
      const escalated = (await outboxOf(tx, due)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated");
      expect(kinds(escalated)).toEqual([["contact_mail_escalated", 0]]);
      expect([escalated[0]!.priority, escalated[0]!.scope]).toEqual([5, "all"]);
      expect(Object.keys(escalated[0]!.facts).sort()).toEqual(["dueAt", "receivedAt"]);
      // Once a message: a second call writes nothing for it.
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await outboxOf(tx, due)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated")).toHaveLength(1);
    });
  });

  test("a person already signed in who acts in the console is not absent: a staff session created or used since the message arrived stops the escalation", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const [session] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from auth.staff_sessions limit 1`);
      expect(session, "a staff session of this run").toBeDefined();
      await tx.execute(sql`update auth.staff_sessions set last_used_at = now() where id = ${session!.id}`);
      const due = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.escalateMinutes + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await outboxOf(tx, due)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated")).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  test("order_due for a message: one row at remind_minutes and one at the deadline, each once, with the deadline and the minutes left", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const early = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes - 1);
      const reminded = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1);
      const late = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      const due = async (id: string) => (await outboxOf(tx, id)).filter((r) => r.kind === "order_due");
      expect(await due(early)).toEqual([]);
      const [first] = await due(reminded);
      expect([first!.step, first!.priority, first!.scope]).toEqual([0, 5, "all"]);
      expect(first!.facts.minutesLeft).toBe(ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes - 1);
      expect(renderAlert("order_due", first!.facts, new Date()).title).toBe(`${first!.facts.minutesLeft} minutes left`);
      // Past the deadline only the deadline's row: the later of the two that has passed.
      expect((await due(late)).map((r) => [r.step, r.facts.minutesLeft])).toEqual([[0, 0]]);
      // Each once: a second call writes nothing; the deadline's row comes when the deadline passes.
      await steps(tx);
      expect(await due(reminded)).toHaveLength(1);
      await ageMessageForTest(tx, reminded, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await due(reminded)).map((r) => [r.step, r.facts.minutesLeft])).toEqual([
        [0, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes - 1],
        [1, 0],
      ]);
    });
  });

  test("handling a message ends its steps, and a stale message never has any", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const handled = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.contact_messages set disposition = 'referral', handled_at = now() where id = ${handled}::uuid`);
      const stale = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1, { stale: true });
      await steps(tx);
      // The handled message keeps the first push its insert wrote, and gets nothing more.
      expect(kinds(await outboxOf(tx, handled))).toEqual([["contact_mail", 0]]);
      expect(await outboxOf(tx, stale)).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  test("the daily test is written once in 24 hours, pushed only", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'alert_test'`);
      const at = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
      await steps(tx);
      const [test] = await outboxSince(tx, "alert_test", at);
      expect([test!.priority, test!.scope, test!.step, Object.keys(test!.facts)]).toEqual([3, "all", 0, ["at"]]);
      expect(ALERT_KINDS.alert_test.legs).toEqual(["push"]);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(await outboxSince(tx, "alert_test", at)).toHaveLength(1);
      // A day later the next one, with the next step.
      // The transaction's own clock stands still: the row moves back a day and a minute.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - interval '1 day 1 minute' where kind = 'alert_test'`);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await tx.execute<{ step: number }>(sql`select step from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'alert_test' order by step`)).map((r) => r.step)).toEqual([0, 1]);
    });
  });

  test("two calls at once write a step once: the unique key drops the second", async () => {
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date());
    made.push(id);
    await ageMessageForTest(w.migrateDb, id, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1);
    await Promise.all([w.apiDb.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`), w.apiDb.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`)]);
    expect((await outboxOf(w.migrateDb, id)).filter((r) => r.kind === "order_due")).toHaveLength(1);

  /** One round of each of the two jobs, the tick and (a job of its own since 3f's review) its mail leg: the tick's report. */
  const round = async (notify: "on" | "off") => {

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3f, Task 2: an order's steps (section 6.1, the rows marked 0025)

  /** A removal order of the migrator's in the transaction, received `minutes` ago, with an item open or disabled. */
  async function orderIn(tx: DbTx, minutes: number, options: { disabled?: boolean; open?: boolean; kind?: string; verified?: boolean; reasons?: boolean } = {}): Promise<string> {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, received_at, opened_at, opened_via,
                                       verified_at, reasons)
      values (gen_random_uuid(), ${options.kind ?? "tco_removal"}, 'DE', 'BKA', ${`S-${randomUUID()}`}, 'portal', false, false, false, true,
              now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), 'cli',
              ${options.verified ? sql`now()` : sql`null`}, ${options.reasons ? "the authority's reasons" : null})
      returning id`);
    if (options.open ?? true) await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_items (order_id, position, link) values (${row!.id}::uuid, 1, 'https://elsewhere.example/open')`);
    if (options.disabled) {
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_items (order_id, position, link, added_at, disabled_at) values (${row!.id}::uuid, 2, 'https://elsewhere.example/done', now() - make_interval(hours => 2), now() - make_interval(mins => 1))`);
    }
    return row!.id;
  }
  const orderRows = async (tx: DbTx, orderId: string) =>
    (await tx.execute<{ kind: string; step: number; scope: string; priority: number; facts: Record<string, unknown> }>(
      sql`select kind, step, scope, priority, facts from public.alert_outbox where order_id = ${orderId}::uuid order by id`,
    )).map((r) => ({ ...r }));
  const restart = (tx: DbTx, orderId: string, annexMinutes: number, clarifiedMinutes: number) =>
    tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, at, via) values
                     (${orderId}::uuid, 'annex3_sent', 'manifest_error', now() - make_interval(mins => ${annexMinutes}), 'cli'),
                     (${orderId}::uuid, 'clarification_received', null, now() - make_interval(mins => ${clarifiedMinutes}), 'cli')`);

  test("order_due for an order: at remind_minutes and at the deadline while an item is open, the clock runs and the order is not closed; never for one given effect in full, stopped or closed", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const remind = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1);
      const late = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      const partial = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1, { disabled: true });
      const full = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1, { disabled: true, open: false });
      const stopped = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, at, via) values (${stopped}::uuid, 'annex3_sent', 'force_majeure', now() - make_interval(mins => 30), 'cli')`);
      const closed = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set closed_at = now() where id = ${closed}::uuid`);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const due = (rows: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof orderRows>>) => rows.filter((r) => r.kind === "order_due").map((r) => [r.step, r.facts.itemsOpen, r.scope, r.priority]);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, remind))).toEqual([[0, 1, "all", 5]]);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, late))).toEqual([[0, 1, "all", 5]]);
      expect((await orderRows(tx, late))[0]!.facts.minutesLeft).toBe(0);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, partial))).toEqual([[0, 1, "all", 5]]);
      for (const none of [full, stopped, closed]) expect(due(await orderRows(tx, none))).toEqual([]);
      // The deadline passes for the order reminded at remind_minutes: the second reminder, once.
      // The order and its first reminder an hour further back, as the hour would have passed.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set received_at = received_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes}), opened_at = opened_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes}) where id = ${remind}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes}) where order_id = ${remind}::uuid`);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, remind))).toEqual([
        [0, 1, "all", 5],
        [1, 1, "all", 5],
      ]);
    });
  });

  test("a restart of an order's clock rings the phone on call again, as a message's first push, once a restart; a second restart alerts again", async () => {

      // The first restart's row was written when it came, nine minutes before the second.

      await restart(tx, order, 5, 1);

      expect((await orderRows(tx, order)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail").map((r) => r.step)).toEqual([0, 1]);
      // A stopped clock does not ring.

    });

      const stored = (await row(id))!;
      const keys = [h.deps.config.notifierKey];
      expect(decrypt(stored.name_enc!, keys).toString("utf8")).toBe("Ada Lovelace");
      // The address is kept as the mails need it: trimmed, in lower case.
      expect(decrypt(stored.email_enc!, keys).toString("utf8")).toBe(address);
      expect(decrypt(stored.mail_token_enc!, keys).toString("utf8")).toMatch(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/);
      expect(stored.email_hash).toBe(emailHash(h.deps.config.authHmacKey, address));
      for (const column of ["name_enc", "email_enc", "mail_token_enc"]) expect(stored[column], column).toMatch(/^v1:[A-Za-z0-9+/]+=*$/);
      // Nothing of it stands in the row as it was typed.
      expect(JSON.stringify(stored)).not.toMatch(/Ada|notifier-/i);
      const forgetAfter = await forgetAfterOf(id);
      const thirteenMonths = new Date(h.clock.now());
      thirteenMonths.setUTCMonth(thirteenMonths.getUTCMonth() + 13);
      // A month's end may clamp the day: within three days of the same day 13 months on.
      expect(Math.abs(forgetAfter - thirteenMonths.getTime())).toBeLessThanOrEqual(3 * DAY);
    });

    test("a contact with a name alone has no address, no hash and no mail token; one with an address alone no name; a disposable address is taken", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const named = await contact(h, { name: "Ada", email: undefined });
      expect(await row(named.id)).toMatchObject({ email_enc: null, email_hash: null, mail_token_enc: null });
      const addressed = await contact(h);
      expect((await row(addressed.id))!.name_enc).toBeNull();
      const disposable = `x-${randomUUID()}@mailinator.com`;
      addresses.push(disposable);
      const thrown = await contact(h, { email: disposable });
      expect(decrypt((await row(thrown.id))!.email_enc!, [h.deps.config.notifierKey]).toString("utf8")).toBe(disposable);
    });

    test("every read decrypts with the key or one it replaced, and writes nothing back", async () => {
      const old = flowHarness(repo);
      const { id, email } = await contact(old, { name: "Ada" });
      const stored = await row(id);
      // The key was rotated: the old one is now among the previous keys.
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      h.deps.config.notifierKey = parseVersionedKey(`v2:${Buffer.alloc(32, 8).toString("base64")}`);
      h.deps.config.notifierPreviousKeys = [old.deps.config.notifierKey];
      expect(await notifierName(h.deps, id)).toBe("Ada");
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      expect(await notifierMailTokenMatches(h.deps, id, tokenSentTo(h, email!))).toBe(true);
      expect(await findNotifierContacts(h.deps, email!)).toEqual([{ id, name: "Ada" }]);
      expect(await row(id)).toEqual(stored);
      // A contact stored now is encrypted under the new key.
      const fresh = await contact(h, { name: "Bob" });
      expect((await row(fresh.id))!.name_enc).toMatch(/^v2:/);
    });
  });

  describe("mailNotifier: a signed-out notifier's receipt", () => {
    test("sends notice_received to the contact's address with the page link, whose fragment is the contact's mail token, and the terms link", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const { id, email } = await contact(h);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt("N-QRSTUVWX45"))).toBe("sent");
      expect(h.mailer.sent).toHaveLength(1);
      const sent = h.mailer.sent[0]!;
      expect(sent).toMatchObject({ to: email, template: "notice_received" });
      expect(sent.data).toEqual({
        ref: "N-QRSTUVWX45",
        time: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC",
        items: "http://localhost:8081/post/0190f3a2-7c1e-7b1a-9f00-0123456789ab, http://localhost:8081/u/ada",
        pageUrl: `http://localhost:8081/notice/N-QRSTUVWX45#t=${tokenSentTo(h, email!)}`,
        termsUrl: "http://localhost:8081/terms",
      });
      expect(tokenSentTo(h, email!)).toBe(decrypt((await row(id))!.mail_token_enc!, [h.deps.config.notifierKey]).toString("utf8"));
    });

    test("forgotten for an id no contact has, no_address for a contact without an address; neither sends anything", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, randomUUID(), receipt())).toBe("forgotten");
      const named = await contact(h, { name: "Ada", email: undefined });
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, named.id, receipt())).toBe("no_address");
      expect(h.mailer.sent).toHaveLength(0);
    });

    test("an unconfirmed address gets one receipt in 24 hours: the next is folded, whichever contact names the address, and the one after the day is sent", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const first = await contact(h);
      const second = await contact(h, { email: first.email!.toUpperCase() });
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, first.id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, second.id, receipt())).toBe("folded");
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, first.id, receipt())).toBe("folded");
      // Another address has a day of its own.
      const other = await contact(h);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, other.id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      h.clock.advance(DAY - 1000);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, second.id, receipt())).toBe("folded");
      h.clock.advance(2000);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, second.id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      expect(h.mailer.sent.filter((m) => m.to === first.email)).toHaveLength(2);
    });

    test("a confirmed address has no cap for the 30 days of its confirmation; a stopped one gets nothing until a confirmation lifts the stop", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const { id, email } = await contact(h);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      const token = tokenSentTo(h, email!);
      expect(await confirmNotifier(h.deps, id, token)).toBe(true);
      for (let n = 0; n < 3; n++) expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      // The confirmation runs out after 30 days: the cap is back.
      h.clock.advance(30 * DAY + 1000);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("folded");

      expect(await stopNotifier(h.deps, id, token)).toBe(true);
      h.clock.advance(2 * DAY);
      const sentBefore = h.mailer.sent.length;
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("suppressed");
      // Another contact of the same address is stopped with it.
      const again = await contact(h, { email });
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, again.id, receipt())).toBe("suppressed");
      expect(h.mailer.sent).toHaveLength(sentBefore);
      expect(await confirmNotifier(h.deps, id, token)).toBe(true);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
    });

    test("refused when the relay says the address is bad; any other failure is thrown, leaves the day's one receipt unspent, and the retry carries the same page link", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const { id, email } = await contact(h);
      const failing = withMailer(h, async () => {
        throw new MailUnavailable("relay down");
      });
      await expect(mailNotifier(failing, id, receipt())).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(MailUnavailable);
      await expect(mailNotifier(failing, id, receipt())).rejects.not.toBeInstanceOf(MailRefused);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      const link = h.mailer.sent[0]!.data.pageUrl;
      h.clock.advance(DAY + 1000);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      expect(h.mailer.sent[1]!.data.pageUrl).toBe(link);

      const bad = await contact(h);
      const refusing = withMailer(h, async () => {
        throw new MailRefused("no such mailbox");
      });
      expect(await mailNotifier(refusing, bad.id, receipt())).toBe("refused");
      expect(h.mailer.sent.filter((m) => m.to === bad.email)).toHaveLength(0);
      expect(email).not.toBe(bad.email);
    });
  });

    test("no_address for a deleted account and for one that never was; refused and unavailable as for a notifier", async () => {

      expect(h.mailer.sent).toHaveLength(0);
      const { id } = await account(h);
      expect(
        await mailAccount(

  describe("the statement and the daily update, to an account", () => {

      // The address asked korbat to stop its report mails: a statement of reasons is no report mail.

      expect(await mailAccount(h.deps, id, { template: "notice_update", lines })).toBe("sent");
      expect(h.mailer.updates).toEqual([{ to: email, template: "notice_update", data: { signedIn: true, lines, receipts: [], pages: [] } }]);
      const signedOut = await contact(h, { email });

  describe("mailNotifierUpdates: one update for each address", () => {
    const app = "http://localhost:8081";
    const pageOf = (h: FlowHarness, to: string, ref: string) => h.mailer.updates.findLast((m) => m.to === to)!.data.pages.find((page) => page.ref === ref)?.pageUrl;

    test("two notices that gave one address make one update: every line, and the page of each notice with that contact's own mail token; another address gets its own", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const first = await contact(h);
      const second = await contact(h, { email: first.email });
      const other = await contact(h);
      // The receipts' links carry each contact's mail token: the update's pages must be the same links.
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, first.id, receipt("N-AAAAAAAA22"))).toBe("sent");
      const firstLink = h.mailer.sent.at(-1)!.data.pageUrl;
      h.clock.advance(DAY + 1000);
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, second.id, receipt("N-BBBBBBBB33"))).toBe("sent");
      const secondLink = h.mailer.sent.at(-1)!.data.pageUrl;
      expect(firstLink).not.toBe(secondLink);
      const results = await mailNotifierUpdates(h.deps, [
        { contactId: first.id, ref: "N-AAAAAAAA22", lines: [line("N-AAAAAAAA22", 1), line("N-AAAAAAAA22", 2)] },
        { contactId: second.id, ref: "N-BBBBBBBB33", lines: [line("N-BBBBBBBB33", 1)] },
        { contactId: other.id, ref: "N-CCCCCCCC44", lines: [line("N-CCCCCCCC44", 1)] },
      ]);
      expect([...results]).toEqual([
        [first.id, "sent"],
        [second.id, "sent"],
        [other.id, "sent"],
      ]);
      expect(h.mailer.updates).toHaveLength(2);
      const shared = h.mailer.updates.find((m) => m.to === first.email)!;
      expect(shared.data.signedIn).toBe(false);
      expect(shared.data.lines.map((each) => `${each.ref} ${each.item}`)).toEqual(["N-AAAAAAAA22 1", "N-AAAAAAAA22 2", "N-BBBBBBBB33 1"]);
      expect(shared.data.pages).toEqual([
        { ref: "N-AAAAAAAA22", pageUrl: firstLink },
        { ref: "N-BBBBBBBB33", pageUrl: secondLink },
      ]);
      expect(shared.data.receipts).toEqual([]);
      expect(pageOf(h, other.email!, "N-CCCCCCCC44")).toMatch(new RegExp(`^${app}/notice/N-CCCCCCCC44#t=[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$`));
      // Neither a confirmation nor the day's cap holds an update back: a second one goes the same day, to an address nobody confirmed.
      expect([...(await mailNotifierUpdates(h.deps, [{ contactId: other.id, ref: "N-CCCCCCCC44", lines: [line("N-CCCCCCCC44", 1)] }]))]).toEqual([[other.id, "sent"]]);
    });

    test("a folded receipt rides in the update with its page link and the terms' address, and its notice gets no second page; a receipt alone makes an update of receipts", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const first = await contact(h);
      const folded = await contact(h, { email: first.email });
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, first.id, receipt("N-AAAAAAAA22"))).toBe("sent");
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, folded.id, receipt("N-BBBBBBBB33"))).toBe("folded");
      const carried = { ref: "N-BBBBBBBB33", receivedAt: new Date("2026-10-04T06:59:59.123Z"), items: ["http://localhost:8081/u/ada"] };
      const results = await mailNotifierUpdates(h.deps, [
        { contactId: first.id, ref: "N-AAAAAAAA22", lines: [line("N-AAAAAAAA22", 1)] },
        { contactId: folded.id, ref: "N-BBBBBBBB33", lines: [line("N-BBBBBBBB33", 1)], receipt: carried },
      ]);
      expect([...results.values()]).toEqual(["sent", "sent"]);
      const update = h.mailer.updates.at(-1)!.data;
      expect(update.receipts).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(update.receipts[0]).toMatchObject({ ref: "N-BBBBBBBB33", time: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", items: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada" });
      expect(update.receipts[0]!.pageUrl).toMatch(new RegExp(`^${app}/notice/N-BBBBBBBB33#t=[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$`));
      // The carried receipt's notice has its page with the receipt; only the other notice gets a page paragraph.
      expect(update.pages.map((page) => page.ref)).toEqual(["N-AAAAAAAA22"]);
      expect(update.termsUrl).toBe(`${app}/terms`);
      // A contact that is owed nothing but its folded receipt: an update of receipts alone.
      const alone = await contact(h);
      expect([...(await mailNotifierUpdates(h.deps, [{ contactId: alone.id, ref: "N-DDDDDDDD55", lines: [], receipt: { ...carried, ref: "N-DDDDDDDD55" } }]))]).toEqual([[alone.id, "sent"]]);
      expect(h.mailer.updates.at(-1)!.data).toMatchObject({ lines: [], pages: [], receipts: [{ ref: "N-DDDDDDDD55" }] });
    });

    test("it answers for each contact: suppressed, no_address, forgotten, refused when the relay refuses the address, unavailable when it cannot take the mail", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const [stopped, nameOnly, fine, bad, down] = [await contact(h), await contact(h, { name: "Bob", email: undefined }), await contact(h), await contact(h), await contact(h)];
      expect(await mailNotifier(h.deps, stopped.id, receipt())).toBe("sent");
      expect(await stopNotifier(h.deps, stopped.id, tokenSentTo(h, stopped.email!))).toBe(true);
      const gone = randomUUID();
      const part = (contactId: string, ref: string) => ({ contactId, ref, lines: [line(ref, 1)] });
      const scripted = withMailer(h, async (message) => {
        if (message.to === bad.email) throw new MailRefused("no such mailbox");
        if (message.to === down.email) throw new MailUnavailable("relay down");
        await h.mailer.send(message);
      });
      const results = await mailNotifierUpdates(scripted, [part(stopped.id, "N-AAAAAAAA22"), part(nameOnly.id, "N-BBBBBBBB33"), part(gone, "N-CCCCCCCC44"), part(fine.id, "N-DDDDDDDD55"), part(bad.id, "N-EEEEEEEE66"), part(down.id, "N-FFFFFFFF77")]);
      expect(Object.fromEntries(results)).toEqual({ [stopped.id]: "suppressed", [nameOnly.id]: "no_address", [gone]: "forgotten", [fine.id]: "sent", [bad.id]: "refused", [down.id]: "unavailable" });
      // Nothing was thrown though one address could not be mailed, and only the one that could was.
      expect(h.mailer.updates.map((m) => m.to)).toEqual([fine.email]);
    });

    test("a contact it cannot read is answered unavailable and logged with its id, never an address, while every other address's update is still sent", async () => {
      const old = flowHarness(repo);
      const unreadable = await contact(old);
      // The key was rotated without keeping the old one: what the old key encrypted no configured key opens.
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      h.deps.config.notifierKey = parseVersionedKey(`v2:${Buffer.alloc(32, 9).toString("base64")}`);
      h.deps.config.notifierPreviousKeys = [];
      const readable = await contact(h);
      const logged: unknown[] = [];
      const deps: AuthDeps = { ...h.deps, log: { ...h.deps.log, error: (...args: unknown[]) => void logged.push(args) } as AuthDeps["log"] };
      const results = await mailNotifierUpdates(deps, [
        { contactId: unreadable.id, ref: "N-AAAAAAAA22", lines: [line("N-AAAAAAAA22", 1)] },
        { contactId: readable.id, ref: "N-BBBBBBBB33", lines: [line("N-BBBBBBBB33", 1)] },
      ]);
      expect(Object.fromEntries(results)).toEqual({ [unreadable.id]: "unavailable", [readable.id]: "sent" });
      expect(h.mailer.updates.map((m) => m.to)).toEqual([readable.email]);
      expect(logged).toHaveLength(1);
      const text = JSON.stringify(logged[0], (_key, value: unknown) => (value instanceof Error ? value.message : value));
      expect(text).toContain(unreadable.id);
      expect(text).not.toContain(unreadable.email!);
    });
  });

  describe("mailStaff: an alert to every live staff account", () => {

    test("the alerts of deciding and of the dispatch hand the templates their data as text: a burst, a decision that lifted the protection of reported images, and cases that wait", async () => {

      expect(dataOf()).toMatchObject({ template: "moderation_csam_lifted", data: { handle: "mod_anna", time: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", what: "dismissed" } });
      // A lane's pair is there only for a lane with a case past its time, and the measures' count only when it is not 0.
      await mailStaff(h.deps, { template: "moderation_waiting", lanes: [{ lane: 0, count: 2, oldest: at }, { lane: 2, count: 1, oldest: at }], interim: 0, phones: true });
      expect(dataOf().data).toEqual({ phones: "on", lane0Count: "2", lane0Oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", lane2Count: "1", lane2Oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC" });
      // 3f's review (people4): with the phone alerts off the mail says so.

      expect(dataOf().data).toEqual({ phones: "off", interimCount: "3" });

    test("is best effort: a relay that takes no mail gives 0 and nothing is thrown; one that takes some gives their number", async () => {

      expect(

    test("notifierFacts: whether a name and an address were given, and whether the address is confirmed or stopped; an id without a row is not found", async () => {

      const missing = randomUUID();
      const none = { found: false, named: false, contactGiven: false, confirmed: false, suppressed: false };
      let facts = await notifierFacts(h.deps, [both.id, named.id, addressed.id, missing]);
      expect(Object.fromEntries(facts)).toEqual({
        [both.id]: { found: true, named: true, contactGiven: true, confirmed: false, suppressed: false },
        [named.id]: { found: true, named: true, contactGiven: false, confirmed: false, suppressed: false },
        [addressed.id]: { found: true, named: false, contactGiven: true, confirmed: false, suppressed: false },
        [missing]: none,
      });

      await mailNotifier(h.deps, addressed.id, receipt());

      facts = await notifierFacts(h.deps, [both.id, addressed.id]);
      expect(facts.get(both.id)).toMatchObject({ confirmed: true, suppressed: false });
      expect(facts.get(addressed.id)).toMatchObject({ confirmed: false, suppressed: true });

      expect(await notifierFacts(h.deps, [])).toEqual(new Map());

      expect(await notifierName(h.deps, named.id)).toBe("Ada Lovelace");
      expect(await notifierName(h.deps, unnamed.id)).toBeNull();
      expect(await notifierName(h.deps, randomUUID())).toBeNull();
    });

    test("only the contact's own mail token matches, confirms or stops: not another contact's, not a guess, and nothing for a contact without an address", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const [mine, other, named] = [await contact(h), await contact(h), await contact(h, { name: "Ada", email: undefined })];
      await mailNotifier(h.deps, mine.id, receipt());
      await mailNotifier(h.deps, other.id, receipt());
      const [token, othersToken] = [tokenSentTo(h, mine.email!), tokenSentTo(h, other.email!)];
      expect(token).not.toBe(othersToken);
      expect(await notifierMailTokenMatches(h.deps, mine.id, token)).toBe(true);
      for (const wrong of [othersToken, "A".repeat(43), "", token.slice(0, 42)]) {
        expect(await notifierMailTokenMatches(h.deps, mine.id, wrong), wrong).toBe(false);
        expect(await confirmNotifier(h.deps, mine.id, wrong), wrong).toBe(false);
        expect(await stopNotifier(h.deps, mine.id, wrong), wrong).toBe(false);
      }
      for (const id of [named.id, randomUUID()]) {
        expect(await notifierMailTokenMatches(h.deps, id, token)).toBe(false);
        expect(await confirmNotifier(h.deps, id, token)).toBe(false);
        expect(await stopNotifier(h.deps, id, token)).toBe(false);
      }
      // Nothing was confirmed or stopped by any of it.
      expect((await notifierFacts(h.deps, [mine.id])).get(mine.id)).toMatchObject({ confirmed: false, suppressed: false });
      // Stopping twice, and confirming twice, is each done once.
      expect(await stopNotifier(h.deps, mine.id, token)).toBe(true);
      expect(await stopNotifier(h.deps, mine.id, token)).toBe(true);
      expect(await confirmNotifier(h.deps, mine.id, token)).toBe(true);
      expect(await confirmNotifier(h.deps, mine.id, token)).toBe(true);
      expect((await notifierFacts(h.deps, [mine.id])).get(mine.id)).toMatchObject({ confirmed: true, suppressed: false });
    });
  });

  describe("forgetting", () => {
    test("forgetNotifierAfter moves the day a contact is forgotten, and no other column of it can be written", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);

      const untouched = await forgetAfterOf(kept.id);
      const at = new Date("2027-04-04T07:00:00.000Z");
      await forgetNotifierAfter(h.deps, [one.id, two.id, randomUUID()], at);
      await forgetNotifierAfter(h.deps, [], at);
      for (const id of [one.id, two.id]) expect(await forgetAfterOf(id)).toBe(at.getTime());
      expect(await forgetAfterOf(kept.id)).toBe(untouched);
      const failure = await db.execute(sql`update auth.notifier_contacts set email_hash = 'x' where id = ${one.id}::uuid`).then(() => null, (err: unknown) => err);
      expect(String((failure as { cause?: unknown } | null)?.cause)).toMatch(/permission denied/);
    });

    test("findNotifierContacts answers the contacts of an address, however it is written, with their names; overdueContacts counts what the janitor should have taken a day ago", async () => {
      const h = flowHarness(repo);
      const first = await contact(h, { name: "Ada" });
      const second = await contact(h, { email: first.email });
      const found = await findNotifierContacts(h.deps, ` ${first.email!.toUpperCase()} `);
      expect(found).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(found).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([{ id: first.id, name: "Ada" }, { id: second.id, name: null }]));
      expect(await findNotifierContacts(h.deps, newTestEmail("nobody"))).toEqual([]);

      const overdue = await overdueContacts(h.deps);
      // A contact due an hour ago is not overdue yet; one due two days ago is, and so is a confirmation that ran out two days ago.
      await forgetNotifierAfter(h.deps, [first.id], new Date(h.clock.ms() - HOUR));
      expect(await overdueContacts(h.deps)).toBe(overdue);
      await forgetNotifierAfter(h.deps, [second.id], new Date(h.clock.ms() - 2 * DAY));
      expect(await overdueContacts(h.deps)).toBe(overdue + 1);
      // A confirmation made now is not overdue; one made 32 days ago ran out two days ago, and is.
      await mailNotifier(h.deps, first.id, receipt());
      await confirmNotifier(h.deps, first.id, tokenSentTo(h, first.email!));
      expect(await overdueContacts(h.deps)).toBe(overdue + 1);
      const past = flowHarness(repo);
      past.clock.advance(-32 * DAY);
      const old = await contact(past);
      await mailNotifier(past.deps, old.id, receipt());
      await confirmNotifier(past.deps, old.id, tokenSentTo(past, old.email!));
      expect(await overdueContacts(h.deps)).toBe(overdue + 2);
    });
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the four auth tables of moderation cases and the moderation tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    const hashes = addresses.map((address) => emailHash(flowHarness(repo).deps.config.authHmacKey, address));
    if (contactIds.length > 0) await db.execute(sql`delete from auth.notifier_contacts where id = any(${`{${contactIds.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
    if (hashes.length > 0) {
      await db.execute(sql`delete from auth.notifier_confirmations where email_hash = any(${`{${hashes.join(",")}}`}::text[])`);
      await db.execute(sql`delete from auth.notifier_suppressions where email_hash = any(${`{${hashes.join(",")}}`}::text[])`);
    }
    expect(await counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});

import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

 * a figure the rows can no longer give. The fixture years lie eleven and twelve years back, where nothing else in the
 * test database stands: every order, event, decision, production and audit row of a fixture is written now and moved
 * back as the migrator, inside a transaction that is rolled back, and the counts are read inside it. A count by hand of
 * what each fixture made is what the command must print.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: staff.js tco-counts, the yearly counts", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;

  let admin: TestStaff;

  let recordsBefore: Record<string, number>;
  const log = pino({ level: "silent" });
  const YEAR = new Date().getUTCFullYear() - 11;
  const EARLIER = YEAR - 1;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    moderator = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "admin");
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, moderator);
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, admin);
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
    recordsBefore = await recordCounts(w.migrateDb);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, [moderator.id, admin.id]);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  /** The minutes from now back to the middle of a year, by which a fixture's rows are moved into it. */
  const backTo = (year: number): number => Math.round((Date.now() - Date.UTC(year, 5, 15, 12)) / 60_000);
  const sameYear = (year: number) => sql`make_interval(mins => ${backTo(year)})`;

  /** An order opened on posts of new authors, and "Disable for an order" on the first `effectOn` of its items. */
  async function effected(tx: DbTx, options: { posts: number; effectOn?: number; memberState?: "DE" | "FR" }): Promise<OrderView> {
    const posts: string[] = [];
    for (let n = 0; n < options.posts; n++) posts.push((await imagePost(tx, 1)).postId);
    const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts, memberState: options.memberState ?? "DE" });
    const chosen = order.items.slice(0, options.effectOn ?? order.items.length).map((item) => item.id);
    return effectWith(tx, moderator, order.id, effectParams(order, { itemIds: chosen }));
  }
  /** Records the order's receipt so many minutes before its last disabling, as the mail host's delivery time would be. */

  /** An event the command line or the console writes, as the migrator writes it with the clock's time. */

  }

      await tx.execute(sql`update public.audit_log set created_at = created_at - ${sameYear(YEAR)} where action = 'order_opened' and target_id = ${g.id}`);
      const [opening] = await tx.execute<{ kind: string }>(sql`select metadata->>'kind' as kind from public.audit_log where action = 'order_opened' and target_id = ${g.id}`);
      expect(opening!.kind).toBe("dsa_art9");
      expect((await retentionRound({ apiDb: tx as unknown as Db, media: casesMedia(tx), log })).orderRecords).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      // The erasure's own row says what the order was when its records went.
      const [erasure] = await tx.execute<{ metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(
        sql`select metadata from public.audit_log where action = 'moderation_retention' and metadata->>'step' = 'order_records' and metadata->>'orderId' = ${g.id}`,
      );
      expect(erasure!.metadata).toMatchObject({ orderId: g.id, kind: "tco_removal", receivedAt: null });
      expect(new Date(String(erasure!.metadata.openedAt)).getUTCFullYear()).toBe(YEAR);
      const counts = await tcoCounts(tx, YEAR);
      expect([counts.received, counts.itemsDisabled, counts.reinstated]).toEqual([null, null, null]);
    });
    // H: an order with no opening row, as restore-import writes one again (it appends restore_imported alone); here its
    // opening row is made to name another order.
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const h = await effected(tx, { posts: 1 });
      await reinstate(tx, h, "withdrawn");
      await ageOrderForTest(tx, h.id, backTo(YEAR));
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.audit_log set target_id = ${randomUUID()} where action = 'order_opened' and target_id = ${h.id}`);
      expect((await retentionRound({ apiDb: tx as unknown as Db, media: casesMedia(tx), log })).orderRecords).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      const counts = await tcoCounts(tx, YEAR);
      expect([counts.received, counts.itemsDisabled, counts.minutes]).toEqual([null, null, null]);
    });
    // An erasure row written before the review names no kind: it counts for every year it could reach, and for no later one.
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      expect((await tcoCounts(tx, YEAR)).received).not.toBeNull();
      await appendAuditRow(tx, {
        actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID,
        action: "moderation_retention",
        targetType: null,
        targetId: null,
        requestId: null,
        metadata: { step: "order_records", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, orderId: randomUUID(), count: 3 },
      });
      // Written three years and a half after the middle of the year: its order's last row could lie in the year.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.audit_log set created_at = make_timestamptz(${YEAR + 3}::int, 12, 31, 0, 0, 0, 'UTC') where chain_seq = (select seq from public.audit_head where id = 1)`);
      expect((await tcoCounts(tx, YEAR)).received).toBeNull();
      expect((await tcoCounts(tx, YEAR + 1)).received).not.toBeNull();
    });
  });

  test("run as the command, as the migrator: a line a figure, each starting with its name; a year that has not begun is refused", async () => {
    const env = { DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE! };
    const run = async (args: string[]) => {
      const lines: string[] = [];
      const code = await runStaffCommand(args, env, { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) });
      return { code, lines };
    };
    const audits = (await w.migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.audit_log`))[0]!.n;
    // A year long before korbat: every figure is computed from rows, and none exists.
    const empty = await run(["tco-counts", String(YEAR - 5)]);
    expect(empty.code).toBe(0);
    expect(empty.lines).toEqual([
      "out tco-counts: removal orders received: 0 (from another Member State: 0)",
      "out tco-counts: items disabled following a removal order: 0",
      "out tco-counts: minutes from the clock's start to the disabling of an order's last item: none; outside the hour: 0; with an item still open: 0",
      "out tco-counts: Annex III sent, by ground: force_majeure 0, manifest_error 0, insufficient_information 0",
      "out tco-counts: scrutiny: requested 0; annulled 0; upheld 0",
      "out tco-counts: reinstated, by ground: withdrawn 0, annulled 0, scrutiny 0, not_authentic 0, wrong_item 0",
      "out tco-counts: access to preserved content by an authority: 0",
      "out tco-counts: restricted by korbat as terrorist content without an order: 0",
      "out tco-counts: referrals closed: 0",
    ]);
    const future = new Date().getUTCFullYear() + 1;
    expect(await run(["tco-counts", String(future)])).toEqual({ code: 1, lines: [`err tco-counts: the year ${future} has not begun; nothing changed`] });
    expect((await run(["tco-counts", "26"])).code).toBe(2);
    // It reads only: no audit row.
    expect((await w.migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.audit_log`))[0]!.n).toBe(audits);
  });

  test("leaves the orders', the channel's and the records' tables as it found them", async () => {
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, messages);
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
    expect(await recordCounts(w.migrateDb)).toEqual(recordsBefore);
  });
});

});

/**
 * The preservation's two commands (3f design, sections 7.11, 8.11 and 10.5; Task 4): order-preserve-extend moves an
 * item's preserve_until forward on an authority's or a court's request, never back, and is refused once the
 * preservation ended (not_preserved); its event preservation_extended names the item and its audit row order_recorded
 * holds the request's facts, the proceedings only as a digest. order-access prints the preserved snapshot's text, its
 * alt texts and the images' ids, sizes and creation times, never an image, and records the access as preserved_accessed
 * with the purpose and the counts; an access for an authority is a production (Task 5): the command takes the
 * authority's name and reference, opens a production of the instrument preserved_access and names it in the audit row.
 * The effect commits with a real key; the last test removes what the block made.

describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the preservation's commands", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  let appOrigin: string;
  const posts: string[] = [];
  const people: string[] = [];
  const started = new Date();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    appOrigin = loadConfig().APP_ORIGIN;
    w = noticesWorld();
    world = deciderWorld(w.apiDb);
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
    moderator = await world.staff("moderator");
  }, 90_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await closeDb(migrateDb);
    await world.close({ keepStaff: true });
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  async function cli(args: string[]) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const env = { DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, HOME_STATE: "DE", APP_ORIGIN: appOrigin };
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, env, { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) }, async () => Buffer.alloc(0));
    return { code, lines, text: lines.join(NEWLINE) };
  }
  /** A post with two images under a removal order given effect with the moderator's real key: its item. */
  async function preserved(): Promise<{ itemId: string; orderId: string; postId: string; mediaIds: string[] }> {
    const p = await imagePost(w.apiDb, 2);
    posts.push(p.postId);
    people.push(p.authorId);
    const order = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, moderator, { posts: [p.postId] });
    const outcome = await effectForTest(world, moderator, order.id, effectParams(order));
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the effect was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return { itemId: outcome.items[0]!.id, orderId: order.id, postId: p.postId, mediaIds: p.mediaIds };
  }
  const item = async (id: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ until: string; ended: string | null }>(
      sql`select to_char(preserve_until at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as until, preserve_ended_at::text as ended from public.legal_order_items where id = ${id}::uuid`,
    ))[0]!;
  const lastAudit = async (targetId: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ action: string; actor_id: string; target_type: string; metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(
      sql`select action, actor_id, target_type, metadata from public.audit_log where target_id = ${targetId} order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    ))[0]!;
  const digest = (text: string) => createHash("sha256").update(text, "utf8").digest("hex");

  test("the usage lists both commands", () => {
    for (const command of ["order-preserve-extend", "order-access"]) expect(STAFF_USAGE, command).toContain(`  ${command} `);
  });

  test("order-preserve-extend moves preserve_until forward, records the request, and is refused backwards, without a flag and once the preservation ended", async () => {
    const { itemId, orderId } = await preserved();
    const was = (await item(itemId)).until;
    const later = new Date(Date.parse(was) + 90 * 86_400_000).toISOString();
    const received = new Date(Date.now() - 3_600_000).toISOString();
    const args = (until: string) => ["order-preserve-extend", itemId, "--until", until, "--by", "Landgericht Berlin", "--reference", "AZ 501/26", "--proceedings", "review of the removal order", "--received", received];
    expect((await cli(args(new Date(Date.parse(was) - 86_400_000).toISOString()))).text).toBe(`err order-preserve-extend: --until is not later than the preservation's end, ${was}; nothing changed`);
    expect((await cli(["order-preserve-extend", itemId, "--until", later, "--by", "x"])).code).toBe(1);
    const done = await cli(args(later));
    expect(done.text).toBe(`out order-preserve-extend: item ${itemId} is preserved until ${later} (was ${was}).`);
    expect((await item(itemId)).until).toBe(later);
    // 3f's review (people6): the notice prints the first end as six months from the disabling and the extended one as
    // longer, each a fact of its own.
    const [held] = await migrateDb.execute<{ decision: string }>(sql`select decision_id as decision from public.legal_order_items where id = ${itemId}::uuid`);
    const notice = (await orderNoticeOf(w.apiDb, held!.decision, "DE"))!;
    expect([notice.facts.preserveFirstUntil, notice.facts.preserveUntil, notice.facts.preserveExtended]).toEqual([was, later, true]);
    const [event] = await migrateDb.execute<{ kind: string; via: string; effective: string }>(
      sql`select kind, via, to_char(effective_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as effective from public.legal_order_events where item_id = ${itemId}::uuid and kind = 'preservation_extended'`,
    );
    expect([event!.kind, event!.via, event!.effective]).toEqual(["preservation_extended", "cli", received]);
    const audit = await lastAudit(orderId);
    expect([audit.action, audit.actor_id, audit.target_type]).toEqual(["order_recorded", SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, "order"]);
    expect(audit.metadata).toEqual({ event: "preservation_extended", itemId, until: later, was, received, by: "Landgericht Berlin", reference: "AZ 501/26", proceedingsSha256: digest("review of the removal order") });
    // Once the preservation ended (here by hand, as the migrator), nothing moves it.
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.legal_order_items set preserve_ended_at = now() where id = ${itemId}::uuid`);
    expect((await cli(args(new Date(Date.parse(later) + 86_400_000).toISOString()))).text).toBe(
      `err order-preserve-extend: not_preserved: item ${itemId} is not preserved, or its preservation has ended; nothing changed`,
    );
  });

  test("order-access prints the preserved text, alt texts and image facts, never an image, and records the access; an authority's access is a production", async () => {
    const { itemId, mediaIds } = await preserved();
    const done = await cli(["order-access", itemId, "--purpose", "review", "--for", "the court asked to see it"]);
    expect(done.code).toBe(0);
    expect(done.lines[0]).toBe("out order-access: recorded, purpose review.");
    expect(done.lines).toContain("out a post");
    expect(done.lines).toContain("out order-access: alt text of image 1: image 1");
    for (const id of mediaIds) expect(done.text).toMatch(new RegExp(`order-access: image ${id}: 1200 x 800 pixels, created [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T`));
    const audit = await lastAudit(itemId);
    expect([audit.action, audit.actor_id, audit.target_type]).toEqual(["preserved_accessed", SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, "order_item"]);
    expect(audit.metadata).toEqual({ purpose: "review", productionId: null, forSha256: digest("the court asked to see it"), images: 2, altTexts: 2, textLength: 6 });
    // Task 5: an authority's access names the authority and its reference, and is recorded as a production.
    expect((await cli(["order-access", itemId, "--purpose", "authority", "--for", "BKA"])).text).toBe("err order-access: --authority is required; nothing changed");
    const forAuthority = await cli(["order-access", itemId, "--purpose", "authority", "--for", "the proceedings", "--authority", "BKA", "--reference", "ST 7/26"]);
    expect(forAuthority.code).toBe(0);
    const recorded = /^out order-access: recorded, purpose authority, production ([0-9a-f-]{36})[.]$/.exec(forAuthority.lines[0]!);
    expect(recorded).not.toBeNull();
    const [production] = await migrateDb.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(
      sql`select instrument, purpose, order_item_id, authority, their_reference, produced, account_id is not null as named from public.productions where id = ${recorded![1]!}::uuid`,
    );
    expect({ ...production }).toEqual({ instrument: "preserved_access", purpose: "authority", order_item_id: itemId, authority: "BKA", their_reference: "ST 7/26", produced: ["content"], named: true });
    expect((await lastAudit(itemId)).metadata).toMatchObject({ purpose: "authority", productionId: recorded![1]! });
    expect((await cli(["order-access", itemId, "--purpose", "curiosity", "--for", "x"])).code).toBe(1);
    expect((await cli(["order-access", randomUUID(), "--purpose", "review", "--for", "x"])).text).toMatch(/^err order-access: not_preserved: /);
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await removeDecided(world.migrateDb, posts, [moderator.id]);
    await removeOrderAlerts(world.migrateDb, started);
    await removeFixtures(world.migrateDb, people);
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
  });
});

    const onboarded = (await (await native.fetch("/api/auth/onboarding/handle", { json: { handle, displayName: "Phone User" } })).json()) as { token: string };
    native.token = onboarded.token;

    const started = await native.fetch("/api/account/delete/start", { method: "POST" });
    expect(started.status).toBe(200);
    const deletion = DeleteStartResponse.parse(await started.json());
    const confirmed = await native.fetch("/api/account/delete/confirm", { json: { flowId: deletion.flowId, code: mailer.lastCodeFor(email)!, handle } });
    expect(confirmed.status).toBe(204);
    expect(confirmed.headers.getSetCookie()).toHaveLength(0);
    expect((await native.fetch("/api/me")).status).toBe(401);
    expect((await app.request(`/api/profiles/${handle}`)).status).toBe(404);
  });
});

  describe("the limits", () => {
    test("signed out: 5 an hour and 20 a day for each network, counted after the human check; another network has its own", async () => {
      expect(NOTICE_LIMITS.signedOut).toEqual({ perHour: 5, perDay: 20 });
      const network = w.sender();
      const send = (from: NoticeSender = network, request = notices.rule([missingPost()])) => submitNotice(w.deps, request, from).then(w.remember);
      // A request that fails the human check is not counted.
      for (let n = 0; n < 8; n++) expect(await refusal(send(network, notices.rule([missingPost()], { turnstileToken: "not-human" })))).toBe("human_check_failed");
      for (let n = 0; n < 5; n++) await send();
      await expect(send()).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "rate_limited", status: 429, retryAfterSeconds: expect.any(Number) });
      // The ground does not matter, and neither does what the notice names.
      expect(await refusal(send(network, notices.csam([missingPost()])))).toBe("rate_limited");
      await send(w.sender());
      // The next three hours take five each; then the day is used up, though the hour is new.
      for (let hour = 0; hour < 3; hour++) {
        w.ahead.limitsMs += HOUR + 1000;
        for (let n = 0; n < 5; n++) await send();
      }
      w.ahead.limitsMs += HOUR + 1000;
      const refused = await send().then(() => null, (err: { code: string; retryAfterSeconds: number }) => err);
      expect(refused).toMatchObject({ code: "rate_limited" });
      // The day's window began with the first of the twenty: about 20 hours of it are left.
      expect(refused!.retryAfterSeconds).toBeGreaterThan(18 * 3600);
