```ts
      await expect(noticeStatus(down, { ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", token: "A".repeat(43) }, "net")).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "service_unavailable", status: 503 });
      expect(await w.counts()).toEqual(counts);
    });
  });

  describe("the targets", () => {
    test("links are parsed, duplicates named once, and each link that names nothing is an item of its own with an id that names nothing", async () => {
      const [author, other, reporter] = [await w.account(), await w.account(), await w.account()];
      const { postId, mediaIds } = await imagePost(w.apiDb, 1, author.id);
      const gone = randomUUID();
      // The other account has left this handle: on a rule it names nothing.
      const left = `old_${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into handle_history (handle_lower, profile_id, changed_at) values (${left}, ${other.id}::uuid, now())`);
      const [unknownOne, unknownTwo] = [`u1_${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`, `u2_${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`];
      const answer = await submit(
        {
          ground: "rule",
          ruleId: "R1",
          targets: [
            linkTarget(`${app}/post/${postId.toUpperCase()}/`),
            postTarget(postId, mediaIds[0]),
            accountTarget(author.handle),
            linkTarget(`${app}/u/${author.handle.toUpperCase()}`),
            accountTarget(unknownOne),
            accountTarget(unknownTwo),
            linkTarget(`${app}/u/${unknownOne}`),
            linkTarget(`${app}/post/${gone}`),
            accountTarget(left),
          ],
        },
        w.sender(reporter.session),
      );
      const items = await w.items(answer.ref);
      expect(items.map((item) => [item.position, item.target_type, item.named_handle, item.case_id === null, item.outcome])).toEqual([
        [1, "post", null, false, null],
        [2, "account", author.handle, false, null],
        [3, "account", unknownOne, true, "not_available"],
        [4, "account", unknownTwo, true, "not_available"],
        [5, "post", null, true, "not_available"],
        [6, "account", left, true, "not_available"],
      ]);
      // The image one of the two spellings pointed at is kept as the hint.
      expect([items[0]!.target_id, items[0]!.media_id, items[1]!.target_id, items[4]!.target_id]).toEqual([postId, mediaIds[0], author.id, gone]);
      // The three handles that name nothing live have ids that name nothing, each its own: the old handle's is not its account's.
      const made = [items[2]!.target_id, items[3]!.target_id, items[5]!.target_id];
      expect(new Set(made).size).toBe(3);
      expect(made).not.toContain(other.id);
      expect((await w.migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from profiles where id = any(${uuids(made)})`))[0]!.n).toBe(0);
    });

    test("a link to another site or to another path is refused with its own code, and nothing of the notice is stored", async () => {
      const author = await w.account();
      const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
      const counts = await w.counts();
      for (const [url, code] of [
        [`https://elsewhere.example/post/${postId}`, "notice_link_offsite"],
        [`${app}/settings/profile`, "notice_link_invalid"],
        [`${app}/u/${author.handle}/followers`, "notice_link_invalid"],
      ] as const) {
        await expect(submitNotice(w.deps, notices.rule([postTarget(postId), linkTarget(url)]), w.sender())).rejects.toMatchObject({ code, status: 422 });
      }
      expect(await w.counts()).toEqual(counts);
    });

    test("a signed-in sender's target they reported already on the same ground is dropped; when every target is, the answer is already_reported; another ground, and the anonymous path, are heard", async () => {
      const [author, reporter] = [await w.account(), await w.account()];
      const [first, second] = [(await imagePost(w.apiDb, 1, author.id)).postId, await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id)];
      const from = () => w.sender(reporter.session);
      const rule = (targets: NoticeRequest["targets"]): NoticeRequest => ({ ground: "rule", ruleId: "R1", targets });
      await submit(rule([postTarget(first)]), from());
      const counts = await w.counts();
      expect(await refusal(submitNotice(w.deps, rule([postTarget(first)]), from()))).toBe("already_reported");
      expect(await refusal(submitNotice(w.deps, rule([linkTarget(`${app}/post/${first}`), postTarget(first)]), from()))).toBe("already_reported");
      expect(await w.counts()).toEqual(counts);
      // Named beside a new target, the reported one is dropped and the new one is the notice's first item.
      const mixed = await submit(rule([postTarget(first), postTarget(second)]), from());
      expect((await w.items(mixed.ref)).map((item) => [item.position, item.target_id])).toEqual([[1, second]]);
      // Beside a link that names nothing, the notice stands with that link alone.
      const withDead = await submit(rule([postTarget(first), accountTarget(`nobody_${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`)]), from());
      expect((await w.items(withDead.ref)).map((item) => [item.position, item.target_type, item.outcome])).toEqual([[1, "account", "not_available"]]);

      // That it is illegal is another ground: the same sender is heard on it, once.
      const { turnstileToken: _token, ...illegal } = notices.illegal([postTarget(first)]);
      await submit(illegal as NoticeRequest, from());
      expect(await refusal(submitNotice(w.deps, illegal as NoticeRequest, from()))).toBe("already_reported");
      // On the path for child sexual abuse material nothing is matched against the account: both notices are taken, each
      // an item with no sender, and the case moves to the urgent lane and freezes the post.
      expect(await postFrozen(w.apiDb, first)).toBe(false);
      const [one, two] = [await submit({ ground: "csam", targets: [postTarget(first)], keyword: "csam" }, from()), await submit({ ground: "csam", targets: [postTarget(first)], keyword: "csam" }, from())];
      for (const answer of [one, two]) expect(await w.items(answer.ref)).toMatchObject([{ target_id: first, suspect: true, reporter_account_id: null, case_lane: 0 }]);
      expect(await postFrozen(w.apiDb, first)).toBe(true);
      // Someone else's report of the same post on the same rule is an item of its own.
      const third = await w.account();
      expect(await refusal(submitNotice(w.deps, rule([postTarget(first)]), w.sender(third.session)).then(w.remember))).toBeNull();
    });

    test("a notice on the path for child sexual abuse material that names two accounts is refused, also when the two handles are one account's old and present one; nothing is written", async () => {
      const [ada, bob] = [await w.account(), await w.account()];
      const left = `old_${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into handle_history (handle_lower, profile_id, changed_at) values (${left}, ${ada.id}::uuid, now())`);
      const counts = await w.counts();
      for (const targets of [
        [linkTarget(`${app}/u/${ada.handle}`), linkTarget(`${app}/u/${bob.handle}`)],
        [accountTarget(ada.handle), linkTarget(`${app}/u/${bob.handle}`)],
        [linkTarget(`${app}/u/${ada.handle}`), linkTarget(`${app}/u/${left}`)],
        // Counted as named, before any is looked up: two handles nobody holds are two accounts too.
        [linkTarget(`${app}/u/nobody_one`), linkTarget(`${app}/u/nobody_two`)],
      ]) {
        await expect(submitNotice(w.deps, notices.csam(targets), w.sender())).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_request", status: 400 });
      }
      expect(await w.counts()).toEqual(counts);
      // One account, also named twice, is taken; on another ground so are two.
      const once = await submit(notices.csam([accountTarget(ada.handle), linkTarget(`${app}/u/${ada.handle.toUpperCase()}`)]));
      expect((await w.items(once.ref)).map((item) => [item.position, item.target_id])).toEqual([[1, ada.id]]);
      const two = await submit(notices.rule([accountTarget(ada.handle), accountTarget(bob.handle)]));
      expect(await w.items(two.ref)).toHaveLength(2);
    });
  });

  describe("liveness: one rule for every ground", () => {
    test("liveTarget: a deleted post or account names nothing on a rule or on the law, and still names its row on the path for child sexual abuse material, an account also under a handle it has left", async () => {
      const [author, gone] = [await w.account(), await w.account()];
      const [live, deleted] = [await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id), await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id)];
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${deleted}::uuid`);
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() where id = ${gone.id}::uuid`);
      const left = `old_${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into handle_history (handle_lower, profile_id, changed_at) values (${left}, ${author.id}::uuid, now())`);
      const post = (id: string) => ({ type: "post" as const, id, mediaId: null });
      const account = (handle: string) => ({ type: "account" as const, handle });
      for (const suspect of [false, true]) {
        expect(await liveTarget(w.deps, post(live), suspect)).toEqual({ type: "post", id: live });
        expect(await liveTarget(w.deps, account(author.handle), suspect)).toEqual({ type: "account", id: author.id });
        expect(await liveTarget(w.deps, post(randomUUID()), suspect)).toBeNull();
        expect(await liveTarget(w.deps, account("nobody_holds_it"), suspect)).toBeNull();
      }
      expect(await liveTarget(w.deps, post(deleted), false)).toBeNull();
      expect(await liveTarget(w.deps, account(gone.handle), false)).toBeNull();
      expect(await liveTarget(w.deps, account(left), false)).toBeNull();
      expect(await liveTarget(w.deps, post(deleted), true)).toEqual({ type: "post", id: deleted });
      expect(await liveTarget(w.deps, account(gone.handle), true)).toEqual({ type: "account", id: gone.id });
      expect(await liveTarget(w.deps, account(left), true)).toEqual({ type: "account", id: author.id });
    });

    test("a report on a rule or on the law about a post its author deleted, or about a deleted account, is answered not available: no case, no hold, no alert", async () => {
      const [author, gone] = [await w.account(), await w.account()];
      const { postId, mediaIds } = await imagePost(w.apiDb, 2, author.id);
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${postId}::uuid`);
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() where id = ${gone.id}::uuid`);
      for (const request of [notices.rule([postTarget(postId), accountTarget(gone.handle)], { ruleId: "R5" }), notices.illegal([postTarget(postId), accountTarget(gone.handle)], { category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE" })]) {
        const answer = await submit(request);
        const items = await w.items(answer.ref);
        expect(items.map((item) => [item.position, item.case_id, item.outcome, item.lane])).toEqual([[1, null, "not_available", 0], [2, null, "not_available", 0]]);
        expect(items[0]!.target_id).toBe(postId);
        expect(items[1]!.target_id).not.toBe(gone.id);
      }
      expect(await holds(mediaIds)).toBe(0);
      expect((await w.migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from cases where target_id = any(${uuids([postId, gone.id])})`))[0]!.n).toBe(0);
      await settle();
      // An item without a case enters no lane: nobody is alerted for a link that names nothing.
      expect(urgentMails()).toHaveLength(0);
    });

    test("a notice on the path for child sexual abuse material about a live image post: an urgent case, a snapshot, holds, the post frozen, and one alert to staff", async () => {
      const author = await w.account();
      const { postId, mediaIds } = await imagePost(w.apiDb, 2, author.id);
      const waitingBefore = await urgentCases();
      const answer = await submit(notices.csam([postTarget(postId, mediaIds[1])]));
      await settle();
      const [item] = await w.items(answer.ref);
      expect(item).toMatchObject({ position: 1, target_id: postId, media_id: mediaIds[1], lane: 0, suspect: true, outcome: null, case_lane: 0 });
      expect(await holds(mediaIds)).toBe(2);
      expect(await postFrozen(w.apiDb, postId)).toBe(true);
      expect((await w.migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from evidence_snapshots where case_id = ${item!.case_id}::uuid`))[0]!.n).toBe(1);
      expect(urgentMails()).toHaveLength(1);
      // 3f's review (people4): and whether the phone alerts are on, which the mail says.
      expect(urgentMails()[0]!.data).toEqual({ count: String(waitingBefore + 1), oldest: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9-]{10} [0-9:]{5} UTC$/), phones: w.config.NOTIFY === "off" ? "off" : "on" });
      // A second urgent report within the alert's window sends no second mail.
      await submit(notices.csam([postTarget(postId)]));
      await settle();
      expect(urgentMails()).toHaveLength(1);
    });

    test("when no staff address took the alert its throttle is given back, so the next urgent report alerts again", async () => {
      const author = await w.account();
      const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
      w.mailer.mode = "fail";
      await submit(notices.rule([postTarget(postId)], { ruleId: "R5" }));
      await settle();
      expect(urgentMails()).toHaveLength(0);
      expect(w.mailer.attempts.some((message) => message.template === "moderation_urgent" && message.to === staffAddress)).toBe(true);
      w.mailer.mode = "deliver";
      await submit(notices.rule([postTarget(postId)], { ruleId: "R5" }));
      await settle();
      expect(urgentMails()).toHaveLength(1);
    });

    test("on that path a post its author deleted, one the purge blanked, and a purged account named by its handle each get an urgent case that waits for an admin; a link to no row is answered at once", async () => {
      const [author, purged] = [await w.account(), await w.account()];
      const deleted = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${deleted}::uuid`);
      const blanked = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, purged.id);
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${blanked}::uuid`);
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now(), display_name = '', bio = '' where id = ${purged.id}::uuid`);
      const posts = await submit(notices.csam([postTarget(deleted), postTarget(blanked), missingPost()]));
      expect((await w.items(posts.ref)).map((item) => [item.position, item.case_id !== null, item.outcome, item.case_lane])).toEqual([[1, true, null, 0], [2, true, null, 0], [3, false, "not_available", null]]);
      const account = await submit(notices.csam([accountTarget(purged.handle)]));
      expect(await w.items(account.ref)).toMatchObject([{ position: 1, target_type: "account", target_id: purged.id, named_handle: purged.handle, suspect: true, outcome: null, case_lane: 0 }]);
    });

    test("on that path a post its author deleted, whose images a closed case's hold still keeps, gets an urgent case on the tombstone: the kept images are held for it, listed in its snapshot and frozen", async () => {
      // The decision that closes the first case commits, so a real staff key confirms it, as the console would.
      const decider = deciderWorld(w.apiDb);
      try {
        const [admin, author] = [await decider.staff("admin"), await w.account()];
        const { postId, mediaIds } = await imagePost(w.apiDb, 2, author.id);
        // A rule report's case holds the post's images as evidence. A decision closes the case; its holds stand.
        const first = await submit(notices.rule([postTarget(postId)]));
        const closedCase = (await w.items(first.ref))[0]!.case_id!;
        expect(typeof (await decider.decideAs(admin, closedCase, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }))).toBe("object");
        expect((await w.migrateDb.execute<{ closed: boolean }>(sql`select closed_at is not null as closed from cases where id = ${closedCase}::uuid`))[0]!.closed).toBe(true);
        expect(await holds(mediaIds)).toBe(2);
        // The author deletes the post: it is a tombstone, and the held image rows are kept.
        await deleteByAuthor(w.apiDb, author.id, postId);
        expect((await w.migrateDb.execute<{ state: string }>(sql`select state from posts where id = ${postId}::uuid`))[0]!.state).toBe("deleted_by_author");
        expect(await existing(mediaIds)).toEqual([...mediaIds].sort());
        // On a rule the deleted post names nothing, kept images or not: no case, and no further hold.
        const ruled = await submit(notices.rule([postTarget(postId)]));
        expect(await w.items(ruled.ref)).toMatchObject([{ position: 1, case_id: null, outcome: "not_available" }]);
        expect(await holds(mediaIds)).toBe(2);

        const answer = await submit(notices.csam([postTarget(postId)]));
        await settle();
        const [item] = await w.items(answer.ref);
        expect(item).toMatchObject({ position: 1, target_id: postId, suspect: true, outcome: null, case_lane: 0 });
        expect(item!.case_id).not.toBe(closedCase);
        // The new case holds what is left of the images beside the closed case's holds, and its snapshot lists them on the tombstone.
        expect(await holds(mediaIds)).toBe(4);
        const [snapshot] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ post_state: string; body: string; images: number }>(sql`select post_state, body, jsonb_array_length(media) as images from evidence_snapshots where case_id = ${item!.case_id}::uuid`);
        expect({ ...snapshot! }).toEqual({ post_state: "deleted_by_author", body: "", images: 2 });
        expect(await postFrozen(w.apiDb, postId)).toBe(true);
        expect(urgentMails()).toHaveLength(1);
      } finally {
        await w.cleanUp();
        await decider.close();
      }
    });

    test("on that path a quoting post its author deleted before the notice, with no image of its own, still brings the post it quotes: two items, two urgent cases, the quoted post's images frozen, one alert that counts both", async () => {
      const [quotedAuthor, author] = [await w.account(), await w.account()];
      const quoted = await imagePost(w.apiDb, 1, quotedAuthor.id);
      const quoting = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { quoteOfId: quoted.postId });
      await deleteByAuthor(w.apiDb, author.id, quoting);
      // The deletion leaves what the post quoted on its row.
      expect({ ...(await w.migrateDb.execute<{ state: string; quote_of_id: string }>(sql`select state, quote_of_id from posts where id = ${quoting}::uuid`))[0]! }).toEqual({ state: "deleted_by_author", quote_of_id: quoted.postId });
      const waitingBefore = await urgentCases();
      const answer = await submit(notices.csam([postTarget(quoting)]));
      await settle();
      const items = await w.items(answer.ref);
      expect(items.map((item) => [item.position, item.target_id, item.suspect, item.outcome, item.case_lane])).toEqual([[1, quoting, true, null, 0], [11, quoted.postId, true, null, 0]]);
      expect(new Set(items.map((item) => item.case_id)).size).toBe(2);
      // The tombstone's own case reaches no image; the quoted post's image is held by its case, and both posts are frozen.
      expect(await holds(quoted.mediaIds)).toBe(1);
      expect([await postFrozen(w.apiDb, quoted.postId), await postFrozen(w.apiDb, quoting)]).toEqual([true, true]);
      expect(urgentMails()).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(urgentMails()[0]!.data.count).toBe(String(waitingBefore + 2));
      // The page lists the named item alone until a release: the item korbat added would tell that the tombstone's id names a row.
      expect((await status(answer.ref, answer.token!)).items.map((item) => [item.position, item.quotedBy, item.outcome])).toEqual([[1, null, null]]);
      // On a rule the deleted quoting post names nothing, and brings nothing.
      const ruled = await submit(notices.rule([postTarget(quoting)]));
      expect(await w.items(ruled.ref)).toMatchObject([{ position: 1, case_id: null, outcome: "not_available" }]);
      expect(await holds(quoted.mediaIds)).toBe(1);
    });

    test("on that path a post that quotes another is a report about both: two items, two urgent cases, one alert that counts both; the status page lists the named items alone until a release", async () => {
      const [quotedAuthor, author] = [await w.account(), await w.account()];
      const quoted = (await imagePost(w.apiDb, 1, quotedAuthor.id)).postId;
      const [quotingOne, quotingTwo, plain] = [await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { quoteOfId: quoted }), await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { quoteOfId: quoted }), await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id)];
      const waitingBefore = await urgentCases();
      const answer = await submit(notices.csam([postTarget(quotingOne)]));
      await settle();
      const items = await w.items(answer.ref);
      expect(items.map((item) => [item.position, item.target_id, item.suspect, item.case_lane])).toEqual([[1, quotingOne, true, 0], [11, quoted, true, 0]]);
      expect(new Set(items.map((item) => item.case_id)).size).toBe(2);
      expect(await postFrozen(w.apiDb, quoted)).toBe(true);
      expect(urgentMails()).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(urgentMails()[0]!.data.count).toBe(String(waitingBefore + 2));
      // The item korbat added is stored, and not listed yet: before a release it would tell that the named post exists.
      const page = await status(answer.ref, answer.token!);
      expect(page.items.map((item) => [item.position, item.link, item.quotedBy, item.suspect, item.scope, item.outcome])).toEqual([[1, `${app}/post/${quotingOne}`, null, true, null, null]]);

      // A notice that names both posts adds nothing; two named posts that quote the same post add one item, after the lower.
      const both = await submit(notices.csam([postTarget(quoted), postTarget(quotingOne)]));
      expect((await w.items(both.ref)).map((item) => item.position)).toEqual([1, 2]);
      const twice = await submit(notices.csam([postTarget(plain), postTarget(quotingTwo), postTarget(quotingOne)]));
      expect((await w.items(twice.ref)).map((item) => [item.position, item.target_id])).toEqual([[1, plain], [2, quotingTwo], [3, quotingOne], [12, quoted]]);
      expect((await status(twice.ref, twice.token!)).items.map((item) => [item.position, item.quotedBy])).toEqual([[1, null], [2, null], [3, null]]);
      // On a rule the quoting post is one item, and its answer concerns its own text and images. The page says so only with
      // the released outcome: before it a live post that quotes another, a live post that quotes nothing and a link to no
      // row read the same, so the page never tells which of them names a row.
      const ruled = await submit(notices.rule([postTarget(quotingOne), postTarget(plain), missingPost()]));
      expect((await status(ruled.ref, ruled.token!)).items.map((item) => [item.position, item.scope, item.outcome])).toEqual([[1, null, null], [2, null, null], [3, null, null]]);
    });

    test("an account named by a handle it has left: on that path an urgent case on the account, its posts frozen, and the alert; on a rule the same handle names nothing", async () => {
      const author = await w.account();
      const { postId } = await imagePost(w.apiDb, 1, author.id);
      const left = `old_${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;

      const ruled = await submit(notices.rule([accountTarget(left)]));
      expect(await w.items(ruled.ref)).toMatchObject([{ target_type: "account", named_handle: left, case_id: null, outcome: "not_available" }]);
      expect((await w.items(ruled.ref))[0]!.target_id).not.toBe(author.id);
      expect(await postFrozen(w.apiDb, postId)).toBe(false);

      const answer = await submit(notices.csam([linkTarget(`${app}/u/${left.toUpperCase()}`)]));
      await settle();
      expect(await w.items(answer.ref)).toMatchObject([{ position: 1, target_type: "account", target_id: author.id, named_handle: left, suspect: true, outcome: null, case_lane: 0 }]);
      expect(await postFrozen(w.apiDb, postId)).toBe(true);
      expect(urgentMails()).toHaveLength(1);
      // The page shows the handle as it was named, never the one the profile holds now, and what the answer will concern.
      const page = await status(answer.ref, answer.token!);
      expect(page.items).toMatchObject([{ position: 1, link: `${app}/u/${left}`, scope: "account_suspect", suspect: true, outcome: null }]);
      expect(JSON.stringify(page)).not.toContain(author.handle);
    });
  });

  describe("the status page and the contact's two buttons", () => {
    test("the notice's own token and the mail's token both open the page; only the mail's tells whether the address is confirmed or stopped; anything else is not found", async () => {
      const author = await w.account();
      const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);

        const waiting = { scope: null, suspect: true, sealed: false, unseen: false, quotedBy: null, outcome: null, decidedOn: null, changed: false, reexamines: false, reexamination: null };

        expect((await status(onTwo.ref, onTwo.token!)).items.map((item) => [item.position, item.quotedBy, item.outcome])).toEqual([[1, null, null], [2, null, "no_violation"], [12, 2, null]]);
      } finally {

    test("after the daily release an item answered at intake shows its outcome and its day, and cannot be examined again; the outcomes the page can show are the database's", async () => {
      const outcomes = await w.apiDb.execute<{ value: string }>(sql`select unnest(enum_range(null::item_outcome))::text as value`);
      expect(outcomes.map((row) => row.value)).toEqual([...ITEM_OUTCOMES]);

      // The release takes every item answered before its cut-off; the cut-off is the statement's own time.

        await imagePost(w.apiDb, 2, sealedAuthor.id);

        const quoting = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { quoteOfId: plain });
        const ruled = await submit(notices.rule([postTarget(plain), accountTarget(author.handle)]));
        const quote = await submit(notices.rule([postTarget(quoting), missingPost()]));
        const onLaw = await submit(notices.illegal([postTarget(frozen)]));
        const suspect = await submit(notices.csam([postTarget(frozen)]));
        // A rule report about the account stands in the case the notice of child sexual abuse material about it joins.
        const beside = await submit(notices.rule([accountTarget(sealedAuthor.handle)]));
        const sealing = await submit(notices.csam([accountTarget(sealedAuthor.handle)]));
        const caseOf = async (ref: string) => (await w.items(ref))[0]!.case_id!;
        const decide = async (caseId: string, input: DecisionInput) => {

          expect(typeof outcome, String(outcome)).toBe("object");
        };
        // No breach in the first post (its author's account stays undecided) nor in the post that quotes it; no action on
        // the third, decided while its images were out of staff's sight, which answers both of its notices; and the
        // account's images sealed for good, which answers both of its reports.
        await decide(await caseOf(ruled.ref), { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        await decide(await caseOf(quote.ref), { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        expect(await caseOf(onLaw.ref)).toBe(await caseOf(suspect.ref));
        await decide(await caseOf(onLaw.ref), { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        expect(await caseOf(beside.ref)).toBe(await caseOf(sealing.ref));
        await decide(await caseOf(sealing.ref), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });

        for (const answer of [ruled, quote, onLaw, suspect, beside, sealing]) {

        }

        // about the account as any item about an account: no scope tells what was decided, or what exists.
        expect((await status(quote.ref, quote.token!)).items.map((item) => item.scope)).toEqual([null, null]);
        expect((await status(beside.ref, beside.token!)).items.map((item) => item.scope)).toEqual(["account"]);
        await w.apiDb.execute(sql`select public.release_outcomes(now())`);
        const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

        expect((await status(quote.ref, quote.token!)).items.map((item) => [item.outcome, item.scope])).toEqual([["no_violation", "quote"], ["not_available", null]]);

        const [post, account] = (await status(ruled.ref, ruled.token!)).items;
        expect(post).toMatchObject({ position: 1, outcome: "no_violation", decidedOn: today, scope: null, sealed: false, unseen: false, changed: false, reexamines: false });
        // The window runs six calendar months from the release.
        expect(post!.reexamination).toEqual({ open: true, until: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]{12}Z$/) });
        const sixMonths = new Date();
        sixMonths.setUTCMonth(sixMonths.getUTCMonth() + 6);
        expect(Math.abs(new Date(post!.reexamination!.until).getTime() - sixMonths.getTime())).toBeLessThan(4 * 24 * HOUR);
        // The item about the account is still waiting, and says so by saying nothing.

        expect((await status(onLaw.ref, onLaw.token!)).items).toMatchObject([{ outcome: "no_violation", decidedOn: today, suspect: false, unseen: true, sealed: false, scope: null, reexamination: { open: true } }]);

      } finally {
        await w.cleanUp();
        await decider.close();
      }
    });
  });

  describe("a notice on the path for child sexual abuse material racing the deletion of what it names (gate K)", () => {
    /** The moderation module over an open transaction: its intake is then a savepoint, and its locks are held until the test lets the transaction end. */
    const depsOver = (tx: DbTx): ModerationDeps => ({ ...w.deps, apiDb: tx as unknown as Db, social: socialForModeration(tx as unknown as Db), media: casesMedia(tx), background: createBackground(pino({ level: "silent" })) });

    const deleters = [
      ["the author's deletion of the post", (db: Db | DbTx, authorId: string, postId: string) => deleteByAuthor(db, authorId, postId)],
      ["the account's purge", (db: Db | DbTx, authorId: string) => purgeAccount(db, authorId)],
    ] as const;
    const targets = [
      ["the post", (made: { postId: string }) => postTarget(made.postId)],
      ["the account", (made: { handle: string }) => accountTarget(made.handle)],
    ] as const;

    for (const [deleterName, remove] of deleters) {
      for (const [targetName, target] of targets) {
        test(`${deleterName}, a notice about ${targetName}: when the notice locks first every image row it reaches is kept; no error, no deadlock`, async () => {
          const author = await w.account();
          const { postId, mediaIds } = await imagePost(w.apiDb, 3, author.id);
          const [locked, wait] = [gate(), gate()];
          let noticing: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
          let removing: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
          try {
            noticing = withLockTimeout(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
              const deps = depsOver(tx);
              w.remember(await submitNotice(deps, notices.csam([target({ postId, handle: author.handle })]), w.sender()));
              await deps.background.settle();
              locked.open();
              await wait.opened;
            });
            await Promise.race([locked.opened, noticing]);
            removing = remove(w.apiDb, author.id, postId);
            // The removal waits for a lock the notice's open transaction holds.
            await untilBlocked(w.apiDb, "");
            wait.open();
            await noticing;
            await removing;
            // The keep trigger read the freeze after the wait and saw the committed item.
            expect(await existing(mediaIds)).toEqual([...mediaIds].sort());
            expect(await postFrozen(w.apiDb, postId)).toBe(true);
            const [post] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ state: string }>(sql`select state from posts where id = ${postId}::uuid`);
            expect(post!.state).toBe("deleted_by_author");
          } finally {
            wait.open();
            await Promise.allSettled([noticing, removing]);
          }
        });

        test(`${deleterName}, a notice about ${targetName}: when the deletion locks first the notice waits, is stored without an error, and no image row is kept`, async () => {
          const author = await w.account();
          const { postId, mediaIds } = await imagePost(w.apiDb, 3, author.id);
          const [removed, wait] = [gate(), gate()];
          let removing: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
          let noticing: Promise<{ ref: string; token?: string } | null> = Promise.resolve(null);
          try {
            removing = withLockTimeout(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
              await remove(tx, author.id, postId);
              removed.open();
              await wait.opened;
            });
            await Promise.race([removed.opened, removing]);
            noticing = submitNotice(w.deps, notices.csam([target({ postId, handle: author.handle })]), w.sender()).then(w.remember);
            await untilBlocked(w.apiDb, "");
            wait.open();
            await removing;
            const answer = (await noticing)!;
            // The report came too late for these images, as it would have a moment later; it still waits for an admin.
            expect(await existing(mediaIds)).toEqual([]);
            expect(await w.items(answer.ref)).toMatchObject([{ position: 1, suspect: true, outcome: null, case_lane: 0 }]);
            expect(await postFrozen(w.apiDb, postId)).toBe(true);
          } finally {
            wait.open();
            await Promise.allSettled([removing, noticing]);
          }
        });
      }
    }
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the moderation tables, the posts and profiles, and the four auth tables of moderation cases hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await w.cleanUp();
    expect(await w.counts()).toEqual(before);
    expect(await authCaseCounts(w.migrateDb)).toEqual(beforeAuth);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { appendConfirmedAudit } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import {
  CHANNEL_TABLES,
  aPost,
  act,
  decideIn,
  hex64,
  imagePost,
  moderationDeps,
  newPostRow,
  newTestStaff,
  newestSnapshot,
  raised,
  removeFixtures,
  report,
  rowCounts,
  staffProfile,
  type TestStaff,
} from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { closeNotifyFixtures } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES, effectParams, effectWith, orderConfig, orderForTest, sessionOf } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 300_000 });

/**
 * The ledger of an order (3f design, section 6.3; invariants 5, 6, 7 and 9, LAB C and D on the built code). Nothing
 * enters the ledger without a key: each of LAB D's refusals at commit leaves nothing behind, and one audit row covers at
 * most ten decisions. An order waives exactly three checks (recusal, staff_target and the decision caps) and has a cap
 * of its own; its reinstatement is an admin's. The level is derived whatever the order of arrival. korbat's appeal does
 * not apply to an order decision. The author's own deletion of a disabled post is refused by the database too. Every
 * test runs in a transaction that is rolled back.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the ledger of an order", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let moderator: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    moderator = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "admin");
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, moderator);
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, admin);
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, [moderator.id, admin.id]);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  const asView = (outcome: OrderView | string): OrderView => {
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`refused: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome;
  };
  async function effect(tx: DbTx, by: TestStaff, view: OrderView, params: Record<string, unknown> = effectParams(view)): Promise<OrderView | string> {
    try {
      return await effectWith(tx, by, view.id, params);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ModerationError) return err.code;
      throw err;
    }
  }
  const confirmedParts = (staff: TestStaff) => ({
    keyId: staff.keyId,
    staffSession: randomUUID(),
    actionHash: hex64(),
    stepUp: { authenticatorData: "AAAA", clientDataJSON: "BBBB", signature: "CCCC" },
    requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}`,
    expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60_000),
  });

  /**
   * The effect's rows with an audit row the test chooses, and decision_holds run at once: answers the refusal's code, or
   * null when the decisions stand. The savepoint goes either way, so nothing is left behind. The audit row is the staff
   * member's; the decisions name `deciderId` when given (3f's review, proofs5), else the same staff member.
   */
  async function rawEffect(
    tx: DbTx,
    staff: TestStaff,
    view: OrderView,
    audit: {
      action?: "order_effected" | "case_decided";
      plain?: boolean;
      params?: (p: OrderEffectedParams) => Record<string, unknown>;
      decisionIds?: (ids: Record<string, string>) => Record<string, string>;
      targetId?: string;
      deciderId?: string;
    },
    params: OrderEffectedParams = effectParams(view),
  ): Promise<string | null> {
    try {
      await tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
        const ids = await effectRows(moderationDeps(sp, { config: orderConfig() }), sp, audit.deciderId ?? staff.id, params);
        const metadata = { params: audit.params ? audit.params(params) : params, decisionIds: audit.decisionIds ? audit.decisionIds(ids) : ids };
        if (audit.plain) await appendAuditRow(sp, { actorId: staff.id, action: "order_effected", targetType: "order", targetId: audit.targetId ?? view.id, requestId: null, metadata });
        else await appendConfirmedAudit(sp, { actorId: staff.id, action: audit.action ?? "order_effected", targetType: "order", targetId: audit.targetId ?? view.id, metadata, ...confirmedParts(staff) });
        await sp.execute(sql`set constraints public.decisions_check, public.decision_actions_recheck immediate`);
        throw new Error("held");
      });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof Error && err.message === "held") return null;
      return raised(err)?.message ?? String(err);
    }
    return null;
  }

  test("LAB D: each refusal at commit, and one audit row covers at most ten decisions", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const posts: string[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 11; i++) posts.push((await imagePost(tx, 0)).postId);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: posts.slice(0, 10) });
      const counted = async () => (await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.decisions where order_item_id is not null`))[0]!.n;
      const start = await counted();
      // The plain row: no confirmation.
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, { plain: true })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      // case_decided in the place of order_effected.
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, { action: "case_decided" })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      // Another order as the target, and a forged reference in the params.
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, { targetId: randomUUID() })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, { params: (p) => ({ ...p, reference: "forged" }) })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      // An item the row does not name, and a decision the row names under another item.
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, { decisionIds: (ids) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(ids).slice(1)) })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      expect(
        await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, {
          decisionIds: (ids) => {
            const [a, b] = Object.keys(ids);
            return { ...ids, [a!]: ids[b!]!, [b!]: ids[a!]! };
          },
        }),
      ).toBe("invalid_decision");
      // "Must not be told" signed with the post shown to its author equals no row.
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, { params: (p) => ({ ...p, sectionC: true }) })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      // Ten decisions under one row stand.
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, {})).toBeNull();
      expect(await counted()).toBe(start);
      // An eleventh is refused: at most items_per_action under one row.
      await addItems(moderationDeps(tx, { config: orderConfig() }), sessionOf(moderator), order.id, { links: [`${orderConfig().APP_ORIGIN}/post/${posts[10]}`] }, { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
      const eleven = (await orderView(moderationDeps(tx, { config: orderConfig() }), order.id, sessionOf(moderator)))!;
      const all = eleven.items.map((item) => ({ itemId: item.id, postId: item.postId! })).sort((a, b) => (a.postId < b.postId ? -1 : 1));
      expect(all).toHaveLength(ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction + 1);
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, eleven, {}, { ...effectParams(eleven), items: all })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      expect(await counted()).toBe(start);
    });
  });

  test("3f's review (proofs5): LAB D's actor check: decisions that name an account that is not staff, or another staff member than the key's holder, are refused at commit", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [p.postId] });
      // An order decision needs no admin and no texts: only this check ties its decider to the key that signed.
      const plain = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, { deciderId: plain.id })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, { deciderId: admin.id })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      // Named after the key's holder, the same rows stand.
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, {})).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  test("a second measure on an order decision is refused", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [p.postId] });
      const second = await tx
        .transaction(async (sp) => {
          const ids = await effectRows(moderationDeps(sp, { config: orderConfig() }), sp, moderator.id, effectParams(order));
          await sp.execute(sql`insert into public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind) values (${Object.values(ids)[0]!}::uuid, 'remove')`);
        })
        .then(
          () => null,
          (err: unknown) => raised(err)?.message ?? null,
        );
      expect(second).toBe("invalid_decision");
    });
  });

  test("an order waives recusal, staff_target and the decision caps, and has a cap of its own", async () => {
    // The decision caps at zero, as the migrator sets them (staff.js limits), and back after.
    const [limits] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ per_hour: number; per_day: number }>(sql`select decisions_per_hour as per_hour, decisions_per_day as per_day from public.moderation_limits where id = 1`);
    try {
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.moderation_limits set decisions_per_hour = 0, decisions_per_day = 0 where id = 1`);
      await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
        // The moderator's own post: a party to it and a staff member, and still given effect by the moderator.
        const own = await newPostRow(tx, moderator.id);
        const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [own] });
        expect(asView(await effect(tx, moderator, order)).items[0]!.inForce).toBe(true);
        // The order's cap: decisionsPerDay order decisions of one account in 24 hours, the next refused.
        let given = 1;
        while (given < ORDER_RULES.decisionsPerDay) {
          const batch: string[] = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction, ORDER_RULES.decisionsPerDay - given); i++) batch.push((await imagePost(tx, 0)).postId);
          const next = await orderForTest(tx, admin, { posts: batch });
          asView(await effect(tx, moderator, next));
          given += batch.length;
        }
        const last = await orderForTest(tx, admin, { posts: [(await imagePost(tx, 0)).postId] });
        expect(await effect(tx, moderator, last)).toBe("order_cap");
        // Another staff member goes on.
        expect(asView(await effect(tx, admin, last)).items[0]!.inForce).toBe(true);
      });
    } finally {
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.moderation_limits set decisions_per_hour = ${limits!.per_hour}, decisions_per_day = ${limits!.per_day} where id = 1`);
    }
  });

  test("the reinstatement is an admin's, asks no recusal, and lifts the measure; the level is derived in either order of arrival (LAB C)", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      // Removed under a rule, then disabled: disabled; reinstated: removed again, since the rule's removal stands.
      const a = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const reported = await report(tx, aPost(a.postId), "rule");
      await decideIn(tx, moderator, reported.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [a.postId] });
      const done = asView(await effect(tx, moderator, order));
      const level = async (postId: string) => (await tx.execute<{ level: string; state: string }>(sql`select moderation_level::text as level, state::text as state from public.posts where id = ${postId}::uuid`))[0]!;
      expect(await level(a.postId)).toEqual({ level: "disabled", state: "disabled" });
      const decisionId = done.items[0]!.decisionId!;
      const caseId = done.items[0]!.caseId!;
      const reinstate = { kind: "correction" as const, reviewsDecisionId: decisionId, outcome: "reversed" as const, actions: [{ kind: "reinstate_by_order" as const, orderGround: "withdrawn" as const }] };
      await expect(decideIn(tx, moderator, caseId, reinstate)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "admin_required" });
      await decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, reinstate);
      expect(await level(a.postId)).toEqual({ level: "removed", state: "removed" });
      const [item] = await tx.execute<{ reinstated: boolean; ended: boolean }>(sql`select reinstated_at is not null as reinstated, preserve_ended_at is not null as ended from public.legal_order_items where order_id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
      expect([item!.reinstated, item!.ended]).toEqual([true, true]);
      // Disabled first, then removed under a rule: the removal changes nothing now; reinstated, the removal stands.
      const b = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const second = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [b.postId] });
      const first = asView(await effect(tx, moderator, second));
      const rule = await report(tx, aPost(b.postId), "rule");
      const removal = await decideIn(tx, moderator, rule.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
      const [noEffect] = await tx.execute<{ no_effect: string | null }>(sql`select no_effect from public.decision_actions where decision_id = ${removal}::uuid and kind = 'remove'`);
      expect(noEffect!.no_effect).toBe("already");
      expect(await level(b.postId)).toEqual({ level: "disabled", state: "disabled" });
      // The admin is the author of a third post: recusal is asked neither of the effect nor of the reinstatement.
      await decideIn(tx, admin, first.items[0]!.caseId!, { ...reinstate, reviewsDecisionId: first.items[0]!.decisionId! });
      expect(await level(b.postId)).toEqual({ level: "removed", state: "removed" });
      const own = await newPostRow(tx, admin.id);
      const ownOrder = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [own] });
      const ownDone = asView(await effect(tx, moderator, ownOrder));
      await decideIn(tx, admin, ownDone.items[0]!.caseId!, { ...reinstate, reviewsDecisionId: ownDone.items[0]!.decisionId!, actions: [{ kind: "reinstate_by_order", orderGround: "wrong_item" }] });
      expect(await level(own)).toEqual({ level: "visible", state: "visible" });
    });
  });

  test("korbat's appeal does not apply: not_appealable; the decision is final when taken", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const a = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { kind: "dsa_art9", posts: [a.postId], withholdFromAuthor: false });
      const done = asView(await effect(tx, admin, order, { ...effectParams(order), urgent: true }));
      const decisionId = done.items[0]!.decisionId!;
      const appeal = await tx
        .transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`insert into public.appeals (decision_id, appellant_account_id) values (${decisionId}::uuid, ${a.authorId}::uuid)`))
        .then(
          () => null,
          (err: unknown) => raised(err)?.message ?? null,
        );
      expect(appeal).toBe("not_appealable");
      const [final] = await tx.execute<{ same: boolean }>(sql`select public.decision_final_at(d.id) = d.decided_at as same from public.decisions d where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid`);
      expect(final!.same).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  test("the author's own deletion of a disabled post is refused by the database; an item's intake item pointed at a reporter's item is refused", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const a = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [a.postId] });
      asView(await effect(tx, moderator, order));
      const deleted = await tx
        .transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`update public.posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', deleted_at = now(), body = '' where id = ${a.postId}::uuid`))
        .then(
          () => null,
          (err: unknown) => raised(err)?.code ?? null,
        );
      expect(deleted).toBe("42501");
      // A reporter's unanswered item of the same case named as the order item's intake item: refused.
      const b = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const reported = await report(tx, aPost(b.postId), "rule");
      const other = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [b.postId] });
      const [item] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.intake_items where case_id = ${reported.caseId}::uuid`);
      const snapshot = await newestSnapshot(tx, reported.caseId);
      const [kase] = await tx.execute<{ v: number }>(sql`select state_version as v from public.cases where id = ${reported.caseId}::uuid`);
      const pointed = await tx
        .transaction(async (sp) => {
          await setItemIntake(sp, other.items[0]!.id, item!.id);
          await insertOrderDecision(sp, {
            id: randomUUID(),
            caseId: reported.caseId,
            itemId: other.items[0]!.id,
            stateVersion: kase!.v,
            rulesVersion: 3,
            redressVersion: 3,
            category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY",
            keyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT",
            snapshotId: snapshot.id,
            snapshotDigest: snapshot.digest,
            decidedBy: moderator.id,
          });
        })
        .then(
          () => null,
          (err: unknown) => raised(err)?.message ?? null,
        );
      expect(pointed).toBe("invalid_decision");
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * The author's notice of an order (3f design, sections 6.3, 7.7 step 3, 7.10 and 9.2; invariants 3, 4's commands and
 * alert, and 28). With Section C the notice is held: nothing reaches the author, and a decision of korbat's own about
 * the post taken during the hold is held with it, while its reporter is answered as always. order_notices_release()
 * tells nothing before the hold's end and everything at it, stamping clock_timestamp(); a correction that holds the
 * order decision's row makes the release wait for it. The authority's words recorded after the author was told make the

describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the author's notice of an order", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;

    await removeFixtures(world.migrateDb, people);

    ))[0]!;
  const env = () => ({ DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, HOME_STATE: "DE", APP_ORIGIN: appOrigin });

    return { code, text: lines.join(" ") };

  test("a held notice tells nobody, on any path; a decision of korbat's own about the post is held with it and its reporter answered; the release tells both at the hold's end and not before", async () => {
    const p = await post(1);

    expect(item!.answered).toBe(true);

    await expect(authorDecisionView(deps, p.authorId, decisionId)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ModerationError);
    await expect(authorDecisionView(deps, p.authorId, removal.decisionId)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ModerationError);
    expect((await authorFacts(deps, p.authorId, [p.postId])).size).toBe(0);
    expect(await exportedDecisions(deps, p.authorId)).toEqual([]);
    // The removal gave a strike, which counts nowhere the author can see while it is held: not on Cases' "Your
    // standing", not in /api/me's standing, not in the export's strikes (section 7.10); the release counts it.
    const [struck] = await w.apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.decision_actions where decision_id = ${removal.decisionId}::uuid and kind = 'strike'`);
    expect(struck!.n).toBe(1);
    const strikes = async () => [(await authorCases(deps, p.authorId)).activeStrikes, (await standingFor(w.apiDb, p.authorId))?.activeStrikes, (await exportedStrikes(w.apiDb, p.authorId)).length];
    expect(await strikes()).toEqual([0, 0, 0]);
    // The API role cannot write a decision's informed_at.
    const refused = await w.apiDb.execute(sql`update public.decisions set informed_at = now() where id = ${decisionId}::uuid`).then(
      () => "written",
      () => "refused",
    );
    expect(refused).toBe("refused");
    // Before the end, nothing is told; an end a moment ahead, and at it everything is.
    expect(await release()).toBe(0);
    await world.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set authority_hold_until = clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => 2) where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
    expect(await release()).toBe(0);
    const [end] = await w.apiDb.execute<{ until: string }>(sql`select to_char(public.order_hold_until(${order.id}::uuid) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as until`);
    await sleep(2_200);
    expect(await release()).toBe(2);
    const order_told = await told(decisionId);
    expect(order_told).toMatchObject({ informed: true, mail: "pending" });
    // Never before the end: the stamp is the clock's at the release.
    expect(Date.parse(order_told.informed_at!)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(Date.parse(end!.until));
    expect(await told(removal.decisionId)).toMatchObject({ informed: true, mail: "pending" });
    expect(await strikes()).toEqual([1, 1, 1]);
    const [event] = await w.apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.legal_order_events where order_id = ${order.id}::uuid and kind = 'notice_released' and via = 'system'`);
    expect(event!.n).toBe(1);
    // Now the author reads both, and the notice says that it was held until now. The notice's row is placed by the day its
    // author was told, which it shows (3f's review, people9); the removal's by the day it was decided, during the hold.
    expect((await authorCases(deps, p.authorId)).decisions.map((d) => [d.kind, d.order ?? null])).toEqual([
      ["order", "disabled"],
      ["final", null],
    ]);
    const view = await authorDecisionView(deps, p.authorId, decisionId);
    expect(view.content).toBeNull();
    // korbat's own removal, held and released with the notice, shows the still disabled post no more than the notice does.
    expect((await authorDecisionView(deps, p.authorId, removal.decisionId)).content).toBeNull();
    expect(view.appealUntil).toBeNull();
    expect(view.order).toMatchObject({ held: true, kind: "tco_removal", withholdAuthor: true });
    expect(statementParagraphs(view, { texts: view.orderTexts ?? null }).join(" ")).toContain("korbat was not allowed to tell you until now.");
    // The chip: a disabled post has none (its level is disabled, which no list shows).
    expect((await authorFacts(deps, p.authorId, [p.postId])).size).toBe(0);
    // A second release tells nothing more.
    expect(await release()).toBe(0);
  });

  test("a measure never rests on a decision its subject has not been told of: a suspension at once on a threat found in the held post is refused, and allowed once the threat's removal is told", async () => {
    // As the migrator, who alone may end the hold by hand here; the flows run as they do for the API.
    await rolledBack(world.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const author = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 0, author.id);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [p.postId], sectionC: true });
      await effectWith(tx, moderator, order.id, effectParams(order));
      // An admin's own finding of a direct threat in the disabled post, decided as a removal: held with the notice.
      const finding = await intake(tx, ground.finding(admin.id, "R5"), aPost(p.postId));
      const threat = await decideIn(tx, admin, finding.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [act("remove")] });
      const [held] = await tx.execute<{ informed: boolean }>(sql`select informed_at is not null as informed from public.decisions where id = ${threat}::uuid`);
      expect(held!.informed).toBe(false);
      // The suspension at once on the threat basis would be told at once, on the account's case: no basis while it is held.
      const onAccount = await intake(tx, ground.finding(admin.id, "R5"), anAccount(author.id, author.handle));
      const suspend = () => decideIn(tx, admin, onAccount.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [timed("suspend", 7, false)] });
      expect(await refusal(suspend())).toBe("invalid_decision");
      // Once the hold has ended and the release has told the threat's removal, the same suspension rests on it.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set hold_ended_at = now(), hold_end_reason = 'released_by_authority' where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.order_notices_release()`);
      const suspension = await suspend();
      const [rests] = await tx.execute<{ basis: string; rests: string[] }>(sql`select basis, rests_on::text[] as rests from public.decision_actions where decision_id = ${suspension}::uuid and kind = 'suspend'`);
      expect([rests!.basis, rests!.rests]).toEqual(["threat", [threat]]);
    });
  });

  test("3f's review (people3): a decision held with the notice counts its appeal from the release: its statement's deadline is the decision screen's appealUntil, not six months from the day it was taken", async () => {
    // As the migrator, who alone may move a decision's time and end the hold by hand here; the flows run as for the API.
    await rolledBack(world.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [p.postId], sectionC: true });
      await effectWith(tx, moderator, order.id, effectParams(order));
      const finding = await intake(tx, ground.finding(admin.id, "R5"), aPost(p.postId));
      const removal = await decideIn(tx, admin, finding.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [act("remove")] });
      // The removal was taken 40 days before the release.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.decisions set decided_at = decided_at - make_interval(days => 40) where id = ${removal}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set hold_ended_at = now(), hold_end_reason = 'released_by_authority' where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.order_notices_release()`);
      const deps = { apiDb: tx as unknown as Db };
      const view = await authorDecisionView(deps, p.authorId, removal);
      expect(view.appealUntil).not.toBeNull();
      const minute = (at: string) => `${at.slice(0, 10)} ${at.slice(11, 16)} UTC`;
      const text = statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(tx as unknown as Db, removal))!.statement).join(" ");
      expect(text).toContain(minute(view.appealUntil!));
      expect(text).not.toContain(minute(appealDeadline(new Date(view.decidedAt)).toISOString()));
      // The screen renders the same statement's data, and so the same deadline.
      expect(statementParagraphs(view).join(" ")).toContain(minute(view.appealUntil!));
    });
  });

  test("a second order on a post whose notice another order holds is held with it, and both are told at the first order's release", async () => {
    // As the migrator, who alone may end the hold by hand here; the flows run as they do for the API.
    await rolledBack(world.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const a = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [p.postId], sectionC: true, reference: `A-${p.postId}` });
      const first = (await effectWith(tx, moderator, a.id, effectParams(a))).items[0]!.decisionId!;
      // B asks for no silence, but its notice would say that another decision already keeps the post from being shown.
      const b = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [p.postId], reference: `B-${p.postId}` });
      const second = (await effectWith(tx, moderator, b.id, effectParams(b))).items[0]!.decisionId!;
      const state = async (id: string) =>
        (await tx.execute<{ informed: boolean; mail: string }>(sql`select informed_at is not null as informed, author_mail::text as mail from public.decisions where id = ${id}::uuid`))[0]!;
      expect([await state(first), await state(second)]).toEqual([
        { informed: false, mail: "none" },
        { informed: false, mail: "none" },
      ]);
      const releaseIn = async () => (await tx.execute<{ told: number }>(sql`select public.order_notices_release() as told`))[0]!.told;
      expect(await releaseIn()).toBe(0);
      expect(await state(second)).toEqual({ informed: false, mail: "none" });
      // A's hold ends: one release tells both.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set hold_ended_at = now(), hold_end_reason = 'released_by_authority' where id = ${a.id}::uuid`);
      expect(await releaseIn()).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
      expect([await state(first), await state(second)]).toEqual([
        { informed: true, mail: "pending" },
        { informed: true, mail: "pending" },
      ]);
    });
  });

  test("the release waits for a transaction that holds an untold order decision's row, and then tells it", async () => {
    const p = await post();
    const order = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, moderator, { posts: [p.postId], sectionC: true });
    const done = await effect(order);

    await world.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set hold_ended_at = now(), hold_end_reason = 'released_by_authority' where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
    let finished = false;
    let releasing: Promise<number> | null = null;
    await w.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      // What a correction of the order decision takes first.
      await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from public.decisions where id = ${decisionId}::uuid for share`);
      releasing = release().then((n) => {
        finished = true;
        return n;
      });
      await sleep(500);
      expect(finished).toBe(false);
    });
    expect(await releasing!).toBe(1);
    expect(await told(decisionId)).toMatchObject({ informed: true, mail: "pending" });
  });

  test("the hold's commands: one extension of 42 days, refused a second time and after the release; a DSA order's end is the authority's, and with none nothing is released; ending a hold tells at the next round", async () => {

    const first = await until(order.id);

    expect(extended.code).toBe(0);

    expect(days!.days).toBe(ORDER_RULES.holdExtensionDays);
    const again = await cli(["order-hold-extend", order.id, "--received", new Date(Date.now() - 60_000).toISOString(), "--how", "again"]);
    expect([again.code, again.text]).toEqual([1, expect.stringContaining("already extended once")]);
    // Ended as korbat's own mistake is refused while the first period of an extended hold runs; another reason ends it.
    expect((await cli(["order-hold-end", order.id, "--reason", "not_ordered", "--how", "x"])).code).toBe(1);
    expect((await cli(["order-hold-end", order.id, "--reason", "annulled", "--how", "the court's ruling"])).code).toBe(0);
    expect(await release()).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(await told(done.items[0]!.decisionId!)).toMatchObject({ informed: true });
    const late = await cli(["order-hold-extend", order.id, "--received", new Date(Date.now() - 60_000).toISOString(), "--how", "late"]);
    expect([late.code, late.text]).toEqual([1, expect.stringContaining("already released")]);
    // A DSA order whose author must not be told, given effect as urgent by an admin: no end until the authority names one.
    const d = await post();
    const dsa = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, admin, { kind: "dsa_art9", posts: [d.postId], sectionC: true });
    const urgent = await effectForTest(world, admin, dsa.id, { ...effectParams(dsa), urgent: true });
    if (typeof urgent === "string") throw new Error(urgent);
    expect(await until(dsa.id)).toBe("infinity");
    expect((await cli(["order-hold-extend", dsa.id, "--received", new Date().toISOString(), "--how", "x"])).code).toBe(1);
    expect(await release()).toBe(0);
    const named = await cli(["order-hold-until", dsa.id, new Date(Date.now() + 90 * 86_400_000).toISOString(), "--basis", "the order's sentence 3", "--how", "read in the order"]);
    expect(named.code).toBe(0);
    expect(named.text).toContain("held until");
    expect(await release()).toBe(0);
    // An end in the past changes nothing without --release.
    const past = await cli(["order-hold-until", dsa.id, new Date(Date.now() - 60_000).toISOString(), "--basis", "b", "--how", "h"]);
    expect([past.code, past.text]).toEqual([1, expect.stringContaining("give --release")]);
  });

  test("hold_ending warns every staff account daily in the last days before a hold's end, and not before", async () => {
    const p = await post();

    await world.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set authority_hold_until = now() + make_interval(days => ${ORDER_RULES.holdWarningDays + 3}) where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
    await world.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'hold_ending'`);

    const none = await outboxSince(world.migrateDb, "hold_ending", since);
    await world.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set authority_hold_until = now() + make_interval(days => 2) where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
    await w.apiDb.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
    const warned = await outboxSince(world.migrateDb, "hold_ending", since);
    expect(none).toEqual([]);

    // The notice's words of the hold do not depend on its own warning.

    expect(STAFF_USAGE).toContain("order-hold-end");
  });
});
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { GAP_CLASSES, GAP_DISPOSITIONS, ORDER_RULES, type GapClass } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { createAuthRepo, type AuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { appendConfirmedAudit } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import {
  RECOVERY_TABLES,
  aPost,
  act,
  decideIn,
  hex64,
  imagePost,
  newTestStaff,
  raised,
  refusal,
  report,
  rowCounts,
  staffProfile,
  type TestStaff,
} from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { SEAL_FOR_GOOD, SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING } from "./records-fixtures";
import { pgError, rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 90_000 });

/**
 * The restore gaps (3f design, sections 6.6, 6.7 and 7.17; invariants 5, 21 and 24): the CHECKs hold the contracts'
 * lists; the API role reads the gaps and writes none, and inserts a copy mark's two columns alone, whose time the trigger
 * forces; gap_close closes a gap with the decision this transaction made by the acting account, when it fits the gap's
 * class and target, as reapplied, and refuses anything else (gap_mismatch), leaving the gap open; a gap closed as not
 * needed stands only with its confirmed audit row gap_closed on that gap, by an admin, refused at commit otherwise; and
 * delete_restore_gaps keeps every gap a decision closed, and the newest copy mark. The gaps are written as the import
 * writes them, as the migrator, and removed by their import's id; the decisions run in transactions that are rolled back,
 * but for the one real closing, whose rows the last test removes.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the restore gaps", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let repo: AuthRepo;
  let mod: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let real: RealStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const imports: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    mod = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "admin");
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    // An admin with a real key, for the one closing that commits; its profile leaves with the world, after the last count.
    real = await world.staff("admin");
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb, RECOVERY_TABLES);
  }, 90_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.restore_gaps where import_id = any(${`{${imports.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
    await world.close();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /** A gap as the import writes it, as the migrator, committed: the class, the lost row's target and metadata. */
  async function gapOf(cls: GapClass, target: { type: string; id: string } | null = null, metadata: Record<string, unknown> = {}, actedAt = "2026-10-02T08:00:00.000Z"): Promise<string> {
    const importId = randomUUID();
    imports.push(importId);
    const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, target_type, target_id, metadata, acted_at, imported_at, class)
      values (${importId}::uuid, 7, ${hex64()}, 'case_decided', ${target?.type ?? null}, ${target?.id ?? null}, ${JSON.stringify(metadata)}::jsonb, ${actedAt}::timestamptz, now(), ${cls})
      returning id`);
    return row!.id;
  }
  const gapRow = async (q: Db | DbTx, id: string) =>
    (await q.execute<{ closed: boolean; closed_by: string | null; disposition: string | null }>(sql`select closed_at is not null as closed, closed_by, disposition from public.restore_gaps where id = ${id}::uuid`))[0]!;
  /** gap_close in a savepoint, so that a refusal leaves the test's transaction usable; answers the code or null. */
  const close = (tx: DbTx, gap: string, decision: string | null, staff: { id: string }) =>
    refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`select public.gap_close(${gap}::uuid, ${decision}::uuid, ${staff.id}::uuid)`)));
  /** One test's world: a transaction of the API's pool that is rolled back, with both staff members' profiles in it. */
  const inWorld = (fn: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<void>) =>
    rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      await staffProfile(tx, mod);
      await staffProfile(tx, admin);
      await fn(tx);
    });
  /** A reported post and a final removal of it by the moderator under R1: the plainest restriction. */
  async function removal(tx: DbTx): Promise<{ postId: string; caseId: string; decisionId: string }> {
    const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
    const { caseId } = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId));
    return { postId: p.postId, caseId, decisionId: await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] }) };
  }

  test("the CHECKs are the contracts' lists; the API role reads the gaps and writes none, and inserts a copy mark's two columns, whose time the trigger forces", async () => {
    const definition = async (table: string, name: string) =>
      (await migrateDb.execute<{ def: string }>(sql`select pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) as def from pg_constraint c where c.conrelid = ${`public.${table}`}::regclass and c.conname = ${name}`))[0]!.def;
    const listed = (def: string) => [...def.matchAll(/'([a-z_]+)'/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
    expect(listed(await definition("restore_gaps", "restore_gaps_class"))).toEqual([...GAP_CLASSES]);
    expect(listed(await definition("restore_gaps", "restore_gaps_disposition"))).toEqual([...GAP_DISPOSITIONS]);
    const privileges = async (table: string) =>
      (await migrateDb.execute<{ p: string }>(sql`select p from unnest(array['SELECT','INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE','TRUNCATE']) p where has_table_privilege('korbat_api', ${table}, p) order by p`)).map((r) => r.p);
    expect(await privileges("public.restore_gaps")).toEqual(["SELECT"]);
    expect(await privileges("public.copy_marks")).toEqual(["SELECT"]);
    const columns = await migrateDb.execute<{ column_name: string }>(
      sql`select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'copy_marks' and has_column_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.copy_marks', column_name, 'INSERT') order by column_name`,
    );
    expect(columns.map((c) => c.column_name)).toEqual(["place", "staff_id"]);
    for (const fn of ["public.gap_close(uuid, uuid, uuid)", "public.delete_restore_gaps(timestamptz)"]) {

    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`update public.restore_gaps set closed_at = now(), disposition = 'not_needed' where id = ${gap}::uuid`))))?.code).toBe("42501");
      expect((await pgError(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`delete from public.restore_gaps where id = ${gap}::uuid`))))?.code).toBe("42501");
      const [mark] = await tx.execute<{ fresh: boolean }>(sql`insert into public.copy_marks (staff_id, place) values (${mod.id}::uuid, 3) returning at > now() - interval '1 minute' as fresh`);

    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const [mark] = await tx.execute<{ fresh: boolean }>(sql`insert into public.copy_marks (staff_id, place, at) values (${mod.id}::uuid, 3, now() - interval '9 days') returning at > now() - interval '1 minute' as fresh`);
      expect(mark!.fresh).toBe(true);
    });

  test("a decision taken again closes the gap it fits, in its own transaction, as reapplied by that decision; a closed gap is refused", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const r = await removal(tx);
      const gap = await gapOf("restriction", { type: "case", id: r.caseId }, { target: { type: "post", id: r.postId } });
      expect(await close(tx, gap, r.decisionId, mod)).toBeNull();
      expect(await gapRow(tx, gap)).toEqual({ closed: true, closed_by: r.decisionId, disposition: "reapplied" });
      expect(await close(tx, gap, r.decisionId, mod)).toBe("gap_mismatch");
      // An unknown gap is not found.
      expect(await close(tx, randomUUID(), r.decisionId, mod)).toBe("not_found");
    });
  });

  test("gap_close refuses a decision that does not fit, and leaves the gap open: another class, another target, another account's, one this transaction did not make", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {

      for (const cls of ["order_effect", "seal_final", "seal_interim", "standing", "reversal", "record"] as const) {
        const gap = await gapOf(cls, { type: "case", id: r.caseId });

        expect((await gapRow(tx, gap)).closed, cls).toBe(false);

      expect(await close(tx, elsewhere, r.decisionId, mod)).toBe("gap_mismatch");
      const fits = await gapOf("restriction", { type: "case", id: r.caseId }, { target: { type: "post", id: r.postId } });
      expect(await close(tx, fits, r.decisionId, admin)).toBe("gap_mismatch");
      // A decision of another transaction (committed before this one began) is no decision taken again here.
      const [old] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.decisions where id <> ${r.decisionId}::uuid order by decided_at limit 1`);
      if (old !== undefined) expect(await close(tx, fits, old.id, mod)).toBe("gap_mismatch");
      expect((await gapRow(tx, fits)).closed).toBe(false);

  });
```
