```ts
    const gap = await gapOf("no_measure");
    /** The closing with a confirmed row of the signer's key, the commit's check run at once; rolled back either way. */
    const closing = async (named: TestStaff, signer: TestStaff): Promise<{ code: string; detail: string | null } | null> => {
      try {
        await apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
          await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
          // gap_close checks the account it is given, here an admin, before it closes.
          await tx.execute(sql`select public.gap_close(${gap}::uuid, null, ${named.id}::uuid)`);
          await appendConfirmedAudit(tx, {
            actorId: signer.id,
            keyId: signer.keyId,
            action: "gap_closed",
            targetType: "restore_gap",
            targetId: gap,
            metadata: { disposition: "not_needed" },
            staffSession: randomUUID(),
            actionHash: hex64(),
            stepUp: { authenticatorData: "AAAA", clientDataJSON: "BBBB", signature: "CCCC" },
            requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}`,
            expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60_000),
          });
          await tx.execute(sql`set constraints public.restore_gaps_confirmed immediate`);
          throw new Error("held");
        });
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof Error && err.message === "held") return null;
        const found = raised(err);
        return found === null ? { code: String(err), detail: null } : { code: found.message, detail: found.detail };
      }
      return null;
    };
    // Another account than the one named, a moderator, signed the row: only the commit's check sees it.
    const refused = await closing(admin, mod);
    expect(refused?.code).toBe("gap_mismatch");
    expect(refused?.detail).toMatch(/^actor: /);
    expect(await closing(admin, admin)).toBeNull();
    expect((await gapRow(apiDb, gap)).closed).toBe(false);
  });

  test("delete_restore_gaps: a gap closed as not needed or imported goes 12 months on, a gap a decision closed never; the copy marks that old go, but the newest", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const months = ORDER_RULES.gapKeepMonths;
      const closedGap = async (disposition: "not_needed" | "imported" | "reapplied", monthsAgo: number) => {
        const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into public.restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, acted_at, imported_at, class, closed_at, closed_by, disposition)
          values (gen_random_uuid(), 9, ${hex64()}, 'case_decided', now(), now(), 'no_measure', now() - make_interval(months => ${monthsAgo}::int, days => 1),
                  ${disposition === "reapplied" ? sql`gen_random_uuid()` : sql`null`}, ${disposition})
          returning id`);
        return row!.id;
      };
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.copy_marks`);
      const oldNeeded = await closedGap("not_needed", months);
      const oldImported = await closedGap("imported", months);
      const oldReapplied = await closedGap("reapplied", months * 3);
      const young = await closedGap("imported", months - 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.copy_marks (staff_id, place) values (${mod.id}::uuid, 3), (${mod.id}::uuid, 5)`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.copy_marks set at = now() - make_interval(months => ${months + 2}::int) where place = 3`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.copy_marks set at = now() - make_interval(months => ${months + 1}::int) where place = 5`);
      // Not before its period: a cut-off younger than gap_keep_months is refused.
      expect(await refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`select public.delete_restore_gaps(now() - make_interval(months => ${months - 1}::int))`)))).toBe("not_due");
      const [done] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select public.delete_restore_gaps(now() - make_interval(months => ${months}::int)) as n`);
      expect(done!.n).toBe(3);
      const left = (await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.restore_gaps where id = any(${`{${[oldNeeded, oldImported, oldReapplied, young].join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`)).map((r) => r.id).sort();
      expect(left).toEqual([oldReapplied, young].sort());
      expect((await tx.execute<{ place: number }>(sql`select place::int from public.copy_marks`)).map((r) => r.place)).toEqual([5]);
    });
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.restore_gaps where import_id = any(${`{${imports.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
    // The real closing's audit row stays, as every audit row does; its staff account goes with the world.
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb, RECOVERY_TABLES)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```ts
 * removal decided, a record to an authority opened and answered, the order verified from the shell, a report answered

 * another hash and a kept place with another hash are each refused whole; a hole is reported and the run before it

 * and one gap for each lost decision and each later step of a record; never a decision or a measure, and the migrator's

 * removal taken again closes its own and its statement names the lost day. The file restores the database it found.

    const done = await restoreImport(migrateDb, [{ seq: head.seq - 10, hash: (JSON.parse(tail.find((line) => placeOf(line) === head.seq - 10)!) as { hash: string }).hash }], input(tail), appOrigin);
    expect(done.ok).toBe(true);
    if (!done.ok) return;
    expect(done.lines[0]).toMatch(new RegExp(`^restore-import: places ${head.seq + 1} to [0-9]+ continue the head ${head.seq}:${head.hash} [(]300 earlier lines checked, not imported[)][.]$`));
    expect(done.lines).toContain("restore-import: gaps, in the order to take them again:");
    expect(done.lines.some((line) => line.startsWith("restore-import: 1. order_effect, order_item"))).toBe(true);
    expect(done.lines).toContain("restore-import: The app's site stays closed until gaps 1 to 1 are closed on the console's After a restore screen.");
    // No ledger row: the import writes records and gaps alone.
    expect(await count("decisions")).toBe(decisions);
    expect(await count("decision_actions")).toBe(measures);
    const [order] = await migrateDb.execute<{ opened: string; imported: boolean; verified: boolean; section_c: boolean }>(
      sql`select to_char(opened_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as opened, imported_at is not null as imported, verified_at is not null as verified, section_c from public.legal_orders where id = ${orderId}::uuid`,
    );
    expect(order).toEqual({ opened: lostOrderOpenedAt, imported: true, verified: true, section_c: true });
    const [item] = await migrateDb.execute<{ disabled: string; preserve: boolean; decision: string | null }>(
      sql`select to_char(disabled_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as disabled, preserve_until = public.order_preserve_until(disabled_at) as preserve, decision_id as decision
            from public.legal_order_items where id = ${itemId}::uuid`,
    );
    expect(item).toEqual({ disabled: lostEffectAt, preserve: true, decision: null });
    expect((await migrateDb.execute<{ frozen: boolean }>(sql`select public.post_preserved(${orderPost}::uuid) as frozen`))[0]!.frozen).toBe(true);
    expect((await migrateDb.execute<{ state: string }>(sql`select state::text from public.posts where id = ${orderPost}::uuid`))[0]!.state).toBe("visible");
    const [record] = await migrateDb.execute<{ state: string; imported: boolean; case_id: string }>(
      sql`select state, imported_at is not null as imported, case_id from public.authority_notifications where id = ${recordId}::uuid`,
    );
    expect(record).toEqual({ state: "owed", imported: true, case_id: removalCase });
    const gaps = await migrateDb.execute<{ class: string; action: string; open: boolean }>(
      sql`select class, action, closed_at is null as open from public.restore_gaps where place > ${head.seq} order by place, target_id`,
    );
    expect(gaps.filter((g) => g.open).map((g) => [g.class, g.action])).toEqual([
      ["order_effect", "order_effected"],
      ["restriction", "case_decided"],
      ["record", "notification_recorded"],
      ["no_measure", "case_decided"],
    ]);
    expect(gaps.filter((g) => !g.open).map((g) => g.action).sort()).toEqual(["notification_recorded", "order_opened", "order_recorded"]);
    const [imported] = await migrateDb.execute<{ action: string; counts: Record<string, number> }>(
      sql`select action, metadata -> 'counts' as counts from public.audit_log where chain_seq = (select seq from public.audit_head where id = 1)`,
    );
    expect(imported).toEqual({ action: "restore_imported", counts: { order_effect: 1, restriction: 1, record: 4, no_measure: 1 } });
  });

  test("the migrator's own copy of the lost decision and its measure never commits: decision_holds refuses it without a confirmed audit row", async () => {
    const decisions = await count("decisions");
    // 3f's review (proofs7): the lost answer of no breach needs no texts, so nothing refuses its row at insert and
    // decision_holds at commit is the only guard. (A copy of the lost removal is refused first, for its texts, which the
    // restore lost; the lost order decision for its case, lost with it.)
    const copied = refusal(
      migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.decisions select * from jsonb_populate_record(null::public.decisions, ${JSON.stringify(lostDecision.decision)}::jsonb)`);
        for (const action of lostDecision.actions) await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.decision_actions select * from jsonb_populate_record(null::public.decision_actions, ${JSON.stringify(action)}::jsonb)`);
      }),
    );
    expect(await copied).toBe("invalid_decision");
    expect(await count("decisions")).toBe(decisions);
    // The case stays open, as the restore left it.
    expect((await migrateDb.execute<{ open: boolean }>(sql`select closed_at is null as open from public.cases where id = ${clearedCase}::uuid`))[0]!.open).toBe(true);
  });

  test("taken again under a key: the disabling keeps its first time and its preservation, its notice stays held, and its gap closes; the removal closes its own, and its statement names the lost day", async () => {
    const view = (await orderView(moderationDeps(apiDb, { config: orderConfig() }), orderId, { role: "moderator" }))!;
    expect(view.items[0]!.gap).toBe(true);
    const again = await effectForTest(world, mod, orderId, effectParams(view));
    if (typeof again === "string") throw new Error(`the effect was not recorded: ${again}`);
    const [item] = await migrateDb.execute<{ disabled: string; preserve: boolean; decision: string }>(
      sql`select to_char(disabled_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as disabled, preserve_until = public.order_preserve_until(${lostEffectAt}::timestamptz) as preserve, decision_id as decision
            from public.legal_order_items where id = ${itemId}::uuid`,
    );
    expect([item!.disabled, item!.preserve]).toEqual([lostEffectAt, true]);
    const [held] = await migrateDb.execute<{ informed: string | null; level: string }>(
      sql`select d.informed_at::text as informed, p.moderation_level::text as level from public.decisions d join public.posts p on p.id = ${orderPost}::uuid where d.id = ${item!.decision}::uuid`,
    );
    expect(held).toEqual({ informed: null, level: "disabled" });
    const [effectGap] = await migrateDb.execute<{ disposition: string; closed_by: string }>(sql`select disposition, closed_by from public.restore_gaps where class = 'order_effect' and target_id = ${itemId}`);
    expect(effectGap).toEqual({ disposition: "reapplied", closed_by: item!.decision });
    const [removal] = await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.restore_gaps where class = 'restriction' and closed_at is null and place > ${head.seq}`);
    const decided = await world.decideAs(admin, removalCase, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] }, { gap: removal!.id });
    if (typeof decided === "string") throw new Error(`the removal was not taken again: ${decided}`);
    const [closed] = await migrateDb.execute<{ disposition: string; closed_by: string }>(sql`select disposition, closed_by from public.restore_gaps where id = ${removal!.id}::uuid`);
    expect(closed).toEqual({ disposition: "reapplied", closed_by: decided.decisionId });
    const [audit] = await migrateDb.execute<{ gap: string }>(sql`select metadata ->> 'gapId' as gap from public.audit_log where action = 'case_decided' and metadata ->> 'decisionId' = ${decided.decisionId}`);
    expect(audit!.gap).toBe(removal!.id);
    const { decisionStatement } = await import("../../src/moderation/statement");
    const statement = (await decisionStatement(apiDb, decided.decisionId))!.statement;
    expect(statement.reapplied).toEqual({ lostOn: lostRemovalAt.slice(0, 10) });
  });

  test("leaves the database as the file found it", async () => {
    await restoreForTest(migrateDb, found);
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...RECOVERY_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```ts
    reexamination: false,
    changed: false,
    reexaminable: false,
    unseen: false,
    automatic: false,
    ...more,
  });
  const noAction = outcomeWords({ outcome: "no_violation", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });

      `To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`,
      "No automated means were used to decide.",
      `You can ${COURTS}`,

    ]);
    // The page link stands at the end of its paragraph, and nothing is an anchor.

  test("a re-examination's answer and a changed outcome are final within korbat; a line that reads UNSEEN_NO_ACTION never is, re-examined again or not", () => {
    const answered = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.`);
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    expect(answered.text).not.toContain("re-examine a moderator's decision");
    const changed = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: "korbat reversed its decision to restrict it.", changed: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(changed.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    // An answer given while nobody could open the images does not spend the re-examination, also when it answered one.
    const unseenLine = { outcome: UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, unseen: true };
    const open = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(open.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: ${UNSEEN_NO_ACTION}`);
    expect(open.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(open.text).toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // Asked again before a retried mail went out: no longer re-examinable, and still not final.
    const asked = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: false })] }));
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // A line of each kind in one update: each sentence once.
    const both = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true }), line({ item: 2, outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(both.text.split(FINAL).length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(both.text.split(REEXAMINE).length - 1).toBe(1);
  });

  test("only a link that named nothing is called automatic", () => {
    const dead = outcomeWords({ outcome: "not_available", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line(), line({ item: 2, outcome: dead, automatic: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide, except for links found to name nothing on korbat, which were checked automatically.");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("If a link was wrong, send a new report with the right link.");
    const live = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line()] }));
    expect(paragraphs(live.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide.");
    expect(live.text).not.toContain("If a link was wrong");
  });

  test("the outcome's words are the contracts': ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, the scopes, the sealed phrase and UNSEEN_NO_ACTION stand in a line exactly as composed, with one full stop", () => {
    const facts = { rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null } as const;
    const outcomes = [
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", noEffect: true }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "account" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", sealed: true, scope: "account_suspect" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "quote" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", unseen: true }),
    ];
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: outcomes.map((outcome, index) => line({ item: index + 1, outcome })) }));
    const lines = paragraphs(r.text).slice(0, outcomes.length);
    outcomes.forEach((outcome, index) => expect(lines[index]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item ${index + 1} (${POST}): ${outcome}`));
    for (const sentence of [ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE, ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE, QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE, SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed, UNSEEN_NO_ACTION]) expect(r.text).toContain(sentence);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[.][.]/);
  });

  test("a folded receipt rides in the update with its page link; an update of receipts alone has another subject and none of the decisions' sentences", () => {
    const receipt = { ref: "N-ZZZZZZZZ77", time: TIME, items: POST, pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB" };
    const alone = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt], termsUrl: TERMS }));
    expect(alone.subject).toBe("korbat received your reports");
    expect(paragraphs(alone.text)).toEqual([
      `korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 at ${TIME}. It names: ${POST}.`,
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a re-examination of a decision, confirm that you sent it, or stop korbat's emails about reports to this address, open this page: http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB",
      `How korbat handles reports, and what it keeps: ${TERMS}.`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    // Two folds on one day and a line of another notice: the receipts first, the terms once, then the line and its page.
    const second = { ...receipt, ref: "N-YYYYYYYY66", pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-YYYYYYYY66#t=CCCC" };
    const full = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt, second], termsUrl: TERMS, lines: [line()], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(full.subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    const out = paragraphs(full.text);
    expect(out.slice(0, 5).map((paragraph) => paragraph.slice(0, 42))).toEqual([
      "korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "korbat received your report N-YYYYYYYY66 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "How korbat handles reports, and what it ke",
    ]);
    expect(full.text.split("How korbat handles reports").length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(out[5]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.`);
    expect(out[6]).toBe(`To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`);
    // A receipt needs the terms' address, and an update of nothing at all is a programming error.
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt] }))).toThrow(/termsUrl/);
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({}))).toThrow(/nothing/);
  });

  test("it carries only what korbat generated: no member of the data holds a report's words", () => {
    const keys = Object.keys(line()).sort();
    expect(keys).toEqual(["automatic", "changed", "item", "link", "outcome", "reexaminable", "reexamination", "ref", "unseen"]);
  });
});

describe("the mailers take the union of messages", () => {
  test("the memory mailer renders a flat message with renderTemplate and the structured one with renderNoticeUpdate, keeps the two apart, and reads a code only from a flat message", async () => {
    const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
    const structured: MailMessage = { to: "a@b.io", template: "notice_update", data: { signedIn: true, lines: [], receipts: [], pages: [] } };
    // An update of nothing is refused as the real mailer would refuse it, before it counts as sent.
    await expect(mailer.send(structured)).rejects.toThrow(/nothing/);
    expect([mailer.sent.length, mailer.updates.length]).toEqual([0, 0]);
    await mailer.send({ to: "a@b.io", template: "sign_in_code", data: { code: "111111" } });
    await mailer.send({
      to: "a@b.io",
      template: "notice_update",
      data: { signedIn: true, lines: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", item: 1, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada", outcome: "no action.", reexamination: false, changed: false, reexaminable: false, unseen: false, automatic: false }], receipts: [], pages: [] },
    });
    // The two kinds are kept apart, so a reader of the flat ones never meets a structure.
    expect(mailer.sent.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["sign_in_code"]);
    expect(mailer.updates.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["notice_update"]);
    expect(mailer.lastCodeFor("a@b.io")).toBe("111111");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.updates[0]!).subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.sent[0]!).subject).toBe("Your korbat sign-in code");
  });

  test("a time in a mail is printed as noticeTime prints it", () => {
    expect(noticeTime(new Date("2026-10-04T06:59:59.999Z"))).toBe(TIME);
  });
});

describe("3e: the statement mails of a suspension taken at once and of its lift (design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat suspended your account for 7 days, from this decision until 2026-10-11 09:30 UTC, without notice beforehand.", "The facts: The account posted a threat."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";

  test("suspension_started_at_once: its subject, its lead with the days and the end, the statement's paragraphs, where to read it, and no link", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", days: "7", endsAt: "2026-10-11 09:30 UTC", statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat suspended your account");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat suspended your korbat account for 7 days, until 2026-10-11 09:30 UTC. It did so at once, without notice beforehand; the reasons follow. You can reply and appeal in korbat from now: sign in and use the banner on any screen.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]/);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", days: "1", endsAt: "2026-10-05 09:30 UTC", statement }).text)[0]).toContain("for 1 day, until");
    // A termination's lead names no days and no end.
    const t = renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "terminate", statement });
    expect(t.subject).toBe("korbat terminated your account");
    expect(paragraphs(t.text)[0]).toBe("korbat terminated your korbat account. It did so at once, without notice beforehand; the reasons follow. You can reply and appeal in korbat from now: sign in and use the banner on any screen.");
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", statement })).toThrow(/days/);
  });

  test("suspension_lifted: a lead for each state of the period, for a lift and for a basis that broke, and none says the account is free of every measure", () => {
    const lead = (why: string, period: string) => {
      const r = renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why, period, statement });
      expect(paragraphs(r.text).slice(1)).toEqual([...lines, READ, LAST_USER]);
      return [r.subject, paragraphs(r.text)[0]];
    };
    expect(lead("lifted", "not_started")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted the suspension of your korbat account that it had announced: it never starts."]);
    expect(lead("lifted", "running")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted the suspension of your korbat account. This suspension no longer restricts your account."]);
    expect(lead("lifted", "ended")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted a past suspension of your korbat account: it no longer counts toward a later suspension."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "not_started")).toEqual(["A suspension of your account will not start", "korbat reversed a decision that the suspension it announced for your korbat account rested on. The suspension will not start."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "running")).toEqual(["A suspension of your account has ended", "The suspension of your korbat account has ended, because a decision it rested on was reversed. This suspension no longer restricts your account."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "ended")).toEqual(["A past suspension of your account no longer counts", "korbat reversed a decision that a past suspension of your account rested on; that suspension no longer counts."]);
    for (const why of ["lifted", "basis"]) {
      for (const period of ["not_started", "running", "ended"]) expect(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why, period, statement }).text).not.toMatch(/as before|handed to your mail provider|delivered/);
    }
    expect(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "terminate", why: "lifted", period: "running", statement }).subject).toBe("korbat lifted the termination of your account");
    // Task 4: a withdrawal needs the withdrawn decision's time; a why the template does not have is a programming error.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "replaced", period: "running", statement })).toThrow(/decidedAt/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "answered", period: "running", statement })).toThrow(/why/);
  });
});

describe("3e Task 4: the mails of an announced measure, of the answer to a reply, of a withdrawal, and of a termination's take-down (design, section 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat will suspend your account for 3 days. Nothing is restricted yet.", "The facts: The account had 3 active strikes."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";
  const EARLIEST = "2026-10-11 09:30 UTC";

  test("suspension_announced: its subject, its lead with the days, the window and the earliest start, the reply, then the statement; a termination's without days", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "3", window: String(STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours), earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat has decided to suspend your account: you can reply first");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `korbat has decided to suspend your korbat account for 3 days. Nothing is restricted yet. The suspension starts ${STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours} hours after korbat sent this email, and not before ${EARLIEST}.`,
      `You can reply before it starts: sign in to korbat, where this decision is always shown and a banner on every screen gives the exact time and a Reply button. A reply sent before ${EARLIEST} is certainly in time, and holds the start until a moderator has answered you.`,
      "The decision and its reasons follow.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|handed to your mail provider|delivered/);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "1", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement }).text)[0]).toContain("for 1 day.");
    const t = renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "terminate", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement });
    expect(t.subject).toBe("korbat has decided to terminate your account: you can reply first");
    expect(paragraphs(t.text)[0]).toBe(`korbat has decided to terminate your korbat account. Nothing is restricted yet. The termination starts 168 hours after korbat sent this email, and not before ${EARLIEST}.`);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement })).toThrow(/days/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "3", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement })).toThrow(/window/);
  });

  test("reply_answered: a lead for a kept and for a reversed answer, then the answer's statement", () => {
    const kept = renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "kept", statement });
    expect(kept.subject).toBe("korbat answered your reply");
    expect(paragraphs(kept.text)).toEqual(["A moderator read your reply and kept the decision. The answer and its reasons follow.", ...lines, READ, LAST_USER]);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "reversed", statement }).text)[0]).toBe("A moderator read your reply and reversed the decision. The answer follows.");
    expect(() => renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "withdrawn", statement })).toThrow(/outcome/);
  });

  test("suspension_lifted for a withdrawal: never an answer to the reply, and the sentence on the reply only when one was filed", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "replaced", decidedAt: "2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", replied: "true", statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat withdrew the suspension it announced");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat withdrew the suspension of your korbat account that it announced on 2026-10-04 09:30 UTC, because it is taking another measure on your account. This is not a decision on your reply.",
      "The decision about the other measure reaches you separately.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "terminate", why: "replaced", decidedAt: "2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", replied: "false", statement }).text)[0]).toBe(
      "korbat withdrew the termination of your korbat account that it announced on 2026-10-04 09:30 UTC, because it is taking another measure on your account.",
    );
  });

  test("termination_final: the decision's day, that it is final, what is deleted, the sentence on sealed images only when images are sealed, and never that korbat keeps nothing when they are", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "false" });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat has closed your terminated account");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat's decision of 2026-04-04 09:30 UTC to terminate your korbat account is final: the time to appeal has passed, or your appeal was answered and the decision kept, and no reply of yours is unanswered.",
      "korbat has closed the account and is now deleting its posts and profile and every image it has not sealed, as that decision said. This cannot be undone. The handle stays reserved, so nobody else can take it.",
      "korbat keeps nothing to recognise a new account of yours by. A new account that carries on what this one was terminated for breaks korbat's terms.",
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    const sealed = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "true" });
    expect(paragraphs(sealed.text)[2]).toBe(
      "korbat keeps nothing to recognise a new account of yours by. Images of yours that korbat sealed stay with it for the authorities alone, as the decision that sealed them said. A new account that carries on what this one was terminated for breaks korbat's terms.",
    );
    for (const mail of [r, sealed]) expect(mail.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|@[a-z]/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("termination_final", { imagesSealed: "false" })).toThrow(/decided/);
    // 3f (7.15 step 8): a termination's take-down holds the address as a deletion does, and its mail says so the same way.
    const held = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "true", heldUntil: "2026-04-11", holdFinal: "true" });
    expect(paragraphs(held.text)[3]).toBe(ACCOUNT_DELETED_HELD.final("2026-04-11"));
    expect(paragraphs(held.text).at(-1)).toBe(LAST_USER);
  });
});

describe("3e Task 5: the statement mails of a warning about reporting and of a restriction of it (design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat warns you about your reports. Nothing is restricted.", "The facts: In the 90 days up to 2026-10-04 the account sent 8 reports."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";

      ...lines,

      LAST_USER,
    ]);

  });
});

describe("3f: the staff mails whose words are their push's (W.4)", () => {
  const NOW = "2026-10-16T09:00:00.000Z";
  /** A kind's mail as the alert tick sends it: the row's facts as text, and the time it is sent, for the day of its times. */
  const mail = (template: TemplateName, facts: Record<string, string>) => renderTemplate(template as Parameters<typeof renderTemplate>[0], { ...facts, now: NOW });

  test("each is the kind's title after korbat:, then its sentence and its line of what to do from ALERT_TEXTS, and the staff mails' last sentence", () => {
    const cases: [TemplateName, AlertKind, Record<string, string>][] = [
      ["contact_mail", "contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }],
      ["contact_mail_escalated", "contact_mail_escalated", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }],
      ["order_due", "order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: "15" }],
      ["mailbox_unreachable", "mailbox_unreachable", { since: "2026-10-15T23:00:00.000Z" }],
      ["alert_channel_down", "alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" }],
      // Task 2: an order opened (with a deadline, and without a time of receipt), a record corrected, the daily unverified.
      ["order_opened", "order_opened", { items: "2", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", unknown: "0" }],
      ["order_opened", "order_opened", { items: "1", unknown: "1" }],
      ["order_corrected", "order_corrected", { count: "2", at: "2026-10-16T08:50:00.000Z" }],
      ["order_unverified", "order_unverified", { count: "1", textsMissing: "1", holdsOpen: "0", oldestAt: "2026-10-15T22:00:00.000Z" }],
    ];
    for (const [template, kind, facts] of cases) {
      const r = mail(template, facts);
      const counted = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(facts).map(([name, value]) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? value : Number(value)]));
      const text = renderAlert(kind, counted, new Date(NOW));
      expect(r.subject, template).toBe(`korbat: ${text.title}`);
      expect(paragraphs(r.text), template).toEqual([text.sentence, text.todo, LAST_STAFF]);
      linkless(r);
    }
    expect(paragraphs(mail("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }).text)[0]).toBe(
      "Mail at the authorities' contact point, received 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",
    );
    expect(mail("order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: "0" }).subject).toBe("korbat: 0 minutes left");
  });

  test("3f's review: every kind whose mail is its sentence is one the alert tick mails, and each has its template: Task 5's two daily kinds too", () => {
    expect([...TICK_MAILED_KINDS].sort()).toEqual([...SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS].sort());
    for (const kind of SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS) {
      const facts = Object.fromEntries(ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts.map((name) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" : "2"]));
      const r = mail(kind as TemplateName, facts);
      expect(r.subject, kind).toBe(`korbat: ${renderAlert(kind, Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(facts).map(([n, v]) => [n, isTimeFact(n) ? v : Number(v)])), new Date(NOW)).title}`);
      linkless(r);
    }
  });

  test("they carry counts and UTC times only: a fact of another name, a time that is no time and a missing one are refused, and no handle or address is printed", () => {
    expect(() => mail("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z" })).toThrow(/dueAt/);
    expect(() => mail("mailbox_unreachable", { since: "yesterday" })).toThrow(/since/);
    expect(() => mail("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z", handle: "mod_anna" })).toThrow(/handle/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" })).toThrow(/now/);
    for (const template of ["contact_mail", "contact_mail_escalated", "order_due", "mailbox_unreachable", "alert_channel_down", "order_opened", "order_corrected", "order_unverified"] as const) {
      const facts = Object.fromEntries(ALERT_KINDS[template].facts.map((name) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" : "3"]));
      expect(mail(template, facts).text, template).not.toMatch(/@/);
    }
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { ACCOUNT_DELETION_WORDS } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { ACCOUNT_DELETED_HELD, renderTemplate } from "../../src/mail/templates";

describe("mail templates", () => {
  test("code emails carry the code and expiry, and no links or images", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("sign_in_code", { code: "123456" });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("Your korbat sign-in code");
    expect(r.text).toContain("123456");
    expect(r.text).toContain("10 minutes");
    expect(r.html).toContain("123456");
    expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |https?:\/\//);
  });
  test("every template renders and HTML escapes its data", () => {
    const data = {
      code: "123456",
      deviceLabel: "<b>Chrome</b> on Windows",
      notMeUrl: "http://localhost:8081/not-me/abc",
      revertUrl: "http://localhost:8081/email-revert/def",
      minutes: "15",
      count: "3",
      email: "new<address>@example.com",
      name: "<i>Work</i> laptop",
      time: "2026-09-25 10:00 UTC",
      removeUrl: "http://localhost:8081/passkey-remove/ghi",
      browser: "Firefox on Linux",
      names: '"Blue key", "Red key"',
      ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23",
      items: "http://localhost:8081/post/0190f3a2-7c1e-7b1a-9f00-0123456789ab",
      pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ABCDEFGH23#t=mail-token",
      termsUrl: "http://localhost:8081/terms",
      oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC",
      handle: "mod_anna",
      limit: "10",
      // 3f's review (people4): whether the phone alerts are on, which the urgent-lane and waiting mails say.
      phones: "on",
      // Moderation cases: a statement's subject key and paragraphs, the queue-age alert's pairs, and what a decision lifted.
      subject: "post_restricted",
      statement: "korbat removed your post of 2026-10-01 12:00 UTC: other people can no longer see it.\nThis applies everywhere korbat is available and has no end date.",
      lane1Count: "2",
      lane1Oldest: "2026-10-03 06:59 UTC",
      interimCount: "1",
      what: "dismissed",
    };
    for (const template of [
      "sign_in_code",
      "sign_up_code",
      "reauth_code",
      "new_device",
      "account_locked",
      "mfa_enabled",
      "mfa_disabled",
      "password_changed",
      "recovery_codes_regenerated",
      "sessions_revoked_all",
      "email_change_code",
      "email_changed",
      "email_change_reverted",
      "badge_verified",
      "badge_removed",
      "delete_account_code",
      "account_deleted",
      "passkey_added",
      "passkey_removed",
      "passkey_suspect",
      "recovery_code_used",
      "staff_key_added",
      "staff_session_started",
      "staff_key_suspect",
      "staff_keys_revoked",
      "notice_received",
      "moderation_urgent",
      "moderation_reads",
      "moderation_reveal",
      "moderation_decision",
      "moderation_waiting",
      "moderation_burst",
      "moderation_csam_lifted",
    ] as const) {
      const r = renderTemplate(template, data);
      expect(r.subject.length, template).toBeGreaterThan(5);
      expect(r.text.length, template).toBeGreaterThan(20);
      // Links stay plain text (new_device carries the not-me URL that way); nothing is ever an anchor or an image.
      expect(r.html, template).not.toMatch(/<img|<a /);
    }
    const newDevice = renderTemplate("new_device", data);
    expect(newDevice.html).toContain("&lt;b&gt;Chrome&lt;/b&gt;");
    expect(newDevice.text).toContain("http://localhost:8081/not-me/abc");
    const emailChanged = renderTemplate("email_changed", data);
    expect(emailChanged.html).toContain("new&lt;address&gt;@example.com");
    expect(emailChanged.text).toContain("new<address>@example.com");
    expect(emailChanged.text).toContain("http://localhost:8081/email-revert/def");
  });
  test("the mails that carry a lockdown link, and the note after one ran, say what the lockdown does (1c design, section 7.6)", () => {
    // The link's page says the same before the owner opens it (Task 7); the mail is where they first read it.
    const lockdownWording = (text: string) => {
      expect(text).toMatch(/signs out every session|every session was signed out/);
      expect(text).toMatch(/removes (your|the) password|password was removed/);
      expect(text).toMatch(/passkey/);
      expect(text).toMatch(/two-factor authentication/);
      expect(text).toMatch(/the day before/);
    };
    const newDevice = renderTemplate("new_device", { deviceLabel: "Chrome on Windows", notMeUrl: "http://localhost:8081/not-me/abc" });
    expect(newDevice.text).toContain("Chrome on Windows");
    expect(newDevice.text).toContain("24 hours");
    expect(newDevice.text).toContain("http://localhost:8081/not-me/abc");
    lockdownWording(newDevice.text);
    const changed = renderTemplate("email_changed", { email: "new@example.com", revertUrl: "http://localhost:8081/email-revert/abc" });
    expect(changed.text).toContain("24 hours");
    expect(changed.text).toMatch(/back to this address/);
    expect(changed.text).toContain("http://localhost:8081/email-revert/abc");
    lockdownWording(changed.text);
    const reverted = renderTemplate("email_change_reverted", {});
    expect(reverted.text).toMatch(/back at this address/);
    expect(reverted.text).not.toMatch(/https?:\/\//);
    lockdownWording(reverted.text);
  });
  test("a recovery code spent at re-authentication is announced, without a link", () => {
    const used = renderTemplate("recovery_code_used", {});
    expect(used.subject).toBe("A recovery code was used on your korbat account");
    expect(used.text).toMatch(/recovery code/);
    expect(used.text).toMatch(/once/);
    expect(used.text).toMatch(/If this was not you/);
    expect(used.text).not.toMatch(/https?:\/\//);
  });
  test("the account lifecycle templates say what happened and what to do if it was not the owner", () => {
    const changeCode = renderTemplate("email_change_code", { code: "654321" });
    expect(changeCode.text).toContain("654321");
    expect(changeCode.text).toContain("10 minutes");
    const changed = renderTemplate("email_changed", { email: "new@example.com", revertUrl: "http://localhost:8081/email-revert/abc" });
    expect(changed.text).toContain("new@example.com");
    expect(changed.text).toMatch(/stays? signed in/);
    expect(changed.text).toMatch(/If this was not you, open this link within 24 hours\./);
    expect(changed.text).toMatch(/: http:\/\/localhost:8081\/email-revert\/abc$/m);
    // A change while an earlier change's link is still out sends no link of its own, and says where the one that works went.
    const again = renderTemplate("email_changed", { email: "new@example.com" });
    expect(again.text).toContain("new@example.com");
    expect(again.text).not.toMatch(/https?:\/\//);
    expect(again.text).toMatch(/less than a day ago/);
    const reverted = renderTemplate("email_change_reverted", {});
    expect(reverted.text).toMatch(/back at this address/);
    expect(reverted.text).toMatch(/every session/i);
    const deleteCode = renderTemplate("delete_account_code", { code: "111222" });
    expect(deleteCode.text).toContain("111222");
    expect(deleteCode.text).toMatch(/delete/i);
    expect(deleteCode.text).toMatch(/revoke|sign out/i);
    expect(renderTemplate("account_deleted", {}).text).toMatch(/cannot be undone/);
    // Both deletion mails say what is removed and what korbat keeps for a case, in the one sentence the deletion screen says
    // too; neither says that everything is gone for good.
    for (const mail of [deleteCode, renderTemplate("account_deleted", {})]) {
      expect(mail.text).toContain(ACCOUNT_DELETION_WORDS);
      expect(mail.text).not.toMatch(/for good|are gone/);
    }
    // 3f (W.5): with the address held for a report, the paragraph of the seal that holds it, with its last day; never both.
    const final = renderTemplate("account_deleted", { heldUntil: "2026-10-24", holdFinal: "true" });
    const deciding = renderTemplate("account_deleted", { heldUntil: "2026-10-24", holdFinal: "false" });
    expect(final.text).toContain(ACCOUNT_DELETED_HELD.final("2026-10-24"));
    expect(final.text).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_DELETED_HELD.deciding("2026-10-24"));
    expect(deciding.text).toContain(ACCOUNT_DELETED_HELD.deciding("2026-10-24"));
    expect(deciding.text).not.toMatch(/report them to the authorities|to the authorities/);
    for (const mail of [final, deciding]) {
      expect(mail.text).toContain(ACCOUNT_DELETION_WORDS);
      expect(mail.text).toContain("2026-10-24 at the latest");
      expect(mail.text).toMatch(/complain to a data protection authority, and go to court/);
      expect(mail.text).not.toMatch(/object|@|http/i);
    }
    // Without a hold the mail is the one wording for every account.
    expect(renderTemplate("account_deleted", {}).text).not.toMatch(/email address, and nothing else/);
    expect(renderTemplate("badge_verified", {}).text).toMatch(/verified/i);
    expect(renderTemplate("badge_removed", {}).text).toMatch(/removed/i);
  });
  test("the passkey templates name the passkey, say what happened and what to do, and never let the name become HTML", () => {
    const name = `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)> "Work" laptop`;
    const removeUrl = "http://localhost:8081/passkey-remove/abc";
    const added = renderTemplate("passkey_added", { name, deviceLabel: "Chrome on Windows", time: "2026-09-25 10:00 UTC", removeUrl });
    expect(added.subject).toBe("A passkey was added to your korbat account");
    expect(added.text).toContain(name);
    expect(added.text).toContain("Chrome on Windows");
    expect(added.text).toContain("2026-09-25 10:00 UTC");
    expect(added.text).toContain(removeUrl);
    expect(added.text).toContain("7 days");
    // What the link does (the lockdown of the 1c design, section 7.6), before the owner opens it.
    expect(added.text).toMatch(/removes? (this|the) passkey/);
    expect(added.text).toMatch(/sign(s)? out every session/);
    expect(added.text).toMatch(/password/);
    expect(added.text).toMatch(/two-factor authentication/);
    expect(added.text).toMatch(/the day before/);
    expect(added.html).toContain("&lt;img src=x onerror=alert(1)&gt; &quot;Work&quot; laptop");
    expect(added.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a /);
    expect(added.html).toContain(removeUrl);

    const removed = renderTemplate("passkey_removed", { name, time: "2026-09-25 11:00 UTC" });
    expect(removed.subject).toBe("A passkey was removed from your korbat account");
    expect(removed.text).toContain(name);
    expect(removed.text).toContain("2026-09-25 11:00 UTC");
    expect(removed.text).not.toMatch(/https?:\/\//);
    expect(removed.html).toContain("&lt;img src=x onerror=alert(1)&gt;");
    expect(removed.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a /);

    const suspect = renderTemplate("passkey_suspect", { name });
    expect(suspect.subject).toBe("A passkey on your korbat account was switched off");
    expect(suspect.text).toContain(name);
    expect(suspect.text).toMatch(/copy/);
    expect(suspect.text).toMatch(/switched (it|that passkey) off/);
    expect(suspect.text).toMatch(/remove it/i);
    expect(suspect.text).toMatch(/add a new one/);
    expect(suspect.text).not.toMatch(/https?:\/\//);
    expect(suspect.html).toContain("&lt;img src=x onerror=alert(1)&gt;");
    expect(suspect.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a /);
  });
  describe("the staff mails (3a design, section 7)", () => {
    const LAST = "korbat never puts a link in a staff email.";
    const name = `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)> "Blue" key`;

    /** Plain paragraphs with no link of any kind, the last one saying so; and a user-written name never becomes HTML. */
    function linkless(template: string, r: { text: string; html: string }) {
      expect(r.text, template).not.toMatch(/https?:|www\.|:\/\//);
      expect(r.html, template).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=|https?:/);
      expect(r.text.trimEnd().split("\n\n").at(-1), template).toBe(LAST);
    }

    test("staff_key_added names the key and the time, and tells the person to go to the operator if it was not them", () => {
      const r = renderTemplate("staff_key_added", { name, time: "2026-10-01 09:30 UTC" });
      expect(r.subject).toBe("A staff key was added to your korbat staff account");
      expect(r.text).toBe(
        [
          `A staff key named "${name}" was registered for your korbat staff account at 2026-10-01 09:30 UTC. It can open the staff console.`,
          "If this was you, there is nothing to do. If not, tell the operator at once; they revoke the key with the staff command line.",
          LAST,
        ].join("\n\n") + "\n",
      );
      expect(r.html).toContain("&lt;img src=x onerror=alert(1)&gt; &quot;Blue&quot; key");
      linkless("staff_key_added", r);
    });

    test("staff_session_started names the key, the browser and the time", () => {
      const r = renderTemplate("staff_session_started", { name, browser: "Firefox on Linux", time: "2026-10-01 09:31 UTC" });
      expect(r.subject).toBe("A staff session started on the korbat console");
      expect(r.text).toBe(
        [
          `A staff session was started on the korbat console at 2026-10-01 09:31 UTC with your staff key "${name}", from Firefox on Linux.`,
          "If this was you, there is nothing to do. If not, someone holds that key: tell the operator at once; they revoke it and every session it opened with the staff command line.",
          LAST,
        ].join("\n\n") + "\n",
      );
      linkless("staff_session_started", r);
    });

    test("staff_key_suspect says the key was switched off as a likely copy, and never sends the person to the app's Security screen", () => {
      const r = renderTemplate("staff_key_suspect", { name });
      expect(r.subject).toBe("A staff key on your korbat staff account was switched off");
      expect(r.text).toBe(
        [
          `A use of your staff key "${name}" on the korbat console (a sign-in or a confirmation) looked like a copy of it, so korbat switched that key off and ended every staff session it opened. It can no longer open the console.`,
          "Ask the operator for a link to register a new key. If you did not use it just now, tell them so: someone else holds a copy of the key.",
          LAST,
        ].join("\n\n") + "\n",
      );
      expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/Security/);
      linkless("staff_key_suspect", r);
    });

    test("staff_keys_revoked lists the keys and the time", () => {
      const r = renderTemplate("staff_keys_revoked", { names: `"${name}", "Red key"`, time: "2026-10-01 09:32 UTC" });
      expect(r.subject).toBe("Staff keys revoked on your korbat staff account");
      expect(r.text).toBe(
        [
          `These staff keys of your korbat staff account were revoked at 2026-10-01 09:32 UTC: "${name}", "Red key". They can no longer open the console, and every staff session they opened has ended.`,
          "If you expected this, there is nothing to do. If not, ask the operator why.",
          LAST,
        ].join("\n\n") + "\n",
      );
      linkless("staff_keys_revoked", r);
    });

    test("each staff mail needs its data", () => {
      expect(() => renderTemplate("staff_key_added", { name: "Blue key" })).toThrow(/time/);
      expect(() => renderTemplate("staff_key_added", { time: "2026-10-01 09:30 UTC" })).toThrow(/name/);
      expect(() => renderTemplate("staff_session_started", { name: "Blue key", time: "2026-10-01 09:31 UTC" })).toThrow(/browser/);
      expect(() => renderTemplate("staff_key_suspect", {})).toThrow(/name/);
      expect(() => renderTemplate("staff_keys_revoked", { time: "2026-10-01 09:32 UTC" })).toThrow(/names/);
    });
  });

  describe("the moderation mails of reports and notices (3c design, section 7.15)", () => {
    const LAST_USER = "korbat staff never ask for your password or a code, and korbat does not read replies to this email.";
    const LAST_STAFF = "korbat never puts a link in a staff email.";
    const POST_LINK = "http://localhost:8081/post/0190f3a2-7c1e-7b1a-9f00-0123456789ab";
    const ACCOUNT_LINK = "http://localhost:8081/u/ada";
    const received = { ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", time: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", items: `${POST_LINK}, ${ACCOUNT_LINK}`, termsUrl: "http://localhost:8081/terms" };
    const paragraphs = (text: string) => text.trimEnd().split("\n\n");

    test("notice_received to a signed-out notifier: the reference, the time, the links, and the page with the mail token in its fragment", () => {
      const pageUrl = "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ABCDEFGH23#t=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA";
      const r = renderTemplate("notice_received", { ...received, pageUrl });
      expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat received your report N-ABCDEFGH23");
      expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
        `korbat received your report N-ABCDEFGH23 at 2026-10-04 06:59 UTC. It names: ${POST_LINK}, ${ACCOUNT_LINK}.`,
        "A moderator decides each item that names something on korbat; a link that names nothing is answered automatically. You get one email with every decision, at most once a day.",
        `To see where your report stands, ask for a re-examination of a decision, confirm that you sent it, or stop korbat's emails about reports to this address, open this page: ${pageUrl}`,
        "How korbat handles reports, and what it keeps: http://localhost:8081/terms.",
        LAST_USER,
      ]);
      // The page link stands at the end of its paragraph, so nothing after it can be taken for a part of the token.
      expect(r.text).toMatch(/#t=A{43}$/m);
      expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=/);
    });

    test("notice_received to an account: no page link, and where to follow the report in the app", () => {
      const r = renderTemplate("notice_received", received);
      expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
        `korbat received your report N-ABCDEFGH23 at 2026-10-04 06:59 UTC. It names: ${POST_LINK}, ${ACCOUNT_LINK}.`,
        "A moderator decides each item that names something on korbat; a link that names nothing is answered automatically. You get one email with every decision, at most once a day.",
        "You can follow it in korbat under Settings, Cases, Your reports.",
        "How korbat handles reports, and what it keeps: http://localhost:8081/terms.",
        LAST_USER,
      ]);
      expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[/]notice[/]|#t=/);
    });

    test("notice_received carries only what korbat generated, and needs each of its fields", () => {
      expect(() => renderTemplate("notice_received", { ...received, ref: "" })).toThrow(/ref/);
      for (const key of ["ref", "time", "items", "termsUrl"] as const) {
        const { [key]: _left, ...rest } = received;
        expect(() => renderTemplate("notice_received", rest), key).toThrow(new RegExp(key));
      }
      // A report's words have no field to travel in: a member the template does not know is not printed.
      const r = renderTemplate("notice_received", { ...received, explanation: "the notifier's own words", name: "Ada" });
      expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/the notifier's own words|Ada/);
    });

    test("moderation_urgent gives the count and the oldest time, no link and no content, and says that the same alert went to the phone on call", () => {
      const r = renderTemplate("moderation_urgent", { count: "3", oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", phones: "on" });
      expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat: a case is waiting in the urgent lane");
      expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
        "3 cases in the urgent lane (child sexual abuse or exploitation, direct threats, violence, public security or self-harm) are waiting; the oldest since 2026-10-04 06:59 UTC.",
        "Open the staff console. The same alert went to the phone on call.",
        LAST_STAFF,
      ]);
      expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|:[/][/]/);
      expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=|https?:/);
      // One case reads as one: the only case is the oldest, so the sentence gives its time alone.
      const one = renderTemplate("moderation_urgent", { count: "1", oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", phones: "on" });
      expect(one.subject).toBe("korbat: a case is waiting in the urgent lane");
      expect(paragraphs(one.text)).toEqual([
        "1 case in the urgent lane (child sexual abuse or exploitation, direct threats, violence, public security or self-harm) is waiting, since 2026-10-04 06:59 UTC.",
        "Open the staff console. The same alert went to the phone on call.",
        LAST_STAFF,
      ]);
      for (const count of ["2", "10", "11", "21"]) {
        expect(renderTemplate("moderation_urgent", { count, oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", phones: "on" }).text, count).toContain(`${count} cases in the urgent lane (child sexual abuse or exploitation, direct threats, violence, public security or self-harm) are waiting; the oldest since 2026-10-04 06:59 UTC.`);
      }
      expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_urgent", { count: "3", phones: "on" })).toThrow(/oldest/);
      expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_urgent", { oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", phones: "on" })).toThrow(/count/);
    });

    test("3f's review (people4): with the phone alerts switched off, moderation_urgent says that it is the only alert and never that one went to a phone", () => {
      const off = renderTemplate("moderation_urgent", { count: "3", oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", phones: "off" });
      expect(paragraphs(off.text)).toEqual([
        "3 cases in the urgent lane (child sexual abuse or exploitation, direct threats, violence, public security or self-harm) are waiting; the oldest since 2026-10-04 06:59 UTC.",
        "Open the staff console. Phone alerts are switched off on this server, so this email is the only alert.",
        LAST_STAFF,
      ]);
      expect(off.text).not.toContain("went to");
      // Whether the phones are on is no default: a mail that does not say is a programming error.
      expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_urgent", { count: "3", oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC" })).toThrow(/phones/);
    });

    test("moderation_reads names the staff account and the limit it reached, tells its holder what to do, and carries no link", () => {
      const r = renderTemplate("moderation_reads", { handle: "mod_anna", limit: "400" });
      expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat: a staff account reached its daily case limit");
      expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
        "The staff account @mod_anna opened 400 different cases today and cannot open others until midnight UTC.",
        "Every staff account gets this email. If @mod_anna is your account and you did not open them, someone else holds your key: tell the operator at once.",
        "If that was not expected, ask them. The operator raises the limit with staff.js limits.",
        LAST_STAFF,
      ]);
      expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|:[/][/]/);
      expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=|https?:/);
      expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_reads", { handle: "mod_anna" })).toThrow(/limit/);
      expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_reads", { limit: "400" })).toThrow(/handle/);
    });

    test("moderation_reveal names the staff account, the time, the day's count and the limit, never the case or who was revealed, and carries no link", () => {
      const data = { handle: "mod_anna", time: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", count: "3", limit: "10" };
      const r = renderTemplate("moderation_reveal", data);
      expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat: a staff account revealed who sent a report");
      expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
        "The staff account @mod_anna revealed who sent a report or notice at 2026-10-04 06:59 UTC. That is 3 of the 10 reveals one staff account may make today (UTC).",
        "Every staff account gets this email. If @mod_anna is your account and you did not reveal it, someone else holds your key: tell the operator at once.",
        "The staff console's home screen lists every reveal of the last 30 days with its case. If this one was not expected, ask them; if their key may be in someone else's hands, the operator revokes it with staff.js revoke.",
        LAST_STAFF,
      ]);
      expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|:[/][/]/);
      expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=|https?:/);
      for (const key of Object.keys(data)) {
        const { [key]: _left, ...rest } = data as Record<string, string>;
        expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_reveal", rest), key).toThrow(new RegExp(key));
      }
      // Only what korbat generated: a name, a case or a reason handed over by mistake appears nowhere.
      const more = renderTemplate("moderation_reveal", { ...data, name: "Ada Lovelace", caseId: "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a", reason: "the reason's own words" });
      expect(more.text).toBe(r.text);
    });
  });

  test("missing template data is a programming error", () => {
    expect(() => renderTemplate("sign_in_code", {})).toThrow(/code/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("passkey_added", { name: "Phone", deviceLabel: "Chrome on Windows", time: "2026-09-25 10:00 UTC" })).toThrow(/removeUrl/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("passkey_added", { deviceLabel: "Chrome on Windows", time: "2026-09-25 10:00 UTC", removeUrl: "http://localhost:8081/passkey-remove/abc" })).toThrow(/name/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("passkey_removed", { name: "Phone" })).toThrow(/time/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("passkey_suspect", {})).toThrow(/name/);
  });
```

```ts
import { PgDialect } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import type { SQL } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { ALERT_KINDS } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { AuthForModeration, StaffMessage } from "../src/auth";
import { MemoryStore, type RateLimitStore } from "../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { URGENT_ALERT_KEY, URGENT_ALERT_WINDOW_MS, alertFacts, alertUrgentLane, staffAlert } from "../src/moderation/alerts";
import { createBackground, type ModerationDeps } from "../src/moderation/context";

/**
 * The staff alerts' throttle, their second leg and the work a request starts without waiting for it (3c design, sections
 * 7.1 step 5 and 7.12; 3f design, sections 5 and 7.2), without a database: the limit store is the in-memory one or a
 * stand-in that fails, the auth module a stand-in that takes, or does not take, the mail, and the database a stand-in
 * that records each statement. After the throttle, staffAlert writes one row of alert_outbox, which the watcher pushes,
 * then mails as 3c did; for 3c's and 3e's kinds, whose mail says more than the row's facts, it then marks the row mailed
 * whether or not an address took the mail, so the alert tick never renders such a mail from a row.
 */

const message: StaffMessage = { template: "moderation_urgent", count: 2, oldest: new Date("2026-10-04T06:59:59.123Z"), phones: true };
const dialect = new PgDialect();

/** What the alert needs: a store, an auth module whose mailStaff answers as scripted, a log that keeps its warnings, and a database that records. */
function world(options: { accepted?: number[]; limits?: RateLimitStore; waiting?: { n: number; oldest: string | null }; insertFails?: boolean; notify?: "on" | "off" } = {}) {
  let now = 1_000_000;
  const store = options.limits ?? new MemoryStore(() => now);
  const mails: StaffMessage[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const accepted = [...(options.accepted ?? [])];
  const statements: { text: string; params: unknown[] }[] = [];
  /** The order of what happened: each row written, each mail, each row marked mailed. */
  const order: string[] = [];
  let ids = 40;
  const execute = async (statement: SQL) => {
    const q = dialect.sqlToQuery(statement);
    statements.push({ text: q.sql, params: q.params });
    if (/insert into public[.]alert_outbox/.test(q.sql)) {
      if (options.insertFails) throw new Error("the database refused the row");
      order.push(`row ${q.params[0]}`);
      return [{ id: String(++ids) }];
    }
    if (/update public[.]alert_outbox set mailed_at/.test(q.sql)) {
      order.push("marked");
      return [];
    }
    // The one read the urgent alert makes: how many cases wait in the urgent lane, and since when.
    return [options.waiting ?? { n: 2, oldest: "2026-10-04T06:59:59.123Z" }];
  };
  const deps = {
    // 3f's review (people4): whether the phone alerts are on, which the urgent lane's mail says.
    config: { NOTIFY: options.notify ?? "on" } as ModerationDeps["config"],
    limits: store,
    auth: {
      mailStaff: async (sent: StaffMessage) => {
        mails.push(sent);
        order.push(`mail ${sent.template}`);
        return accepted.length > 0 ? accepted.shift()! : 1;
      },
    } as unknown as AuthForModeration,
    log: { warn: (_fields: unknown, text: string) => warnings.push(text), error: (_fields: unknown, text: string) => warnings.push(text) } as unknown as ModerationDeps["log"],
    apiDb: { execute, transaction: async <T>(run: (tx: { execute: typeof execute }) => Promise<T>) => run({ execute }) } as unknown as ModerationDeps["apiDb"],
  };
  const rows = () => statements.filter((s) => /insert into public[.]alert_outbox/.test(s.text)).map((s) => s.params);
  return { deps, mails, warnings, store, statements, order, rows, advance: (ms: number) => (now += ms) };
}

describe("a staff alert is sent at most once in its key's window", () => {

    expect(w.rows()).toHaveLength(2);

describe("the work a request starts and does not wait for", () => {
  test("settle resolves once every task has ended, those started meanwhile included; a task that throws is logged and stops nothing", async () => {
    const errors: unknown[] = [];
    const background = createBackground({ error: (fields: { err: unknown }) => errors.push(fields.err) } as unknown as pino.Logger);
    const done: string[] = [];
    let release!: () => void;
    const held = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      release = resolve;
    });
    background.start(async () => {
      await held;
      done.push("first");
      // A task may start another: settle waits for that one too.
      background.start(async () => {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20));
        done.push("started meanwhile");
      });
    });
    const failure = new Error("the relay fell over");
    background.start(async () => {
      throw failure;
    });
    let settled = false;
    const settling = background.settle().then(() => {
      settled = true;
    });
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20));
    expect(settled).toBe(false);
    expect(errors).toEqual([failure]);
    release();
    await settling;
    expect(done).toEqual(["first", "started meanwhile"]);
    // With nothing running, settle resolves at once.
    await background.settle();
  });
});
```

```tsx
 * not one of the old ones, so no number is typed. The rulebook, the measures' labels and the outcomes' phrases are held
 * the same way. 3e (design, W.7) adds four sections, "Strikes", "Suspension and termination", "Reporting in bad faith" and
 * "Handles", whose numbers are STANDING_RULES', REPLY_AIM_HOURS', RETENTION.mailGiveUpDays' and APPEAL_MONTHS', and grows
 * RETENTION by three members: two numbers and one phrase, which the terms print as they print a rule's text. 3f (design,
 * W.6) adds "Authorities' orders" and "Contact point for authorities", rewrites "Terrorist content", grows four sections
 * by sentences and RETENTION by four members read from ORDER_RULES, whose two other numbers the terms print are held too.
 */
vi.mock("expo-router", () => ({
  Link: ({ href, children }: { href: string; children: ReactElement }) => cloneElement(children, { href } as object),
}));

type Contracts = typeof contracts;
type Rules = typeof rules;
type TermsModule = typeof terms;
type Section = { title: string; body: string };

const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
/** The markup's text as a reader sees it: tags dropped, entities read, spaces collapsed. */
const textOf = (markup: string): string =>
  markup
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
    .replace(/&#x27;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&gt;/g, ">")
    .replace(/&amp;/g, "&")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();

/** The sections 3c and 3e wrote or rewrote whole; of "Your data" they wrote every paragraph after the first, which older designs wrote. */
const MODERATION_TITLES = ["What you can post", "The rules", "Reports and notices", "How moderators decide", "Appeals", "Strikes", "Suspension and termination", "Reporting in bad faith", "Handles", "Authorities' orders", "Terrorist content", "Contact point for authorities"];
const bodyOf = (t: TermsModule, title: string): string => t.TERMS_SECTIONS.find((section: Section) => section.title === title)?.body ?? "";
const paragraphsOf = (t: TermsModule, title: string): string[] => t.termsParagraphs(bodyOf(t, title));
/** What 3c added to "Your data". */
const dataParagraphs = (t: TermsModule): string[] => paragraphsOf(t, "Your data").slice(1);
/** The terms' moderation text, section by section: the name of the section each sentence is looked for in, and its text. */
const moderationText = (t: TermsModule): Record<string, string> => ({ ...Object.fromEntries(MODERATION_TITLES.map((title) => [title, bodyOf(t, title)])), "Your data": dataParagraphs(t).join(" ") });

/** A count as the terms print it: a small number as a word, and its noun in the singular or the plural. */
const count = (n: number, one: string): string => `${numberWord(n)} ${n === 1 ? one : `${one}s`}`;
/** A share as the terms print it: half as a word, any other as a percentage. */
const share = (fraction: number): string => (fraction === 0.5 ? "half" : `${fraction * 100} percent`);
```
