```ts
/**
 * The dispatch job (3c design, sections 7.8 and 7.12): every ten minutes it repeats the staff alerts that are still due,
 * runs the daily release once its hour has come, sends the receipts and statements a relay failure left pending, mails
 * each address and account one update of the outcomes released to it, and gives up what stayed unsent for five days.
 *
 * A round runs its steps in the order 5, 3, 1, 2, 4, 6 of the design's list: the alerts first, and the daily release,
 * which writes only to the databases, before any mail, so it never waits behind a relay. Every step runs in a try of its
 * own, and so does every mail: a failure is logged with the step and the row's id, never an address, and leaves the row
 * as it was, so a row that keeps failing never stops the alerts, the release or another row's mail. It stays pending
 * until the last step gives it up.
 *
 * Every time the job compares is its own clock's (`deps.now()`), handed to the database as a parameter, so one clock
 * decides what is fifteen minutes or five days old, and a test can move it.
 */

const MINUTE_MS = 60_000;
const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * MINUTE_MS;

/** The job's name: its lock is `job:moderation-dispatch`, and its log lines carry it. */
export const DISPATCH_JOB = "moderation-dispatch";
/** The time between the end of one round and the start of the next. */
export const DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS = 10 * MINUTE_MS;
/** A receipt, a statement and an urgent item are the job's once they are this old: until then the request that made them is still at work on them. */
const DUE_AFTER_MS = 15 * MINUTE_MS;
/** How many pending receipts one round sends. */
const RECEIPTS_PER_ROUND = 100;
/**
 * How many suspect cases one round asks the media module what they reach: one query a case, and a report of child sexual
 * abuse material needs no account, so a flood of them could hold the round's first step for minutes. The oldest cases
 * are read first; any beyond this count as calling, unread, which only repeats an alert that a case read later may ask for
 * anyway.
 */
export const URGENT_REACH_PER_ROUND = 200;
/** How long a cut-off's marker is kept: two days, so a marker is still there for every round of its own day. */
const MARKER_TTL_MS = 2 * DAY_MS;
/** How long the question "is the marker set?" holds the key when the process dies between asking and letting go. */
const MARKER_PROBE_MS = 30_000;

/** The key and the window of the queue-age alert. */
export const WAITING_ALERT_KEY = "moderation-waiting";
export const WAITING_ALERT_WINDOW_MS = DAY_MS;

/** A round's cut-off: the latest dispatch hour (UTC) at or before the round's start. */
export function cutoffOf(start: Date, hour: number): Date {
  const today = Date.UTC(start.getUTCFullYear(), start.getUTCMonth(), start.getUTCDate(), hour);
  return new Date(today <= start.getTime() ? today : today - DAY_MS);
}

/**
 * The marker of a cut-off's release, by the cut-off's day and hour. Because the key holds the hour, a changed dispatch
 * hour gives a cut-off whose release has not run. It lives beside the jobs' locks, which a restore of the database does
 * not bring back: the README's restore steps delete the markers.

export const dispatchMarkerKey = (cutoff: Date) => `moderation-dispatched:${cutoff.toISOString().slice(0, 13)}`;

/** What one round did, for its log line and for the tests. */
export interface DispatchReport {
  /** The urgent lane's repeat: what became of the alert, or "none" when no item still calls for someone. */
  urgent: "sent" | "throttled" | "unsent" | "nothing_waiting" | "none";
  /** The queue-age alert: what became of it, or "none" when no case is past its time. */
  waiting: "sent" | "throttled" | "unsent" | "none";
  /** How many items the daily release changed, or null when it did not run in this round. */
  released: number | null;
  /** Whether the cut-off's release, both halves, has finished: before this round or in it. */
  marked: boolean;
  /** Whether this round ran the release to its end and wrote the cut-off's marker itself: the daily round. */
  daily: boolean;
  /** The receipts and the statements whose result this round recorded. */
  receipts: number;
  statements: number;
  /** The addresses' contacts and the accounts whose update the relay took. */
  outcomeMails: number;

  /** 3f: the decisions the release of held notices told in this round. */
  noticesReleased: number;
}

/** What a mail's result is recorded as; nothing is recorded where the relay could not take the mail, so the next round sends it again. */
const RECORDED: Record<NotifierUpdateResult | AccountMailResult, MailState | null> = {
  sent: "sent",
  suppressed: "suppressed",
  no_address: "no_address",
  // A contact the janitor has forgotten has no address any more.
  forgotten: "no_address",
  // The relay refused the address for good: no later try changes that.
  refused: "failed",
  unavailable: null,

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- step 5: the alerts

/**
 * Whether an unanswered item of the urgent lane still calls for someone (3c design, section 7.12), in its three cases.
 *   1. A suspect item whose case reaches an image that is still served: until a choice not to seal is recorded on the
 *      case after the item arrived, and then only while no post with a served image was created after the newest such
 *      choice. Nothing else ends it short of the item's answer: after a note, a withhold or a field reset some reader, the
 *      uploader included, is still served the images. A seal ends it by leaving no served image.
 *   2. A suspect item whose case reaches no served image: until a decision taken while deciding, a note or a recorded
 *      choice not to seal comes after the item arrived.
 *   3. Any other item: while no decision taken while deciding came after it and, when the case is about an account or its
 *      post is not visible, no note did either. On a visible post a note never ends it: the post is withheld or decided.
 * The two times of case 1 are compared to the millisecond, and a post created in the same millisecond as the recorded
 * choice counts as created after it: the alert errs on the side of repeating.
 */
export function stillCalls(item: UrgentItemRow, reach: { served: number; newestServedAt: Date | null } | null): boolean {
  if (item.suspect) {
    if (reach === null) throw new Error("a suspect item is judged by what its case reaches");
    if (reach.served > 0) {
      if (!item.declinedAfter || item.newestDeclinedMs === null) return true;
      return reach.newestServedAt !== null && reach.newestServedAt.getTime() >= item.newestDeclinedMs;
    }
    return !(item.interimAfter || item.noteAfter || item.declinedAfter);

  return !item.interimAfter && !(noteCounts && item.noteAfter);

/**
 * The open cases that hold an unanswered item of the urgent lane which is older than 15 minutes and still calls for
 * someone. What a case reaches is read once for a case, and only for a case that holds a suspect item, for at most
 * `limit` cases, the oldest first. An alert fails open: a case whose reach cannot be read counts as calling, and the
 * failure is logged with the case's id, so one case that keeps failing never silences the lane; so does a suspect case
 * beyond the limit, unread.
 */
export async function casesCalling(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "media" | "log">, now: Date, limit = URGENT_REACH_PER_ROUND): Promise<string[]> {
  const items = await urgentItems(deps.apiDb, new Date(now.getTime() - DUE_AFTER_MS));
  const reaches = new Map<string, { served: number; newestServedAt: Date | null }>();
  const calling = new Set<string>();
  // Every read counts toward the limit, one that fails too.
  let reads = 0;
  for (const item of items) {
    if (calling.has(item.caseId)) continue;
    let reach = reaches.get(item.caseId) ?? null;
    if (item.suspect && reach === null) {
      if (reads >= limit) {
        calling.add(item.caseId);
        continue;
      }
      reads++;
      try {
        reach = await deps.media.reach({ type: item.targetType, id: item.targetId });
      } catch (err) {
        deps.log.error({ err, job: DISPATCH_JOB, step: "urgent", caseId: item.caseId }, "moderation-dispatch: what a case reaches could not be read; the case counts as calling");
        calling.add(item.caseId);
        continue;
      }
      reaches.set(item.caseId, reach);

/** The urgent lane's repeat: while a case still calls, the alert is sent again under the key and window of the first one. */
async function repeatUrgent(deps: ModerationDeps, now: Date): Promise<DispatchReport["urgent"]> {
  if ((await casesCalling(deps, now)).length === 0) return "none";
  return alertUrgentLane(deps);
}

/**
 * The queue-age alert, at most once a day: per lane the cases past its response time with the oldest one's time, the
 * open cases that have held a measure taken while deciding for more than a day, whose author cannot appeal it, and (3e,
 * section 7.14) the replies to a suspension or a termination unanswered for longer than REPLY_AIM_HOURS, under the same

}

 * 3e (design, sections 5 and 7.14 item 3): gives up the statement mails of decisions that hold an announced suspension

 * derives into the profile's columns, so the profile is held when it is recorded, and an on-time reply that holds the
 * profile is read before the start is derived. The order is sendStatement's (3e's review, database3), so the two never
 * take the same rows in opposite orders. Answers the ids given up; a failure for one is logged with the decision's id and
 * leaves it for the next round.
 */
export async function giveUpAnnounced(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "social" | "log">, now: Date): Promise<string[]> {

    }

}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- step 3: the daily release

/**
 * Whether the marker is set. The lock a job runs under is also the store of its markers, and it can only take a key or
 * let it go: the question takes the key for a moment, which fails when the marker is there, and lets it go again. A
 * process that dies in between leaves the key for half a minute, not for the marker's two days.
 */
async function markerSet(lock: JobLock, key: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const probe = randomBytes(16).toString("hex");
  if (!(await lock.acquire(key, probe, MARKER_PROBE_MS))) return true;
  await lock.release(key, probe);
  return false;
}

/**
 * The daily release, until the cut-off's marker is set. (a) The database releases every item answered before the cut-off
 * and every changed outcome. (b) Every contact whose notice is still owed something is kept for another six months. The
 * marker is set once both have finished, so a round that fails in between runs the step again: the release then releases
 * nothing new, and no outcome mail goes before (b) has moved each contact's day.
 *
 * When the marker cannot be asked for, the step runs: it only repeats what a finished release leaves as it is. The round
 * is the daily one only when its own write of the marker was accepted. A marker that could not be written is logged, and
 * the next round that can write it is the daily one: a receipt that rides alone goes out once a day, never once a round.
 */
async function dailyRelease(deps: ModerationDeps, lock: JobLock, now: Date, report: DispatchReport): Promise<void> {
  const cutoff = cutoffOf(now, deps.config.MODERATION_DISPATCH_HOUR);
  const key = dispatchMarkerKey(cutoff);
  try {
    if (await markerSet(lock, key)) {
      report.marked = true;
      return;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.warn({ err, job: DISPATCH_JOB, step: "release" }, "moderation-dispatch: the release's marker could not be read; the release runs again");
  }
  report.released = await releaseOutcomes(deps.apiDb, cutoff);
  const owed = await contactsOwed(deps.apiDb);
  if (owed.length > 0) await deps.auth.forgetNotifierAfter(owed, appealDeadline(now));
  report.marked = true;
  try {
    report.daily = await lock.acquire(key, "done", MARKER_TTL_MS);

  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.warn({ err, job: DISPATCH_JOB, step: "release" }, "moderation-dispatch: the release's marker could not be set; the next round runs the release again");
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- step 4: the outcome mails

/**
 * One line of the daily update, from a released item (3c design, section 7.8, step 4, and section 5). The outcome's words
 * are the contracts' one composition, with the scope the status page gives the same item; the other fields say which of
 * the mail's sentences go with the line.
 */
export function updateLine(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "config">, row: OutcomeLineRow): NoticeUpdateLine {
  const outcome = row.shownOutcome as ItemOutcome;
  const noAction = outcome === "no_violation" || outcome === "not_evident";
  let scope: OutcomeWordsInput["scope"] = null;
  // 3e (7.11 item 7): an item whose decision retired the handle reads that in place of the display name and bio, and one
  // whose decision suspended or terminated the account at once reads ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE.measure, which names nothing
  // of what the measure is or how long it lasts.
  if (row.targetType === "account") scope = row.suspect || row.sealed ? "account_suspect" : row.retired ? "account_retired" : row.measure ? "account_measure" : "account";
  else if (row.hasCase && !row.suspect && row.quotes) scope = "quote";

  const unseen = noAction && row.decisionUnseen && row.targetType === "post" && !row.suspect;

    const found = row.ruleId === null || row.rulesVersion === null ? undefined : getRule(row.ruleId, row.rulesVersion);
    if (!found) throw new Error("the item's restriction names no rule of a rulebook korbat holds");
    rule = { id: found.id, title: found.title };
  }
  return {
    ref: row.ref,
    item: row.position,
    link: itemLink(deps, row),
    outcome: outcomeWords({ outcome, rule, suspect: row.suspect, sealed: row.sealed, unseen, noEffect: row.noEffect, scope }),
    reexamination: row.reexamines,
    changed: row.changed,
    // Only a moderator's decision to take no action can be examined again, once; an answer given with the images out of
    // sight does not spend that, also when it answered a re-examination.
    reexaminable: row.byDecision && noAction && !row.reexamined && (!row.reexamines || unseen),
    unseen,
    automatic: !row.hasCase,
  };
}

/** The log line of a mail that did not go: a relay that could not take it is expected and tried again; anything else is a fault to read. */
function logUnsent(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "log">, err: unknown, step: string, row: Record<string, string | string[]>): void {
  if (err instanceof MailUnavailable) deps.log.warn({ err, job: DISPATCH_JOB, step, ...row }, "moderation-dispatch: a mail was not sent; it stays pending for the next round");
  else deps.log.error({ err, job: DISPATCH_JOB, step, ...row }, "moderation-dispatch: a row failed and was left as it was; the round goes on");
}

/**
 * The outcome mails: every released item whose mail is pending, whichever round released it.
 *   - Signed out, the lines go by contact to the auth module, which alone knows which contacts share an address and sends
 *     each address one update. A receipt the 24-hour cap folded rides with its contact's lines; in the daily round a
 *     contact with a folded receipt and nothing else is passed too, so its address gets an update of receipts alone. In
 *     later rounds a folded receipt goes only with its own contact's retried lines, so an address gets one update a day.
 *   - Signed in, they go as one update per account. An item whose reporter was forgotten has nobody to mail.
 * Each line and each carried receipt records its result only while it is still pending. Where the relay could not take a
 * mail nothing is recorded, and the next round sends it again. The rows a mail's result is recorded on are taken before
 * it is sent, in the transaction that records it (beginMailRecord): a database that cannot write refuses that, and
 * nothing is sent, so a line is never mailed round after round for want of a record. The signed-out updates are one call
 * to the auth module, which groups the contacts by address, so their rows are taken and recorded in one transaction,
 * each part's record in a savepoint of its own; each account's update has a transaction of its own.
 */
async function outcomeMails(deps: ModerationDeps, report: DispatchReport): Promise<void> {
  const q = deps.apiDb;
  const rows = await pendingOutcomeLines(q);
  const folded = new Map<string, NoticeRow>((await foldedReceipts(q)).map((notice) => [notice.contactId!, notice]));

  // One part for each contact, which is one notice; one list for each account.
  const byContact = new Map<string, { ref: string; items: string[]; lines: NoticeUpdateLine[] }>();
  const byAccount = new Map<string, { items: string[]; lines: NoticeUpdateLine[] }>();
  const nobody: string[] = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    let line: NoticeUpdateLine;
    try {
      line = updateLine(deps, row);
    } catch (err) {
      logUnsent(deps, err, "outcomes", { itemId: row.id });
      continue;
    }
    if (row.contactId !== null) {
      const part = byContact.get(row.contactId) ?? { ref: row.ref, items: [], lines: [] };
      part.items.push(row.id);
      part.lines.push(line);
      byContact.set(row.contactId, part);
    } else if (row.reporterId !== null) {
      const update = byAccount.get(row.reporterId) ?? { items: [], lines: [] };
      update.items.push(row.id);
      update.lines.push(line);
      byAccount.set(row.reporterId, update);
    } else {
      nobody.push(row.id);
    }
  }

  // Signed out. The parts keep the order of their notices, so an address's update lists them as they were sent.
  const parts: NotifierUpdatePart[] = [];
  const carried = new Map<string, NoticeRow>();
  const withReceipt = async (contactId: string, part: { ref: string; lines: NoticeUpdateLine[] }): Promise<void> => {
    const notice = folded.get(contactId);
    if (!notice) {
      parts.push({ contactId, ref: part.ref, lines: part.lines });
      return;
    }
    try {
      const receipt = await receiptMessage(deps, notice);
      carried.set(contactId, notice);
      parts.push({ contactId, ref: part.ref, lines: part.lines, receipt: { ref: receipt.ref, receivedAt: receipt.receivedAt, items: receipt.items } });
    } catch (err) {
      // The receipt could not be built: the lines go without it, and it waits for the next daily round.
      logUnsent(deps, err, "outcomes", { intakeId: notice.id });
      if (part.lines.length > 0) parts.push({ contactId, ref: part.ref, lines: part.lines });
    }
  };
  for (const [contactId, part] of byContact) await withReceipt(contactId, part);
  if (report.daily) {
    for (const [contactId, notice] of folded) if (!byContact.has(contactId)) await withReceipt(contactId, { ref: notice.ref, lines: [] });
  }
  if (parts.length > 0) {
    // A transaction that fails before its mail (its rows could not be taken) has sent nothing; the round goes on.
    await q.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await beginMailRecord(tx);
      // Every line's row and every carried receipt's notice, before anything is sent; what another sender recorded
      // meanwhile is left out of the mail.
      const locked = await lockPendingOutcomeLines(tx, [...byContact.values()].flatMap((part) => part.items));
      const sending: NotifierUpdatePart[] = [];
      for (const part of parts) {
        const notice = carried.get(part.contactId);
        if (notice && !(await lockPendingReceipt(tx, notice.id, true))) carried.delete(part.contactId);
        const items = byContact.get(part.contactId)?.items ?? [];
        const lines = part.lines.filter((_, index) => locked.has(items[index]!));
        const receipt = carried.has(part.contactId) ? part.receipt : undefined;
        if (lines.length > 0 || receipt) sending.push({ contactId: part.contactId, ref: part.ref, lines, ...(receipt ? { receipt } : {}) });
      }
      if (sending.length === 0) return;
      let results = new Map<string, NotifierUpdateResult>();
      try {
        results = await deps.auth.mailNotifierUpdates(sending);
      } catch (err) {
        logUnsent(deps, err, "outcomes", { contacts: String(sending.length) });
      }
      for (const part of sending) {
        const state = RECORDED[results.get(part.contactId) ?? "unavailable"];
        if (state === null) continue;
        try {
          await tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
            await recordOutcomeMails(sp, (byContact.get(part.contactId)?.items ?? []).filter((id) => locked.has(id)), state);
            const notice = carried.get(part.contactId);
            if (notice) await recordCarriedReceipt(sp, notice.id, state);
          });
          if (state === "sent") report.outcomeMails++;
        } catch (err) {
          logUnsent(deps, err, "outcomes", { contactId: part.contactId });
        }
      }
    }).catch((err: unknown) => logUnsent(deps, err, "outcomes", { contacts: String(parts.length) }));
  }

  // Signed in: one update per account, through the account's own address, each in a transaction of its own.
  for (const [accountId, update] of byAccount) {
    try {
      await q.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await beginMailRecord(tx);
        const locked = await lockPendingOutcomeLines(tx, update.items);
        const lines = update.lines.filter((_, index) => locked.has(update.items[index]!));
        if (lines.length === 0) return;
        const state = RECORDED[await deps.auth.mailAccount(accountId, { template: "notice_update", lines })];
        if (state === null) return;
        await recordOutcomeMails(tx, update.items.filter((id) => locked.has(id)), state);
        if (state === "sent") report.outcomeMails++;
      });
    } catch (err) {
      // The rows are the items: the account is the reporter, whom no log line names.
      logUnsent(deps, err, "outcomes", { itemIds: update.items });
    }
  }

  // The reporter's link was forgotten with their account: there is nobody to mail.
  if (nobody.length > 0) await recordOutcomeMails(q, nobody, "no_address");
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the round

/**
 * One round. `lock` is the store the job's own lock lives in, where the daily release keeps its markers.
 */
export async function dispatchRound(deps: ModerationDeps, lock: JobLock): Promise<DispatchReport> {
  const now = deps.now();
  const report: DispatchReport = {
    urgent: "none",
    waiting: "none",
    released: null,
    marked: false,
    daily: false,
    receipts: 0,
    statements: 0,
    outcomeMails: 0,
    givenUp: { receipts: 0, authorMails: 0, outcomes: 0 },
    noticesReleased: 0,
  };
  const step = async (name: string, run: () => Promise<void>) => {
    try {
      await run();
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err, job: DISPATCH_JOB, step: name }, "moderation-dispatch: a step failed; the round goes on");
    }
  };
  const due = new Date(now.getTime() - DUE_AFTER_MS);

  // 5. The alerts, each in a try of its own: a case whose reach cannot be read never holds the queue-age alert back.
  await step("urgent", async () => {
    report.urgent = await repeatUrgent(deps, now);
  });
  await step("waiting", async () => {
    report.waiting = await alertWaiting(deps, now);
  });

  // 3. The daily release.
  await step("release", () => dailyRelease(deps, lock, now, report));

  // 1. The receipts a relay failure left pending. sendReceipt records every result but a relay failure, which it logs
  // and leaves pending; any other fault it throws, and the row is logged here with the step and left as it was.
  await step("receipts", async () => {
    for (const intakeId of await pendingReceipts(deps.apiDb, due, RECEIPTS_PER_ROUND)) {
      try {
        const state = await sendReceipt(deps, intakeId);
        if (state !== "pending" && state !== "none") report.receipts++;
      } catch (err) {
        logUnsent(deps, err, "receipts", { intakeId });
      }
    }
  });

  // 3f (section 7.10): the release of held notices, before the statements, so that a notice told now is mailed in this
  // round. One transaction: the database's function, which tells what its hold no longer keeps and every decision held
  // with it, then, when it told anything, the audit row order_notices_released by the system, as its last statement.
  await step("order-notices", async () => {
    report.noticesReleased = await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      const count = await releaseHeldNotices(tx);
      if (count > 0) {
        await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "order_notices_released", targetType: null, targetId: null, requestId: null, metadata: { count } });
      }
      return count;
    });
  });

  // 2. The statements that were not mailed after their decision's commit, as they are mailed there.
  await step("statements", async () => {
    for (const decisionId of await pendingAuthorMails(deps.apiDb, due)) {
      try {
        if ((await sendStatement(deps, decisionId)) !== "none") report.statements++;
      } catch (err) {
        logUnsent(deps, err, "statements", { decisionId });
      }
    }
  });

  // 4. The outcome mails, only once the cut-off's release has finished, so each contact's day was moved before its lines go.
  let outcomesTried = false;
  if (report.marked) {
    await step("outcomes", async () => {
      await outcomeMails(deps, report);
      outcomesTried = true;
    });
  }

  // 6. What stayed unsent for five days is given up, without another attempt. Outcome lines only in a round that tried
  // them, after it, so each is tried at least once even when the daily release kept failing for longer than that.
  await step("give-up", async () => {
    const gone = await giveUpReceiptsAndAuthorMails(deps.apiDb, now, RETENTION.mailGiveUpDays);
    // 3e: the announced measures' statement mails, which the bulk statement leaves out, one by one under the profile's lock.
    const announced = await giveUpAnnounced(deps, now);
    report.givenUp.receipts = gone.receipts.length;
    report.givenUp.authorMails = gone.authorMails.length + announced.length;
    for (const id of gone.receipts) deps.log.warn({ job: DISPATCH_JOB, kind: "receipt", id }, "moderation: mail given up");
    for (const id of [...gone.authorMails, ...announced]) deps.log.warn({ job: DISPATCH_JOB, kind: "statement", id }, "moderation: mail given up");
    if (!outcomesTried) return;
    const lines = await giveUpOutcomeMails(deps.apiDb, now, RETENTION.mailGiveUpDays);
    report.givenUp.outcomes = lines.length;
    for (const id of lines) deps.log.warn({ job: DISPATCH_JOB, kind: "outcome", id }, "moderation: mail given up");
  });

  // One line for a round that did something, so the day's release and its mails can be found in the log: counts only.
  const gaveUp = report.givenUp.receipts + report.givenUp.authorMails + report.givenUp.outcomes;
  if (report.daily || report.receipts + report.statements + report.outcomeMails + gaveUp + report.noticesReleased > 0 || report.urgent === "sent" || report.waiting === "sent") {
    deps.log.info({ job: DISPATCH_JOB, ...report }, "moderation-dispatch: round");
  }
  return report;
}

/** The job: a round every ten minutes, counted from the end of the one before, on one API instance at a time. */
export function createDispatchJob(deps: ModerationDeps, lock: JobLock) {
  return createJob({ name: DISPATCH_JOB, intervalMs: DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS, lockTtlMs: DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS, lock, log: deps.log, run: () => dispatchRound(deps, lock) });
}
```

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type {
  Annex3Ground,
  ContactDisposition,
  ContactFolder,
  HoldEndReason,
  OrderChannel,
  OrderCloseGround,
  OrderConsoleEvent,
  OrderEventKind,
  OrderEventVia,
  OrderGround,
  OrderItemCloseReason,
  OrderKind,
  ReportsOwed,
  TellPersonRule,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";

/**
 * The SQL of authorities' orders (3f design, section 5): the messages at the contact point, which the watcher inserts and
 * the console lists and closes (the API role reads every column of contact_messages and may update only its disposition
 * and who set it; the database forces when), and the order records, their items and events (Task 2). The API role reads
 * every order and inserts the console's columns; the clock's events and the corrections go through the two definer
 * functions, bound to their audit rows.
 */

type Querier = Pick<Db, "execute"> | Pick<DbTx, "execute">;

/** One message as the Contact point screen reads it, with its place in the list as text of microseconds for the cursor. */
export interface ContactRow {
  id: string;
  folder: ContactFolder;
  receivedAt: Date;
  /** received_at in UTC to the microsecond: the cursor's sort key. */
  place: string;
  seenAt: Date;
  stale: boolean;
  disposition: ContactDisposition | null;
  handledAt: Date | null;
  /** The handle of the staff member who handled it, or null. */
  handledBy: string | null;
}

/** A page of messages, newest first by the time of receipt, after the given place; only those without a disposition when `open`. */
export async function contactMessages(q: Querier, options: { open: boolean; after: { place: string; id: string } | null; limit: number }): Promise<ContactRow[]> {
  const after = options.after === null ? sql`true` : sql`(m.received_at, m.id) < (${options.after.place}::timestamptz, ${options.after.id}::uuid)`;
  const rows = await q.execute<{
    id: string;
    folder: ContactFolder;
    received_at: string;
    place: string;
    seen_at: string;
    stale: boolean;
    disposition: ContactDisposition | null;
    handled_at: string | null;
    handled_by: string | null;
  }>(sql`
    select m.id, m.folder, m.received_at, to_char(m.received_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as place,
           m.seen_at, m.stale, m.disposition, m.handled_at, p.handle as handled_by
      from public.contact_messages m
      left join public.profiles p on p.id = m.handled_by
     where ${after} and (not ${options.open} or m.disposition is null)
     order by m.received_at desc, m.id desc
     limit ${options.limit}`);
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    folder: row.folder,
    receivedAt: new Date(row.received_at),
    place: row.place,
    seenAt: new Date(row.seen_at),
    stale: row.stale,
    disposition: row.disposition,
    handledAt: row.handled_at === null ? null : new Date(row.handled_at),
    handledBy: row.handled_by,
  }));
}

/**
 * Sets a message's disposition and who set it, only while it has none: the trigger stamps when, and refuses any other
 * change. Answers the message's time of receipt and folder for the audit row, or null when no message without a
 * disposition has the id.
 */
export async function closeMessage(tx: DbTx, id: string, disposition: Exclude<ContactDisposition, "order">, staffId: string): Promise<{ receivedAt: Date; folder: ContactFolder } | null> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ received_at: string; folder: ContactFolder }>(sql`
    update public.contact_messages set disposition = ${disposition}, handled_by = ${staffId}::uuid
     where id = ${id}::uuid and disposition is null
    returning received_at, folder`);
  return row ? { receivedAt: new Date(row.received_at), folder: row.folder } : null;
}

/** Whether a message has the id, whatever its disposition. */
export async function messageExists(q: Querier, id: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return (await q.execute(sql`select 1 from public.contact_messages where id = ${id}::uuid`)).length > 0;
}

/**
 * The home screen's counts of the contact point: the messages without a disposition, stale ones included, the oldest
 * one's time of receipt, and the earliest deadline among them, the time of receipt and order_rules().hour_minutes, also
 * once it has passed. The orders' deadlines are nearestOrderDeadline's.
 */
export async function contactCounts(q: Querier): Promise<{ open: number; oldestAt: Date | null; dueAt: Date | null }> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ open: number; oldest_at: string | null; due_at: string | null }>(sql`
    select count(*)::int as open, min(m.received_at) as oldest_at,
           min(m.received_at) + make_interval(mins => (select r.hour_minutes from public.order_rules() r)) as due_at
      from public.contact_messages m
     where m.disposition is null`);
  return { open: row!.open, oldestAt: row!.oldest_at === null ? null : new Date(row!.oldest_at), dueAt: row!.due_at === null ? null : new Date(row!.due_at) };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- order records (3f design, sections 6.2, 7.4 and 7.5)

/** A timestamptz expression as ISO text in UTC, to the millisecond. The expression is written here, never input. */
const isoOf = (expression: string) => sql.raw(`to_char(${expression} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')`);
/** A list of uuids as a PostgreSQL array. */
const uuidList = (ids: readonly string[]) => sql`${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]`;

/** One link of a new order, with the post it resolved to (null when it named none). */
export interface NewOrderItem {
  link: string;
  postId: string | null;
}

/**
 * The rows of opening an order (section 7.4), which the console's route, `staff.js order-open` and the import all write
 * through insertOrder. `openedBy` is the opening staff account, null from the command line; `cli` carries what only the
 * migrator may write (the receipt and the sending time a channel states), and is absent for the console, whose insert
 * names the console's columns alone and lets the trigger force the rest.
 */
export interface NewOrder {
  id: string;
  kind: OrderKind;
  memberState: string;
  authority: string;
  reference: string;
  channel: OrderChannel;
  messageId: string | null;
  sectionC: boolean;
  emergency: boolean;
  crossBorder: boolean;
  withholdFromAuthor: boolean;
  openedBy: string | null;
  items: readonly NewOrderItem[];
  cli?: { receivedAt: Date | null; sentAt: Date | null };
  /**
   * 3f Task 6 (section 7.17 step 2): the import after a restore writes an order again as its lost row describes it, as
   * the migrator: its own id, when and how it was opened, the receipt and the sending time, each item's id, position and
   * time, and imported_at now. `items` holds the same entries as the order's `items`, in the same order. With it, `cli`
   * is not read.
   */
  imported?: { openedAt: Date; openedVia: "console" | "cli"; receivedAt: Date | null; sentAt: Date | null; items: readonly { id: string; position: number; addedAt: Date }[] };
}

/** An item as written: its id, position, the time the database stamped, and what it names. */
export interface WrittenItem {
  id: string;
  position: number;
  addedAt: Date;
  link: string;
  postId: string | null;
}

/** What opening an order wrote, as its audit row and its alert need it. */
export interface InsertedOrder {
  id: string;
  openedAt: Date;
  receivedAt: Date | null;
  sentAt: Date | null;
  channel: OrderChannel;
  withholdFromAuthor: boolean;
  items: WrittenItem[];
}

/** Inserts items at the next positions of an order, in the order given, and answers them. */
async function insertItems(tx: DbTx, orderId: string, items: readonly NewOrderItem[], from: number): Promise<WrittenItem[]> {
  const written: WrittenItem[] = [];
  for (const [index, item] of items.entries()) {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string; position: number; added_at: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.legal_order_items (id, order_id, position, link, post_id)
      values (gen_random_uuid(), ${orderId}::uuid, ${from + index}::smallint, ${item.link}, ${item.postId}::uuid)
      returning id, position, ${isoOf("added_at")} as added_at`);
    written.push({ id: row!.id, position: row!.position, addedAt: new Date(row!.added_at), link: item.link, postId: item.postId });
  }

}

/**
 * The rows of opening an order, in the caller's transaction (section 7.4 step 4): the order's row (the trigger forces
 * when and how it was opened, the receipt from the message and the withholding), one item a link from position 1, the
 * event `opened`, and the message's disposition `order` when one is named and has none (a message closed as something
 * else keeps its word). The audit row is the caller's, last. A plain function of the module's index: it takes the
 * caller's transaction and no dependency, so the command line, as the migrator, writes the same rows. The migrator's
 * insert passes the triggers' forcing, so it supplies its own `opened_via`, its event's `via` and the message's time.
 */
export async function insertOrder(tx: DbTx, order: NewOrder): Promise<InsertedOrder> {
  if (order.imported !== undefined) return insertImportedOrder(tx, order, order.imported);

          insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, message_id, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, opened_by)
          values (${order.id}::uuid, ${order.kind}, ${order.memberState}, ${order.authority}, ${order.reference}, ${order.channel}, ${order.messageId}::uuid,
                  ${order.sectionC}::boolean, ${order.emergency}::boolean, ${order.crossBorder}::boolean, ${order.withholdFromAuthor}::boolean, ${order.openedBy}::uuid)
          returning ${isoOf("opened_at")} as opened_at, ${isoOf("received_at")} as received_at, ${isoOf("sent_at")} as sent_at, channel, withhold_from_author`)
      : await tx.execute<{ opened_at: string; received_at: string | null; sent_at: string | null; channel: OrderChannel; withhold_from_author: boolean }>(sql`
          insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, message_id, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author,
                                           opened_by, opened_via, received_at, sent_at)
          values (${order.id}::uuid, ${order.kind}, ${order.memberState}, ${order.authority}, ${order.reference}, ${order.channel}, ${order.messageId}::uuid,
                  ${order.sectionC}::boolean, ${order.emergency}::boolean, ${order.crossBorder}::boolean, ${order.withholdFromAuthor}::boolean, ${order.openedBy}::uuid,
                  'cli', ${cli.receivedAt?.toISOString() ?? null}::timestamptz, ${cli.sentAt?.toISOString() ?? null}::timestamptz)
          returning ${isoOf("opened_at")} as opened_at, ${isoOf("received_at")} as received_at, ${isoOf("sent_at")} as sent_at, channel, withhold_from_author`);
  const items = await insertItems(tx, order.id, order.items, 1);
  // The event `opened`: the API role's insert is forced to the console, the clock and the opening account; the migrator's
  // is the command line's.
  await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, by_staff, via) values (${order.id}::uuid, 'opened', ${order.openedBy}::uuid, ${cli === undefined ? "console" : "cli"})`);

        : sql`update public.contact_messages set disposition = 'order', handled_at = now() where id = ${order.messageId}::uuid and disposition is null`,

/**
 * The rows of an order written again by the import after a restore (Task 6, section 7.17 step 2), as the migrator, whose
 * inserts the triggers do not force: the order with its original times and imported_at now, its items with their own ids,
 * positions and times, and the event `opened` at its original time, by whoever opened it, from where. The message keeps
 * its disposition, or gets `order` when the restored database holds it without one. No alert: the order was heard once.
 */
async function insertImportedOrder(tx: DbTx, order: NewOrder, imported: NonNullable<NewOrder["imported"]>): Promise<InsertedOrder> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ opened_at: string; received_at: string | null; sent_at: string | null; channel: OrderChannel; withhold_from_author: boolean }>(sql`
    insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, message_id, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author,
                                     opened_by, opened_via, opened_at, received_at, sent_at, imported_at)
    values (${order.id}::uuid, ${order.kind}, ${order.memberState}, ${order.authority}, ${order.reference}, ${order.channel}, ${order.messageId}::uuid,
            ${order.sectionC}::boolean, ${order.emergency}::boolean, ${order.crossBorder}::boolean, ${order.withholdFromAuthor}::boolean, ${order.openedBy}::uuid,
            ${imported.openedVia}, ${imported.openedAt.toISOString()}::timestamptz, ${imported.receivedAt?.toISOString() ?? null}::timestamptz,
            ${imported.sentAt?.toISOString() ?? null}::timestamptz, now())
    returning ${isoOf("opened_at")} as opened_at, ${isoOf("received_at")} as received_at, ${isoOf("sent_at")} as sent_at, channel, withhold_from_author`);
  const items: WrittenItem[] = [];
  for (const [index, item] of order.items.entries()) {
    const at = imported.items[index]!;
    await tx.execute(sql`
      insert into public.legal_order_items (id, order_id, position, link, post_id, added_at)
      values (${at.id}::uuid, ${order.id}::uuid, ${at.position}::smallint, ${item.link}, ${item.postId}::uuid, ${at.addedAt.toISOString()}::timestamptz)`);
    items.push({ id: at.id, position: at.position, addedAt: at.addedAt, link: item.link, postId: item.postId });
  }
  await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, at, by_staff, via)
                       values (${order.id}::uuid, 'opened', ${imported.openedAt.toISOString()}::timestamptz, ${order.openedBy}::uuid, ${imported.openedVia})`);
  if (order.messageId !== null) await tx.execute(sql`update public.contact_messages set disposition = 'order', handled_at = now() where id = ${order.messageId}::uuid and disposition is null`);
  return {
    id: order.id,
    openedAt: new Date(row!.opened_at),
    receivedAt: row!.received_at === null ? null : new Date(row!.received_at),
    sentAt: row!.sent_at === null ? null : new Date(row!.sent_at),
    channel: row!.channel,
    withholdFromAuthor: row!.withhold_from_author,
    items,
  };
}

/** Adds items to an order after its last position (section 7.4, "More items"); the caller holds the order's advisory lock. */
export async function addOrderItems(tx: DbTx, orderId: string, items: readonly NewOrderItem[]): Promise<WrittenItem[]> {
  const [last] = await tx.execute<{ position: number }>(sql`select coalesce(max(position), 0)::int as position from public.legal_order_items where order_id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
  return insertItems(tx, orderId, items, last!.position + 1);
}

/** The posts of these ids that a row of posts has, in any state. */
export async function existingPosts(q: Querier, ids: readonly string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
  if (ids.length === 0) return new Set();
  const found = await q.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.posts where id = any(${uuidList(ids)})`);
  return new Set(found.map((row) => row.id));
}

/**
 * How many orders the account opened in the last 24 hours by the database's clock, and in how many seconds the oldest of
 * them leaves that window (section 7.4 step 1); the insert's trigger counts again under the account's lock.
 */
export async function ordersOpenedToday(q: Querier, staffId: string): Promise<{ count: number; retryAfterSeconds: number }> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ count: number; retry: number | null }>(sql`
    select count(*)::int as count,
           ceil(extract(epoch from min(opened_at) + make_interval(days => 1) - clock_timestamp()))::int as retry
      from public.legal_orders where opened_by = ${staffId}::uuid and opened_at > clock_timestamp() - make_interval(days => 1)`);
  return { count: row!.count, retryAfterSeconds: Math.max(1, row!.retry ?? 1) };
}

/** The order of this issuing state, authority and reference, which the unique key names. */
export async function orderByReference(q: Querier, memberState: string, authority: string, reference: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.legal_orders where member_state = ${memberState} and authority = ${authority} and reference = ${reference}`);
  return row?.id ?? null;
}

/** An order's row as the console's reads need it: the facts, the hold's columns and what the command line recorded. */
export interface OrderRow {
  id: string;
  kind: OrderKind;
  memberState: string;
  authority: string;
  reference: string;
  channel: OrderChannel;
  messageId: string | null;
  receivedAt: string | null;
  sentAt: string | null;
  issuedAt: string | null;
  dueAt: string | null;
  sectionC: boolean;
  emergency: boolean;
  crossBorder: boolean;
  withholdFromAuthor: boolean;
  preserve: boolean;
  holdExtended: boolean;
  holdEndedAt: string | null;
  holdEndReason: HoldEndReason | null;
  tellPerson: TellPersonRule | null;
  tellPersonAt: string | null;
  openedBy: string | null;
  openedVia: "console" | "cli";
  openedAt: string;
  verifiedAt: string | null;
  hasReasons: boolean;
  hasRedress: boolean;
  hasScope: boolean;
  hasDocument: boolean;
  closedAt: string | null;
  importedAt: string | null;
  /** order_hold_until: null without Section C, 'infinity' as null with `holdOpen`. */
  holdUntil: string | null;
  holdOpen: boolean;
  closeGround: OrderCloseGround | null;
  /** The newest notice_released event's time. */
  releasedAt: string | null;
  /** Whether a scrutiny was requested. */
  scrutinyRequested: boolean;
  items: number;
  itemsInForce: number;
  /** Decisions of the order whose author was not told. */
  noticesHeld: number;
  /** An item of the order is disabled, or was. */
  givenEffect: boolean;
  /** Items neither disabled nor closed with a reason, for every kind of order. */
  itemsOpen: number;
  /** An item added after the verification, or any item while the order is not verified. */
  itemsUnverified: boolean;
  clock: OrderClockRow | null;
  /** The database's clock when the row was read. */
  now: string;
}

/** One row of legal_order_clock, with the newest Annex III's time and ground while the clock is stopped. */
export interface OrderClockRow {
  clockStart: string | null;
  stopped: boolean;
  stoppedAt: string | null;
  stopGround: Annex3Ground | null;
  deadlineAt: string | null;
  targetAt: string | null;
  itemsOpen: number;
  firstEffectAt: string | null;
  lastEffectAt: string | null;
  withinHour: boolean | null;
}

/** The orders the filter selects, with every fact the list and the order's screen print. */
async function orderRowsWhere(q: Querier, where: ReturnType<typeof sql>): Promise<OrderRow[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
    select o.id, o.kind, o.member_state, o.authority, o.reference, o.channel, o.message_id,
           ${isoOf("o.received_at")} as received_at, ${isoOf("o.sent_at")} as sent_at, ${isoOf("o.issued_at")} as issued_at, ${isoOf("o.due_at")} as due_at,
           o.section_c, o.emergency, o.cross_border, o.withhold_from_author, o.preserve, o.hold_extended,
           ${isoOf("o.hold_ended_at")} as hold_ended_at, o.hold_end_reason, o.tell_person, ${isoOf("o.tell_person_at")} as tell_person_at,
           p.handle as opened_by, o.opened_via, ${isoOf("o.opened_at")} as opened_at, ${isoOf("o.verified_at")} as verified_at,
           o.reasons is not null as has_reasons, o.redress is not null as has_redress, o.scope is not null as has_scope, o.document_sha256 is not null as has_document,
           ${isoOf("o.closed_at")} as closed_at, ${isoOf("o.imported_at")} as imported_at,
           case when h.until = 'infinity'::timestamptz then null else ${isoOf("h.until")} end as hold_until,
           coalesce(h.until = 'infinity'::timestamptz, false) as hold_open,
           case when o.closed_at is null then null else
             (select e.ground from public.legal_order_events e where e.order_id = o.id and e.kind = 'closed_without_effect' order by e.at desc, e.id desc limit 1) end as close_ground,
           (select ${isoOf("max(e.at)")} from public.legal_order_events e where e.order_id = o.id and e.kind = 'notice_released') as released_at,
           exists (select 1 from public.legal_order_events e where e.order_id = o.id and e.kind = 'scrutiny_requested') as scrutiny_requested,
           (select count(*)::int from public.legal_order_items i where i.order_id = o.id) as items,
           (select count(*)::int from public.legal_order_items i join public.measures_in_force m on m.id = i.action_id where i.order_id = o.id) as items_in_force,
           (select count(*)::int from public.legal_order_items i join public.decisions d on d.order_item_id = i.id where i.order_id = o.id and d.informed_at is null) as notices_held,
           exists (select 1 from public.legal_order_items i where i.order_id = o.id and i.disabled_at is not null) as given_effect,
           (select count(*)::int from public.legal_order_items i where i.order_id = o.id and i.disabled_at is null and i.closed_at is null) as items_open_all,
           exists (select 1 from public.legal_order_items i where i.order_id = o.id and (o.verified_at is null or i.added_at > o.verified_at)) as items_unverified,
           c.order_id is not null as has_clock, ${isoOf("c.clock_start")} as clock_start, c.stopped, ${isoOf("c.deadline_at")} as deadline_at, ${isoOf("c.target_at")} as target_at,
           c.items_open, ${isoOf("c.first_effect_at")} as first_effect_at, ${isoOf("c.last_effect_at")} as last_effect_at, c.within_hour,
           case when c.stopped then (select ${isoOf("a.at")} from public.legal_order_events a where a.order_id = o.id and a.kind = 'annex3_sent' order by a.at desc, a.id desc limit 1) end as stopped_at,
           case when c.stopped then (select a.ground from public.legal_order_events a where a.order_id = o.id and a.kind = 'annex3_sent' order by a.at desc, a.id desc limit 1) end as stop_ground,
           ${isoOf("clock_timestamp()")} as now
      from public.legal_orders o
      left join public.profiles p on p.id = o.opened_by
      left join public.legal_order_clock c on c.order_id = o.id
      cross join lateral (select public.order_hold_until(o.id) as until) h
     where ${where}`);
  return found.map((r) => ({
    id: r.id as string,
    kind: r.kind as OrderKind,
    memberState: r.member_state as string,
    authority: r.authority as string,
    reference: r.reference as string,
    channel: r.channel as OrderChannel,
    messageId: r.message_id as string | null,
    receivedAt: r.received_at as string | null,
    sentAt: r.sent_at as string | null,
    issuedAt: r.issued_at as string | null,
    dueAt: r.due_at as string | null,
    sectionC: r.section_c as boolean,
    emergency: r.emergency as boolean,
    crossBorder: r.cross_border as boolean,
    withholdFromAuthor: r.withhold_from_author as boolean,
    preserve: r.preserve as boolean,
    holdExtended: r.hold_extended as boolean,
    holdEndedAt: r.hold_ended_at as string | null,
    holdEndReason: r.hold_end_reason as HoldEndReason | null,
    tellPerson: r.tell_person as TellPersonRule | null,
    tellPersonAt: r.tell_person_at as string | null,
    openedBy: r.opened_by as string | null,
    openedVia: r.opened_via as "console" | "cli",
    openedAt: r.opened_at as string,
    verifiedAt: r.verified_at as string | null,
    hasReasons: r.has_reasons as boolean,
    hasRedress: r.has_redress as boolean,
    hasScope: r.has_scope as boolean,
    hasDocument: r.has_document as boolean,
    closedAt: r.closed_at as string | null,
    importedAt: r.imported_at as string | null,
    holdUntil: r.hold_until as string | null,
    holdOpen: r.hold_open as boolean,
    closeGround: r.close_ground as OrderCloseGround | null,
    releasedAt: r.released_at as string | null,
    scrutinyRequested: r.scrutiny_requested as boolean,
    items: r.items as number,
    itemsInForce: r.items_in_force as number,
    noticesHeld: r.notices_held as number,
    givenEffect: r.given_effect as boolean,
    itemsOpen: r.items_open_all as number,
    itemsUnverified: r.items_unverified as boolean,
    clock: r.has_clock
      ? {
          clockStart: r.clock_start as string | null,
          stopped: r.stopped as boolean,
          stoppedAt: r.stopped_at as string | null,
          stopGround: r.stop_ground as Annex3Ground | null,
          deadlineAt: r.deadline_at as string | null,
          targetAt: r.target_at as string | null,
          itemsOpen: r.items_open as number,
          firstEffectAt: r.first_effect_at as string | null,
          lastEffectAt: r.last_effect_at as string | null,
          withinHour: r.within_hour as boolean | null,
        }
      : null,
    now: r.now as string,
  }));
}

/** One order's row, or null. */
export async function orderRow(q: Querier, id: string): Promise<OrderRow | null> {
  const [row] = await orderRowsWhere(q, sql`o.id = ${id}::uuid`);
  return row ?? null;
}

/** The orders that are not closed, and those closed in the last 30 days (section 7.5). */
export async function orderRows(q: Querier): Promise<OrderRow[]> {
  return orderRowsWhere(q, sql`(o.closed_at is null or o.closed_at > clock_timestamp() - make_interval(days => 30))`);
}

/** One item of an order with what it named, read live, and what became of it. */
export interface OrderItemRow {
  id: string;
  position: number;
  link: string;
  postId: string | null;
  addedAt: string;
  decisionId: string | null;
  caseId: string | null;
  inForce: boolean;
  disabledAt: string | null;
  noEffect: "deleted" | "already" | null;
  preserveUntil: string | null;
  preserveEndedAt: string | null;
  /** When the preservation's end erased the post: its post's erasure at the very instant the preservation ended. */
  erasedAt: string | null;
  reinstatedAt: string | null;
  reinstatedGround: OrderGround | null;
  closedAt: string | null;
  closedReason: OrderItemCloseReason | null;
  /** The post as it stands now, when a row of posts has the item's post. */
  post: { authorHandle: string | null; state: string; body: string; createdAt: string; deletedOn: string | null } | null;
}

/**
 * When the end of an item's preservation erased its post (Task 4, order_preservation_end): that function sets the post's
 * erased_at and the item's preserve_ended_at to the same instant, its transaction's start, and no other writer does so,
 * so the equality tells an erasure from an end without one (a reinstatement, a correction, a measure no longer in force).
 * `i` is the item and `p` its post.
 */
const ERASED_BY_PRESERVATION = "(case when p.erased_at = i.preserve_ended_at then i.preserve_ended_at end)";

/** An order's items in position order, each with its post read live. */
export async function orderItems(q: Querier, orderId: string): Promise<OrderItemRow[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
    select i.id, i.position, i.link, i.post_id, ${isoOf("i.added_at")} as added_at, i.decision_id, d.case_id,
           exists (select 1 from public.measures_in_force m where m.id = i.action_id) as in_force,
           ${isoOf("i.disabled_at")} as disabled_at, a.no_effect, ${isoOf("i.preserve_until")} as preserve_until, ${isoOf("i.preserve_ended_at")} as preserve_ended_at,
           ${isoOf(ERASED_BY_PRESERVATION)} as erased_at,
           ${isoOf("i.reinstated_at")} as reinstated_at,
           (select e.ground from public.legal_order_events e where e.item_id = i.id and e.kind = 'reinstated' order by e.at desc, e.id desc limit 1) as reinstated_ground,
           ${isoOf("i.closed_at")} as closed_at, i.closed_reason,
           p.id is not null as has_post, a2.handle as author_handle, p.state::text as post_state, p.body, ${isoOf("p.created_at")} as post_created_at,
           to_char(p.deleted_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as deleted_on
      from public.legal_order_items i
      left join public.decisions d on d.id = i.decision_id
      left join public.decision_actions a on a.id = i.action_id
      left join public.posts p on p.id = i.post_id
      left join public.profiles a2 on a2.id = p.author_id
     where i.order_id = ${orderId}::uuid
     order by i.position`);
  return found.map((r) => ({
    id: r.id as string,
    position: r.position as number,
    link: r.link as string,
    postId: r.post_id as string | null,
    addedAt: r.added_at as string,
    decisionId: r.decision_id as string | null,
    caseId: r.case_id as string | null,
    inForce: r.in_force as boolean,
    disabledAt: r.disabled_at as string | null,
    noEffect: r.no_effect as "deleted" | "already" | null,
    preserveUntil: r.preserve_until as string | null,
    preserveEndedAt: r.preserve_ended_at as string | null,
    erasedAt: r.erased_at as string | null,
    reinstatedAt: r.reinstated_at as string | null,
    reinstatedGround: r.reinstated_ground as OrderGround | null,
    closedAt: r.closed_at as string | null,
    closedReason: r.closed_reason as OrderItemCloseReason | null,
    post: r.has_post
      ? { authorHandle: r.author_handle as string | null, state: r.post_state as string, body: r.body as string, createdAt: r.post_created_at as string, deletedOn: r.deleted_on as string | null }
      : null,
  }));
}

/** One event of an order, oldest first, with who wrote it as a staff handle. */
export interface OrderEventRow {
  id: string;
  kind: OrderEventKind;
  ground: string | null;
  at: string;
  effectiveAt: string | null;
  itemId: string | null;
  by: string | null;
  via: OrderEventVia;
}

export async function orderEvents(q: Querier, orderId: string): Promise<OrderEventRow[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
    select e.id, e.kind, e.ground, ${isoOf("e.at")} as at, ${isoOf("e.effective_at")} as effective_at, e.item_id, p.handle as by, e.via
      from public.legal_order_events e left join public.profiles p on p.id = e.by_staff
     where e.order_id = ${orderId}::uuid order by e.at, e.id`);
  return found.map((r) => ({
    id: r.id as string,
    kind: r.kind as OrderEventKind,
    ground: r.ground as string | null,
    at: r.at as string,
    effectiveAt: r.effective_at as string | null,
    itemId: r.item_id as string | null,
    by: r.by as string | null,
    via: r.via as OrderEventVia,
  }));
}

/** An event's effective time, as its audit row records it. */
export async function eventEffectiveAt(q: Querier, eventId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ effective_at: string | null }>(sql`select ${isoOf("effective_at")} as effective_at from public.legal_order_events where id = ${eventId}::uuid`);
  return row?.effective_at ?? null;
}

/** The ground of an event, which for `corrected` is the rule that allowed the correction. */
export async function eventGround(q: Querier, eventId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ ground: string | null }>(sql`select ground from public.legal_order_events where id = ${eventId}::uuid`);
  return row?.ground ?? null;
}

/** order_event_record, as its owner, for the acting account (section 6.2): answers the event's id. */
export async function recordOrderEvent(tx: DbTx, orderId: string, kind: OrderConsoleEvent, ground: string | null, messageId: string | null, byStaff: string): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(
    sql`select public.order_event_record(${orderId}::uuid, ${kind}::text, ${ground}::text, ${messageId}::uuid, ${byStaff}::uuid) as id`,
  );
  return row!.id;
}

/** order_correct, as its owner, for the acting account (section 6.2): answers the event's id. */
export async function correctOrder(tx: DbTx, orderId: string, facts: Record<string, unknown>, byStaff: string): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select public.order_correct(${orderId}::uuid, ${JSON.stringify(facts)}::text::jsonb, ${byStaff}::uuid) as id`);
  return row!.id;
}

/** The authors of the posts an order disabled, which a correction after effect locks first (section 5, the lock order, item 2). */
export async function disabledAuthors(q: Querier, orderId: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<{ author_id: string }>(sql`
    select distinct p.author_id from public.legal_order_items i join public.posts p on p.id = i.post_id
     where i.order_id = ${orderId}::uuid and i.disabled_at is not null order by p.author_id`);
  return found.map((row) => row.author_id);
}

/** The orders opened from each of these messages. */
export async function ordersOfMessages(q: Querier, messageIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, string[]>> {
  const orders = new Map<string, string[]>();
  if (messageIds.length === 0) return orders;
  const found = await q.execute<{ message_id: string; id: string }>(
    sql`select message_id, id from public.legal_orders where message_id = any(${uuidList(messageIds)}) order by opened_at, id`,
  );
  for (const row of found) orders.set(row.message_id, [...(orders.get(row.message_id) ?? []), row.id]);
  return orders;
}

/**
 * The earliest deadline of an order that still has an open item (section 10.2, StaffOverview.contact.dueAt), also once
 * it has passed: a removal order's running clock, or a DSA order's deadline as its text states it. Null when none runs.
 */
export async function nearestOrderDeadline(q: Querier): Promise<Date | null> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ due_at: string | null }>(sql`
    select min(d.due) as due_at from (
      select c.deadline_at as due from public.legal_order_clock c join public.legal_orders o on o.id = c.order_id
       where o.closed_at is null and not c.stopped and c.deadline_at is not null and c.items_open > 0
      union all
      select o.due_at from public.legal_orders o
       where o.closed_at is null and o.kind <> 'tco_removal' and o.due_at is not null
         and exists (select 1 from public.legal_order_items i where i.order_id = o.id and i.disabled_at is null and i.closed_at is null)) d`);
  return row?.due_at ? new Date(row.due_at) : null;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- giving effect (Task 3, section 7.6)

/** An order's item as the effect reads it before its transaction: the post it names and what became of it. */
export interface EffectItemRow {
  id: string;
  postId: string | null;
  inForce: boolean;
  /** Whether a correction had closed it when the effect read the order. */
  closed: boolean;
}

/** The order's items of these ids (the effect compares each with what the key signed). */
export async function effectItems(q: Querier, orderId: string, itemIds: readonly string[]): Promise<EffectItemRow[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<{ id: string; post_id: string | null; in_force: boolean; closed: boolean }>(sql`
    select i.id, i.post_id, exists (select 1 from public.measures_in_force m where m.id = i.action_id) as in_force, i.closed_at is not null as closed
      from public.legal_order_items i where i.order_id = ${orderId}::uuid and i.id = any(${uuidList(itemIds)})`);
  return found.map((row) => ({ id: row.id, postId: row.post_id, inForce: row.in_force, closed: row.closed }));
}

/**
 * Which of these items are closed now, read as a statement of its own once the effect's transaction holds their rows, so
 * a closing that committed while the effect waited for a row is seen (3f's review, database4).
 */
export async function closedItems(tx: DbTx, itemIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Set<string>> {
  const found = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.legal_order_items where id = any(${uuidList(itemIds)}) and closed_at is not null`);
  return new Set(found.map((row) => row.id));
}

/** The intake item an effect inserted for an order's item: the API role may write that one column, which decisions_record does not trust. */
export async function setItemIntake(tx: DbTx, itemId: string, intakeItemId: string): Promise<void> {
  await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_order_items set intake_item_id = ${intakeItemId}::uuid where id = ${itemId}::uuid`);
}

/** A case's version as it stands in this transaction, which an order decision names as the version it saw. */
export async function caseVersion(tx: DbTx, caseId: string): Promise<number> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ state_version: number }>(sql`select state_version from public.cases where id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
  return row!.state_version;
}

/**
 * An order decision's row (7.6 step 5.2): its item, the case's version, the law as its ground, no rule and no text of
 * korbat's, the texts' versions the API serves, and the snapshot this transaction took. The triggers force the source,
 * the category and keyword, whether it needs an admin, and whether its author is told now or at the hold's end.
 */
export async function insertOrderDecision(
  tx: DbTx,
  row: { id: string; caseId: string; itemId: string; stateVersion: number; rulesVersion: number; redressVersion: number; category: string; keyword: string | null; snapshotId: string; snapshotDigest: string; decidedBy: string },
): Promise<void> {
  await tx.execute(
    sql`insert into decisions (id, case_id, kind, order_item_id, seen_state_version, through_seq, outcome, ground, rule_id, rules_version, redress_version, category, category_keyword,
                               snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, facts_digest, reason_digest, legal_reference_digest, decided_by)
        values (${row.id}::uuid, ${row.caseId}::uuid, 'order'::decision_kind, ${row.itemId}::uuid, ${row.stateVersion}::int, 0, 'restricted'::decision_outcome,
                'illegal'::decision_ground, null, ${row.rulesVersion}::smallint, ${row.redressVersion}::smallint, ${row.category}, ${row.keyword},
                ${row.snapshotId}::uuid, ${row.snapshotDigest}, null, null, null, ${row.decidedBy}::uuid)`,
  );
}

/**
 * Home's [home.unverified] (10.2): the orders that are not closed and have a disabled item while the order is not
 * verified, or a disabled item added after the check, each with its first disabling, oldest first.
 */
export async function unverifiedOrders(q: Querier, limit: number): Promise<{ total: number; items: { orderId: string; effectAt: string }[] }> {
  const found = await q.execute<{ id: string; effect_at: string; total: number }>(sql`
    select o.id, ${isoOf("min(i.disabled_at)")} as effect_at, (count(*) over ())::int as total
      from public.legal_orders o join public.legal_order_items i on i.order_id = o.id and i.disabled_at is not null
     where o.closed_at is null and (o.verified_at is null or i.added_at > o.verified_at)
     group by o.id order by min(i.disabled_at), o.id limit ${limit}`);
  return { total: found[0]?.total ?? 0, items: found.map((row) => ({ orderId: row.id, effectAt: row.effect_at })) };
}

/**
 * Task 5 (sections 7.13 and 10.2, Home's [home.owed]): the notification records owed, as reports_owed() answers them and
 * nothing more: each one's case, kind and since when, oldest first, at most `limit`, and how many. The API's role reads
 * no record itself; the definer function is all it may ask.
 */
export async function reportsOwed(q: Querier, limit: number): Promise<{ total: number; items: { caseId: string; kind: ReportsOwed["items"][number]["kind"]; since: string }[] }> {
  const found = await q.execute<{ case_id: string; kind: ReportsOwed["items"][number]["kind"]; since: string; total: number }>(sql`
    select r.case_id, r.kind, ${isoOf("r.since")} as since, (count(*) over ())::int as total
      from public.reports_owed() r order by r.since, r.case_id limit ${limit}`);
  return { total: found[0]?.total ?? 0, items: found.map((row) => ({ caseId: row.case_id, kind: row.kind, since: row.since })) };
}

/** Task 5 (8.6, CaseView.reportOwed): since when a report to the authorities is owed for this case, from reports_owed(); null when none is. */
export async function reportOwedOn(q: Querier, caseId: string): Promise<{ since: string } | null> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ since: string | null }>(sql`select ${isoOf("min(r.since)")} as since from public.reports_owed() r where r.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
  return row?.since ? { since: row.since } : null;
}

/**
 * Whether an order's notice about this post is held (8.6, CaseView.noticeHeld): an untold order decision about it whose
 * measure is in force, with the earliest end of such a hold, null while it has none recorded ('infinity'); null when no
 * notice is held. The same test as the database's order_notice_held.
 */
export async function noticeHeldOn(q: Querier, postId: string): Promise<{ until: string | null } | null> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ held: boolean; until: string | null; open: boolean }>(sql`
    select count(*) > 0 as held,
           ${isoOf("min(public.order_hold_until(i.order_id)) filter (where public.order_hold_until(i.order_id) < 'infinity'::timestamptz)")} as until,
           bool_or(public.order_hold_until(i.order_id) = 'infinity'::timestamptz) as open
      from public.measures_in_force m
      join public.decisions d on d.id = m.decision_id and d.kind::text = 'order' and d.informed_at is null
      join public.legal_order_items i on i.id = d.order_item_id
     where m.post_id = ${postId}::uuid and m.kind::text = 'disable_by_order'`);
  if (!row?.held) return null;
  return { until: row.open ? null : row.until };
}

/**
 * The order members of a case's ledger rows (10.2, CaseDecisionAction): for a disable_by_order its order and whether it
 * keeps the post from its author, for a reinstatement its ground; rows of other kinds are not in the answer.
 */
export async function caseOrderFacts(q: Querier, caseId: string): Promise<Map<string, { orderId?: string; withholdAuthor?: boolean; orderGround?: OrderGround }>> {
  const found = await q.execute<{ id: string; order_id: string | null; withhold_author: boolean | null; order_ground: string | null }>(sql`
    select a.id, i.order_id, a.withhold_author, a.order_ground
      from public.decision_actions a join public.decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id
      left join public.legal_order_items i on i.id = d.order_item_id
     where d.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid and a.kind::text in ('disable_by_order', 'reinstate_by_order')`);
  const facts = new Map<string, { orderId?: string; withholdAuthor?: boolean; orderGround?: OrderGround }>();
  for (const row of found) {
    facts.set(row.id, {
      ...(row.order_id !== null ? { orderId: row.order_id } : {}),
      ...(row.withhold_author !== null ? { withholdAuthor: row.withhold_author } : {}),
      ...(row.order_ground !== null ? { orderGround: row.order_ground as OrderGround } : {}),
    });
  }
  return facts;
}

/** Whether a post is preserved for an order now: the database's one predicate, post_preserved. */
export async function postPreserved(q: Querier, postId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ preserved: boolean }>(sql`select public.post_preserved(${postId}::uuid) as preserved`);
  return row?.preserved ?? false;
}

/** order_notices_release(), as its owner: how many decisions it told (section 6.3). */
export async function releaseHeldNotices(tx: DbTx): Promise<number> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ told: number }>(sql`select public.order_notices_release() as told`);
  return row?.told ?? 0;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- preservation and retention (Task 4)

/**
 * The items whose preservation is due to end (3f design, sections 7.11 and 7.18): preserve_until passed and no end
 * recorded, oldest first. The retention job only names them: order_preservation_end checks the same again under its
 * locks, and answers false, writing nothing, while the post is still frozen, so such an item is named again next round.
 */
export async function duePreservations(q: Querier): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
    select i.id from public.legal_order_items i
     where i.preserve_until is not null and i.preserve_until <= now() and i.preserve_ended_at is null
     order by i.preserve_until, i.id`);
  return found.map((row) => row.id);
}

/**
 * order_preservation_end(item), as its owner (6.4): whether the preservation ended, and whether that erased the post's
 * content, which is so exactly when the item's measure still stands after the call (step 5; an end without an erasure,
 * step 3, is the end of a preservation whose measure no longer stands). Raises not_due when the item is not due.
 */
export async function endPreservation(tx: DbTx, itemId: string): Promise<{ ended: boolean; erased: boolean }> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ ended: boolean }>(sql`select public.order_preservation_end(${itemId}::uuid) as ended`);
  if (!row?.ended) return { ended: false, erased: false };
  const [after] = await tx.execute<{ erased: boolean }>(sql`
    select exists (select 1 from public.measures_in_force m where m.id = i.action_id) as erased
      from public.legal_order_items i where i.id = ${itemId}::uuid`);
  return { ended: true, erased: after?.erased ?? false };
}

/** The orders whose records are due (order_records_due(), 6.4): three years after the newest event, once nothing of them stands. */
export async function dueOrderRecords(q: Querier): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await q.execute<{ order_id: string }>(sql`select d.order_id from public.order_records_due() d order by d.order_id`);
  return found.map((row) => row.order_id);
}

/**
 * 3f's review (proofs3): what the yearly counts need to know of an order whose records are about to be erased, read in the
 * erasure's own transaction: its kind and its receipt and opening times as they stand then. The order_records step's
 * audit row carries them, since the order's opening row may name another kind (corrected since) or not exist (an order
 * written again by restore-import), and the records themselves are gone afterwards. Null when no order has the id.
 */
export async function erasedOrderFacts(tx: DbTx, orderId: string): Promise<{ kind: string; receivedAt: string | null; openedAt: string } | null> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ kind: string; received_at: string | null; opened_at: string }>(sql`
    select o.kind::text as kind, ${isoOf("o.received_at")} as received_at, ${isoOf("o.opened_at")} as opened_at from public.legal_orders o where o.id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
  return row ? { kind: row.kind, receivedAt: row.received_at, openedAt: row.opened_at } : null;
}

/** erase_order_records(order), as its owner: how many rows of the order's records it deleted. Raises not_due when it is not due. */
export async function eraseOrderRecords(tx: DbTx, orderId: string): Promise<number> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select public.erase_order_records(${orderId}::uuid) as n`);
  return row?.n ?? 0;
}

/**
 * delete_contact_messages(older_than) with older_than the database's own now() less message_keep_days, computed in the
 * same statement as the function's check, so no clock of the API's is ever compared with the database's.
 */
export async function deleteContactMessages(tx: DbTx): Promise<number> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(
    sql`select public.delete_contact_messages(now() - make_interval(days => (select r.message_keep_days from public.order_rules() r))) as n`,
  );
  return row?.n ?? 0;
}

/**
 * Task 5 (sections 6.5 and 7.18): the retention step authority_records, one call of erase_authority_records(), which checks
 * its own rule against the database's clock and answers a count and nothing else: the API's role reads no record.
 */
export async function eraseAuthorityRecords(tx: DbTx): Promise<number> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select public.erase_authority_records() as n`);
  return row?.n ?? 0;
}

/**
 * The UTC day on which an order's preservation ended by erasing this post (8.6, CaseView.orderErasedOn), or null when no
 * preservation's end erased it.
 */
export async function orderErasedOn(q: Querier, postId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ day: string | null }>(sql`
    select to_char(max(i.preserve_ended_at) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day
      from public.legal_order_items i join public.posts p on p.id = i.post_id
     where i.post_id = ${postId}::uuid and p.erased_at = i.preserve_ended_at`);
  return row?.day ?? null;
}
```
